Many noted that Shri Mataji's strong creative energy greatly inspired them to deepen the mastery of their skill and to realise their full potential.

Shri Mataji's efforts in the development of the arts included active support of theatre. She inspired a group of talented actors to unite and create the \"Theatre of Eternal Values.\" Formed in 1996 in Ghent, Belgium, TEV continues to tour around the world, performing original productions that touch on the themes of spirituality, self-development, and awareness, by writers such as William Blake, Shakespeare, and Leo Tolstoy.
","action":"","url":"","image":{"id":230,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/230/small_PhotoSM-150.jpg"},"mediaFiles":[230],"type":"image","alignment":"left","style":"hero","spacing":"separate","background":"white","color":"dark","position":"right","decorations":{"sidetext":{"text":"The Arts"},"triangle":{"alignment":"left"}}}},{"id":"0gFJSg2Z6M","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"x9e0wfd2mmi","text":"Holistic approach to health","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"pZRP83egUK","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"ah06fh9onsu","text":"Shri Mataji studied medicine for several years until the political events connected with the independence movement of India forced her to leave school. Being brought up in a tradition that recognised the connection between spirituality and health, Shri Mataji devoted herself to studying meditation and observing how it affects the mind and physical body of a person.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"rXIV3Du6Nl","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"5t121rat8pg","text":"During the study of meditation, Shri Mataji learned about the subtle energy system of the chakras (nerve plexuses) and channels (sympathetic and parasympathetic nervous systems). This subtle system determines our physical, mental and emotional state. Shri Mataji also knew of a nourishing female inner energy, known as ‘Kundalini’ in the ancient Indian writings. She studied human behaviour and its influence on this energy and subtle system. She saw how unbalanced behaviour could lead to physical, mental and emotional extremes, which in turn leads to a deterioration in health, but that the Kundalini can restore balance .","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"upK0pQV97a","type":"textbox","data":{"id":"pd5ey9ut9fo","title":"","subtitle":"","caption":"","credit":"","text":"\"This Kundalini, when She passes through these six centers, She enlightens those centers, nourishes those centers and integrates them - so in totality you are all right. It's not like, that one part of the body is treated, another part is neglected - in totality, in the whole balance. And She puts you in the central path of balance.\"","action":"","url":"","mediaFiles":[],"type":"text","alignment":"center","style":"hero","spacing":"overlap","background":"white","color":"light","position":"left","decorations":{}}},{"id":"bxMhpBR4Vu","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"jj1j16owv8n","text":"Shri Mataji emphasised that although Sahaja Yoga improves health, its goal is not to cure but to awaken the kundalini and give people an understanding of spirituality through self-realisation.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"HGAPhVdTW5","type":"media","data":{"id":"cz4d0dmmz1k","poster":{},"items":[{"image":{"id":232,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/232/small_IMG0006a.jpg"},"alt":"Shri Mataji giving a lecture on the subtle system","caption":"","credit":""}],"mediaFiles":[232],"type":"image","quantity":"single","position":"center","size":"narrow","decorations":{}}},{"id":"9VU6PJxAMU","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"gwuufmcmb1n","text":"Dr. Ramesh Manocha, general practitioner and researcher at the Department of Natural Therapy of the Royal Hospital for Women in Sydney, Australia, cites convincing results of the positive influence of Sahaja Yoga Meditation in the treatment and prevention of various disorders, including hypertension, asthma, and ADD. According to Dr. Manocha, the silence of the mind, established during meditation, is associated with a unique character of physiological activity. He notes that among the many methods of meditation and relaxation, meditation by the method of Sahaja Yoga has proved effective in terms of therapeutic treatment.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"6Ola9txD2r","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"2spzejmccz8","text":"In 1996, Shri Mataji founded the Sahaja Yoga International Research Wellness Center in Belapur, near Mumbai, India. The clinic is now accepting patients from all over the world. Diagnosis and treatment involve the use of Sahaja Yoga methods in addition to Ayurvedic medical practices. Compared with traditional Western medicine, the use of meditation in treatment leads to a significant stabilisation of blood pressure, reduction in stress levels, and strengthening of the immune system, and studies of further effects are ongoing.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"mwgNjg0S3Q","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"0a20b5b2e1cea873","text":"Recognition around the world","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"Eckd71eaPD","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"mjpoynue08d","text":"Throughout the 41 years Shri Mataji spent spreading Sahaja Yoga, she received numerous awards, nominations, and accolades from state leaders and notable institutions around the world.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"0nGVmaqjDu","type":"textbox","data":{"id":"i4kl3m115lr","title":"","subtitle":"","caption":"Public speech at the Royal Albert Hall, London, 1997","credit":"Claes Nobel, Grand-Nephew of Alfred Nobel","text":"“A source of hope for humanity”","action":"","url":"","mediaFiles":[],"type":"text","alignment":"center","style":"hero","spacing":"overlap","background":"white","color":"light","position":"left","decorations":{}}},{"id":"pt__s-4Neq","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"5xsnsj28tdv","text":"In 1996, she was nominated for the Nobel Peace Prize, and in 1997 she received personal recognition from Claes Nobel, the grand-nephew of Alfred Nobel. In a public speech at the Royal Albert Hall in London, Nobel spoke with a deep respect for the life and work of Shri Mataji, describing Sahaja Yoga as 'a reference point for determining right from wrong.'","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"lxWVDQNMeH","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"18wjh32vvf1","text":"On bestowing honorary membership of the Petrovskaya Academy of Arts and Science in St Petersburg, a distinction only ever received by 12 people, including Einstein, the institution praised Shri Mataji with the words ‘You are even higher than science.’ It is this profound respect and admiration from representatives of all sectors of society which highlights the value of Shri Mataji’s teachings.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"E_fkWiZZ7z","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"hecf7bvn0v5","text":"Some notable moments in the life of Shri Mataji:","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"s2Yv--q_jJ","type":"layout","data":{"id":"9d0d8a670a94521b","items":[{"title":"Italy, 1986","text":"The Italian government proclaims Shri Mataji as the Personality of the Year."},{"title":"Moscow, Russia, 1989","text":"Succeeding Shri Mataji’s meeting with the Minister for Health of the USSR, Sahaja Yoga receives full government support, including funding of scientific research."},{"title":"St. Petersburg, Russia, 1993","text":"Elected as an honorary member of the Petrovsky Academy of Arts and Science. Shri Mataji opens the International Conference on Medicine and Self-knowledge, which subsequently becomes an annual conference."},{"title":"Brasilia, Brazil, 1994","text":"Shri Mataji is welcomed at the airport by the Mayor of Brasilia, who presents her with the key to the city and sponsors all of her programs."},{"title":"New York, USA, 1994","text":"26th September is declared ‘Shri Mataji Nirmala Devi Day’. Shri Mataji is offered a police escort for a parade in her honour."},{"title":"British Columbia, Canada, 1994","text":"On behalf of the people of Canada, the Premier of the Province of British Columbia, Mr Mike Harcourt, extends a letter of welcome to Shri Mataji."},{"title":"Bucharest, Romania, 1995","text":"Granted an Honorary Doctorate in Cognitive Science by Prof D Drime, head of the Ecological University Bucharest."},{"title":"Beijing, China 1995","text":"The Chinese government invites Shri Mataji to be an official guest speaker at the 4th UN Conference on Women."},{"title":"Pune, India, 1996","text":"Shri Mataji addresses the ‘World Philosophers Meet ‘96 - A Parliament of Science, Religion and Philosophy’, where she is celebrated for the establishment of Sahaja Yoga."},{"title":"USA, 105th Congress, 1997 and 106th Congress, 2000","text":"Honorarium read into the Congressional Record by Congressman Eliot Engle, who commends Shri Mataji for her dedicated and tireless work for humanity."},{"title":"Cabella Ligure, Italy, 2006","text":"The Italian government awards Shri Mataji with honorary citizenship, succeeded by the presentation of the foundation stone for the ‘Shri Mataji Nirmala Devi World Foundation of Sahaja Yoga’ in Cabella Ligure."}],"type":"grid","mediaFiles":[]}},{"id":"FyhA0t79PE","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"6wqw0botj","text":"Her Legacy","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"2DOCcJPuyP","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"wl7gf8v9po","text":"Shri Mataji established kindergartens and schools, medical centers and homes for the disadvantaged, art academies and social projects, but her legacy is something far greater than all of these. No monument or non-governmental organisation can demonstrate the true legacy of Shri Mataji Nirmala Devi, it is above all these things.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"Zfs2xZXDv9","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"xtylm2sudfo","text":"What Shri Mataji has given to our world is not a philosophy, doctrine or concept. It is an extraordinary transformative experience - Self-realisation. Recognition of one's spiritual essence and the power to change our world from the very root of society by starting with the individual is the true legacy of Shri Mataji's life.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"svopMyY5OK","type":"textbox","data":{"id":"az63q3sdsms","title":"","subtitle":"","caption":"","credit":"","text":"\"Prepare them so that they can solve their problems, that's what I should do ... You must be doctors to yourself. You must be a guru to yourself. \"","action":"","url":"","mediaFiles":[],"type":"text","alignment":"center","style":"hero","spacing":"overlap","background":"white","color":"light","position":"left","decorations":{}}},{"id":"g3Ubkfao8J","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"3wg4lye6r81","text":"Her work has led to the creation of a dynamically developing international community, bringing together practitioners of Sahaja Yoga in more than 95 countries. All of them are united by the desire for spiritual transformation and the creation of an opportunity for global change.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"CWTBc2pjL7","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"yicrepepgl","text":"Shri Mataji's vision was not to create any organisations - her message is focused on the person, on the inner \"I\". Shri Mataji noted that only the dedication to universal spiritual values ​​can solve the global problems of mankind. She also insisted on the freedom of the individual: In Sahaja Yoga, there are no dogmas or prescriptions, there is only the inner awareness of what is beneficial for spiritual development.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"c7FBoRbuDr","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"k3nsgy3j7u","text":"By initiating profound personal changes through the awakening of Kundalini and meditation, Shri Mataji taught people how to strive for and achieve higher goals than mere material success or power. \"We must reach peace inside,\" she said.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"M4bP5lG_NE","type":"action","data":{"id":"6fcg40lc5z7","title":"","subtitle":"","text":"","action":"Learn More","url":"https://shrimataji.org","list_id":"","type":"button","form":"signup","spacing":"spaced","decorations":{"leaves":true}}},{"id":"cTN8XPNGs7","type":"media","data":{"id":"voig2omrzlr","poster":{},"items":[{"image":{"id":419,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/419/small_BC084_Belgium_1985_ColinH1.jpg"},"alt":"Shri Mataji in Belgium","caption":"","credit":""}],"mediaFiles":[419],"type":"image","quantity":"single","position":"center","size":"narrow","decorations":{}}}],"version":"2.23.2","markupVersion":3,"mediaFiles":[]}

translations.name: بنیان‌گذار ساهاجایوگا
translations.content: {"time":1618314001680,"blocks":[{"type":"textbox","data":{"id":"d82007b48a6c6d1a","image":{"id":211,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/211/small_founder.jpg"},"title":"بنیانگذار ساهاجایوگا","text":"شری ماتاجی نیرمالا دوی به روشی بینظیر از مدیتیشن پی برد که به آن \"ساهاجایوگا\" می‌گویند. این روش امکان دستیابی به آگاهی درونی را برقرار می سازد و قدرت واقعی بشر را هویدا می‌نماید. شری ماتاجی زندگی خود را سراسر وقف توسعه و انتشار این روش نمود و امروزه صدها هزار نفر در سراسر عالم ساهاجایوگا را انجام می‌دهند.","action":"","url":"","type":"image","background":"white","color":"dark","position":"left","spacing":"overlap","mediaFiles":[211],"decorations":{"sidetext":{"text":"The Founder"},"circle":true}}},{"type":"textbox","data":{"id":"e4f4a9194877fff6","image":{"id":212,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/212/small_master-of-yoga.jpg"},"title":"استاد بزرگ یوگا","text":"شری ماتاجی نشان داد که در هر شخصی، یک انرژی معنوی مادرانه وجود دارد که به آن کندالینی می‌گویند؛ بیدار شدن این کندالینی، ما را به مرتبه مدیتیشن خودبخودی می‌رساند. برخلاف بسیاری از دیگر معلمان کهن که تنها قادر بودند تجربه خود را با تعداد معدودی از افراد به اشتراک گذارند، شری ماتاجی توانست کندالینی هزاران نفر را بیدار کند، کاری که قبلا غیرممکن تلقی می‌شد.  امکان بیدار کردن این انرژی درونی معنوی، ساهاجایوگا را از دیگر روش‌های مدیتیشن متمایز می‌گرداند. این یک تجربه زنده غیرمعمول است که به ما اجازه رسیدن به چنین مرتبه آرامش و رضایت کامل را می‌دهد؛ رسیدن به جوهره واقعی وجود و آشکار شدن بهترین ویژگی‌های واقعی ما.","action":"","url":"","type":"image","background":"image","color":"dark","position":"left","spacing":"overlap","mediaFiles":[212],"decorations":{"triangle":{"alignment":"left"}}}},{"type":"textbox","data":{"id":"e20aeb9d32494d79","image":{"id":214,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/214/small_social-work.jpg"},"title":"A life dedicated to humanity","text":"Shri Mataji not only founded and spread the method of Sahaja Yoga far across the world but also created many non-profit organizations in various fields of public life.\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003eFrom a centre for destitute women and orphans, international schools with comprehensive and balanced curiculum, health centres using the methods of Sahaja Yoga to academies teaching classical arts - the list of Shri Mataji’s achievements is striking in its diversity.","action":"","url":"","type":"image","background":"white","color":"dark","position":"left","spacing":"overlap","mediaFiles":[214],"decorations":{"sidetext":{"text":"Social Work"},"gradient":{"alignment":"right","color":"blue"}}}},{"type":"textbox","data":{"id":"73c46d073db8a0d5","image":{"id":215,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/215/small_family.jpg"},"title":"Life among great people","text":"Since birth Shri Mataji was surrounded by exceptional people. Her parents were scholars and political activists who played an important role in the liberation movement of India. They sought the independence of their country together with Mahatma Gandhi, who noticed the extraordinary potential of the young Shri Mataji and consulted her on spiritual matters.\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003eThroughout her life, Shri Mataji was often in the circles of prominent political and public figures. Her husband, Sir Chandrika Prasad Srivastava, started as a young officer in the Indian Civil Service and rose through the ranks becoming Private Secretary to the Prime Minister of India, Lal Bahadur Shastri. He was later appointed Secretary-General of the United Nations International Maritime Organisation in London and served in this post for four successive terms. His relentless dedication to public service and exceptional achievements awarded him a knighthood by Queen Elizabeth II. He was the first Indian to receive such honour after India gained independence.","action":"","url":"","type":"image","background":"white","color":"dark","position":"right","spacing":"overlap","mediaFiles":[215],"decorations":{"sidetext":{"text":"Family"}}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"5ffb8c84bfbc2d6b","text":"Early Years","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"26da9f96c664d768","text":"Shri Mataji was born as Nirmala Salve on the 21st of March 1923, in Chindwara, India. Her family descended from the royal Shalivahana dynasty, and she was raised Christian following her forefathers’ decision to convert from Hinduism, in light of the cruel treatment of widowed women. Shri Mataji's father was a lawyer and scientist, fluent in 14 languages ​​and famous for translating the Qur'an into Hindi, and her mother was the first woman in India to receive an honors degree in mathematics.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"1859b545171f08f0","text":"Shri Mataji's parents also actively participated in the struggle for India's independence from British occupation and were both jailed several times for their involvement. As a child, Shri Mataji often visited the ashram of Mahatma Gandhi, discussing with him the means to bring about social and spiritual liberation. In 1942, Shri Mataji, as a teenager, was detained and tortured by British soldiers for participating in the liberation movement. This was, however, considered a necessary sacrifice - so strong was the conviction that the internal liberation of people could come only after the country's liberation from foreign rule.","type":"text"}},{"type":"media","data":{"id":"16342ec19c541dbe","items":[{"image":{"id":216,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/216/small_early-years.jpg"},"alt":"Young Shri Mataji with her family","caption":"Shri Mataji with family, second from the left, middle row. In the middle - Shri Mataji’s parents.","credit":""}],"type":"image","quantity":"single","position":"center","size":"normal","mediaFiles":[216],"decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"b5b6ad72a0dd827e","text":"In 1947, Shri Mataji married a young political figure, Chandrika Prasad, later known as Sir CP, with whom she had two daughters. Shri Mataji was a housewife and raised the daughters as Sir CP helped develop the newly liberated country, moving up the political ladder and serving in various posts in the state hierarchy. However, Shri Mataji always remembered her true destiny - the search of a method for the spiritual enlightenment of humanity.","type":"text"}},{"type":"textbox","data":{"id":"f6faa449f5037ae7","text":"When are you finally going to start your spiritual work? Now you are free, and you have to start.","credit":"Mahatma Gandhi","caption":"in a conversation with Shri Mataji, the day before he was assasinated","type":"text","style":"hero","alignment":"center","decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"4a173ab985b71356","text":"The founding of ‘Sahaja Yoga’","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"e64ad489f0e38c7c","text":"Shri Mataji always knew that the meaning of her life was to find a way to teach the truth of meditation to as many people as possible. She knew that only through the inner transformation of every person can the whole of society become harmonious.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"726dde74d63d9378","text":"She also saw how many people try to learn the truth, and how many so-called \"gurus\" use this pure impulse for their enrichment. After attending a lecture of one of such pseudo-teachers, she saw how he manipulated people and was disgusted by this attitude. Shri Mataji spent the whole of that night on a beach in Nargol, West India, contemplating this dilemma. She knew that for people to reach a higher awareness of themselves they must be able to go beyond their minds and be connected to their subtle being.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"v389vjf7w6","text":"Deep in meditation, she felt her Kundalini rise within her, moving along her spine through all her chakras until it pierced the final chakra, the Sahasrara,  at the top of her head. At that moment she was brought into a state of total serenity and knew that this was the answer to what so many were searching for. Thus on the 5th of May 1970, she discovered the method to achieve the state of meditation, which she later called \"Sahaja Yoga,\" which in Sanskrit means \"spontaneous union.\"","type":"text"}},{"type":"textbox","data":{"id":"hsujh51bf5n","text":"“I saw the whole thing open and a big  torrential rain of breeze started flowing through my head all over, as if, and I felt 'I am lost now, I am no more there. It's only the grace is there, that is there'.  I saw it completely happening to me.\"","credit":"Shri Mataji Nirmala Devi","caption":"Vienna, 1986","type":"text","style":"hero","alignment":"center","decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"f4d3d6cddec0a32e","text":"From Nirmala to ‘Shri Mataji’","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"9d6c1bc696018578","text":"Soon Shri Mataji began to teach this new method to a few close individuals in India, awakening their Kundalinis to give them ‘Self-Realisation’. This was a difficult process; since ancient times, through years of dedication and labour, only the most worthy yogis had managed to achieve such awakening.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"4340f3ee54b7a0f7","text":"However, the presence of Shri Mataji and her patient work on people seemed to be the catalyst for this process. All of her students reached this state of inner freedom and lightness, and also felt a cool breeze on the palms and above the head. It is because of the effect of Shri Mataji's presence and her tirelessly loving and selfless work on people that her students gave her the name Shri Mataji, which literally means \"respected holy mother.”","type":"text"}},{"type":"textbox","data":{"id":"896211ff5572d869","image":{"id":220,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/220/small_ShriMataji_18.jpg"},"title":"Sharing the experience","text":"The method of meditation discovered by Shri Mataji began to spread around the world after she and her family moved to London, starting with her first students whom Shri Mataji sheltered in her home in London. She gave them their Self Realisation, taught them the basics of meditation, and gradually rebuilt their shattered subtle bodies.\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003eBefore long she was giving television and radio interviews, and holding lectures in public halls across the country. Afterwards, she would always spend a lot of time giving individual attention to the audience and patiently answering their questions. Shri Mataji never charged any money for these lectures, nor the experience of Self Realisation, insisting that it is the birthright of every individual.","action":"","url":"","type":"image","background":"white","color":"dark","position":"left","spacing":"overlap","mediaFiles":[220],"decorations":{"sidetext":{"text":"Spreading the Word"},"gradient":{"alignment":"right","color":"blue"}}}},{"type":"textbox","data":{"id":"4f0749860c6b17ef","image":{"id":218,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/218/small_vision.jpg"},"title":"The global vision","text":"From the 1980s onwards, Shri Mataji began to travel the world to bring her knowledge to all who wished to receive it. Starting with Europe, North America, and Australia, and later moving on to South America, Asia, and the Pacific region, she tirelessly taught Sahaja Yoga to all who were interested.\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003eIn 1990 alone, Shri Mataji attended more than 200 official events in 26 countries and had many more informal meetings in between. Whether it was a speech in the main hall of a capital city or an informal conversation in a villager’s home, every talk and experience was of equal importance to her.\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003eHer vision was global, and, traveling and meeting people around the world, she sought to realise it. This vision was to change the world for the better, giving each person, regardless of race, religion, or circumstance, a method by which they could achieve inner transformation and become their true selves.","action":"","url":"","type":"image","background":"white","color":"dark","position":"right","spacing":"overlap","mediaFiles":[218],"decorations":{"sidetext":{"text":"Vision"},"triangle":{"alignment":"left"}}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"s7sm8pmjt0o","text":"Inner development as the foundation of a healthy society","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"oiq2bydz29k","text":"Shri Mataji, in her lectures and conversations, paid attention to many aspects of a person's life, saying that the inner state enlightened by the practice of meditation must find an outward manifestation in all spheres of human life.","type":"text"}},{"type":"textbox","data":{"id":"v9z84p7xdy","image":{"id":223,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/223/small_IMG_6200.jpg"},"title":"Enlightened Education","text":"Shri Mataji paid special attention to the creation of a solid foundation for the development of the individual, thereby emphasising the importance of preschool education. She noted that education should not only ensure the intellectual and emotional development of children but also lay the foundations of morality and spirituality.\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003eTo form the worthy behaviour of children and a sense of self-respect, Shri Mataji attached great importance to discipline based on love and respect. \"It is our duty to see that our children are growing into great people. Greater than ourselves,\" said Shri Mataji. \"They must take care of this world.\"\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003eRealising her vision in practice, Shri Mataji created an education system based on Sahaja Yoga. The training involves mastering a complex curriculum and regular meditation classes. Meditation helps students improve their attention and motivation, and develops a sense of self-confidence, allowing them to understand themselves and establish harmony within. \u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003eYoung people from different countries successfully receive a decent education and build up harmonious relationships based on empathy and collectivity, in schools organised by Shri Mataji in India, Italy, Canada, Austria, the US, the Czech Republic, and Australia.\u003cbr\u003e","action":"","url":"","type":"image","background":"white","color":"dark","position":"left","spacing":"overlap","mediaFiles":[223],"decorations":{"circle":false,"gradient":{"alignment":"right","color":"blue"},"sidetext":{"text":"Education"}}}},{"type":"textbox","data":{"id":"6mxb05rf9w7","image":{"id":230,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/230/small_PhotoSM-150.jpg"},"title":"Pure Creativity","text":"Throughout her life, Shri Mataji devoted much time and energy to the development of the arts. She saw art not only as one of the main means of self-expression but also as a way of supporting world cultures. In particular, Shri Mataji sought to preserve the rich artistic traditions of India, rooted in antiquity, and she actively promoted the dissemination of the cultural heritage of India around the world.\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003eIn 2003, Shri Mataji together with her brother founded an Academy of Arts in Maharashtra (India). Students from different countries come to the academy to study Indian classical music, dance, and painting in a quiet Indian village. Shri Mataji personally supervised the architectural project of the Academy building, as well as the creation of other institutions with humanitarian goals. One such project is the Nirmala Prem Center in Delhi (India) for orphans.\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003eOver the years, Shri Mataji has patronised some of the most famous representatives of classical Indian music and dance, inviting them to perform at various concerts and programs. Those performers who have performed in her presence describe this experience as a turning point in their creative path. Many noted that Shri Mataji's strong creative energy greatly inspired them to deepen the mastery of their skill and to realise their full potential.\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003eShri Mataji's efforts in the development of the arts included active support of theatre. She inspired a group of talented actors to unite and create the \"Theatre of Eternal Values.\" Formed in 1996 in Ghent, Belgium, TEV continues to tour around the world, performing original productions that touch on the themes of spirituality, self-development, and awareness, by writers such as William Blake, Shakespeare, and Leo Tolstoy.\u003cbr\u003e","action":"","url":"","type":"image","background":"white","color":"dark","position":"right","spacing":"overlap","mediaFiles":[230],"decorations":{"sidetext":{"text":"The Arts"},"triangle":{"alignment":"left"}}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"x9e0wfd2mmi","text":"Holistic approach to health","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"ah06fh9onsu","text":"Shri Mataji studied medicine for several years until the political events connected with the independence movement of India forced her to leave school. Being brought up in a tradition that recognised the connection between spirituality and health, Shri Mataji devoted herself to studying meditation and observing how it affects the mind and physical body of a person.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"5t121rat8pg","text":"During the study of meditation, Shri Mataji learned about the subtle energy system of the chakras (nerve plexuses) and channels (sympathetic and parasympathetic nervous systems). This subtle system determines our physical, mental and emotional state. Shri Mataji also knew of a nourishing female inner energy, known as ‘Kundalini’ in the ancient Indian writings. She studied human behaviour and its influence on this energy and subtle system. She saw how unbalanced behaviour could lead to physical, mental and emotional extremes, which in turn leads to a deterioration in health, but that the Kundalini can restore balance .","type":"text"}},{"type":"textbox","data":{"id":"pd5ey9ut9fo","text":"\"This Kundalini, when She passes through  these six centers, She   enlightens those centers, nourishes those  centers and integrates them -   so in totality you are all right. It's  not like, that one part of the   body is treated, another part is  neglected - in totality, in the whole   balance. And She puts you in the  central path of balance.\"","credit":"","caption":"","type":"text","style":"hero","alignment":"center","decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"jj1j16owv8n","text":"Shri Mataji emphasised that although Sahaja Yoga improves health, its goal is not to cure but to awaken the kundalini and give people an understanding of spirituality through self-realisation.","type":"text"}},{"type":"media","data":{"id":"cz4d0dmmz1k","items":[{"image":{"id":232,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/232/small_IMG0006a.jpg"},"alt":"Shri Mataji giving a lecture on the subtle system","caption":"","credit":""}],"type":"image","quantity":"single","position":"center","size":"normal","mediaFiles":[232],"decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"gwuufmcmb1n","text":"Dr. Ramesh Manocha, general practitioner and researcher at the Department of Natural Therapy of the Royal Hospital for Women in Sydney, Australia, cites convincing results of the positive influence of Sahaja Yoga Meditation in the treatment and prevention of various disorders, including hypertension, asthma, and ADD. According to Dr. Manocha, the silence of the mind, established during meditation, is associated with a unique character of physiological activity. He notes that among the many methods of meditation and relaxation, meditation by the method of Sahaja Yoga has proved effective in terms of therapeutic treatment.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"2spzejmccz8","text":"In 1996, Shri Mataji founded the Sahaja Yoga International Research Wellness Center in Belapur, near Mumbai, India. The clinic is now accepting patients from all over the world. Diagnosis and treatment involve the use of Sahaja Yoga methods in addition to Ayurvedic medical practices. Compared with traditional Western medicine, the use of meditation in treatment leads to a significant stabilisation of blood pressure, reduction in stress levels, and strengthening of the immune system, and studies of further effects are ongoing.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"0a20b5b2e1cea873","text":"Recognition around the world","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"mjpoynue08d","text":"Throughout the 41 years Shri Mataji spent spreading Sahaja Yoga, she received numerous awards, nominations, and accolades from state leaders and notable institutions around the world.","type":"text"}},{"type":"textbox","data":{"id":"i4kl3m115lr","text":"“A source of hope for humanity”","credit":"Claes Nobel, Grand-Nephew of Alfred Nobel","caption":"Public speech at the Royal Albert Hall, London, 1997","type":"text","style":"hero","alignment":"center","decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"5xsnsj28tdv","text":"In 1996, she was nominated for the Nobel Peace Prize, and in 1997 she received personal recognition from Claes Nobel, the grand-nephew of Alfred Nobel. In a public speech at the Royal Albert Hall in London, Nobel spoke with a deep respect for the life and work of Shri Mataji, describing Sahaja Yoga as 'a reference point for determining right from wrong.'","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"18wjh32vvf1","text":"On bestowing honorary membership of the Petrovskaya Academy of Arts and Science in St Petersburg, a distinction only ever received by 12 people, including Einstein, the institution praised Shri Mataji with the words ‘You are even higher than science.’ It is this profound respect and admiration from representatives of all sectors of society which highlights the value of Shri Mataji’s teachings.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"hecf7bvn0v5","text":"Some notable moments in the life of Shri Mataji:","type":"text"}},{"type":"layout","data":{"id":"9d0d8a670a94521b","items":[{"title":"Italy, 1986","text":"The Italian government proclaims Shri Mataji as the Personality of the Year."},{"title":"Moscow, Russia, 1989","text":"Succeeding Shri Mataji’s meeting with the Minister for Health of the USSR, Sahaja Yoga receives full government support, including funding of scientific research."},{"title":"St. Petersburg, Russia, 1993","text":"Elected as an honorary member of the Petrovsky Academy of Arts and Science. Shri Mataji opens the International Conference on Medicine and Self-knowledge, which subsequently becomes an annual conference."},{"title":"Brasilia, Brazil, 1994","text":"Shri Mataji is welcomed at the airport by the Mayor of Brasilia, who presents her with the key to the city and sponsors all of her programs.\u003cbr\u003e"},{"title":"New York, USA, 1994","text":"26th September is declared ‘Shri Mataji Nirmala Devi Day’. Shri Mataji is offered a police escort for a parade in her honour."},{"title":"British Columbia, Canada, 1994","text":"On behalf of the people of Canada, the Premier of the Province of British Columbia, Mr Mike Harcourt, extends a letter of welcome to Shri Mataji."},{"title":"Bucharest, Romania, 1995","text":"Granted an Honorary Doctorate in Cognitive Science by Prof D Drime, head of the Ecological University Bucharest."},{"title":"Beijing, China 1995","text":"The Chinese government invites Shri Mataji to be an official guest speaker at the 4th UN Conference on Women."},{"title":"Pune, India, 1996","text":"Shri Mataji addresses the ‘World Philosophers Meet ‘96 - A Parliament of Science, Religion and Philosophy’, where she is celebrated for the establishment of Sahaja Yoga."},{"title":"USA, 105th Congress, 1997 and 106th Congress, 2000","text":"Honorarium read into the Congressional Record by Congressman Eliot Engle, who commends Shri Mataji for her dedicated and tireless work for humanity.\u003cbr\u003e"},{"title":"Cabella Ligure, Italy, 2006","text":"The Italian government awards Shri Mataji with honorary citizenship, succeeded by the presentation of the foundation stone for the ‘Shri Mataji Nirmala Devi World Foundation of Sahaja Yoga’ in Cabella Ligure."}],"type":"grid","mediaFiles":[]}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"6wqw0botj","text":"Her Legacy","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"wl7gf8v9po","text":"Shri Mataji established kindergartens and schools, medical centers and homes for the disadvantaged, art academies and social projects, but her legacy is something far greater than all of these. No monument or non-governmental organisation can demonstrate the true legacy of Shri Mataji Nirmala Devi, it is above all these things.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"xtylm2sudfo","text":"What Shri Mataji has given to our world is not a philosophy, doctrine or concept. It is an extraordinary transformative experience - Self-realisation. Recognition of one's spiritual essence and the power to change our world from the very root of society by starting with the individual is the true legacy of Shri Mataji's life.","type":"text"}},{"type":"textbox","data":{"id":"az63q3sdsms","text":"\"Prepare them so that they can solve their problems, that's what I should do ... You must be doctors to yourself. You must be a guru to yourself. \"","credit":"","caption":"","type":"text","style":"hero","alignment":"center","decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"3wg4lye6r81","text":"Her work has led to the creation of a dynamically developing international community, bringing together practitioners of Sahaja Yoga in more than 95 countries. All of them are united by the desire for spiritual transformation and the creation of an opportunity for global change.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"yicrepepgl","text":"Shri Mataji's vision was not to create any organisations - her message is focused on the person, on the inner \"I\". Shri Mataji noted that only the dedication to universal spiritual values ​​can solve the global problems of mankind. She also insisted on the freedom of the individual: In Sahaja Yoga, there are no dogmas or prescriptions, there is only the inner awareness of what is beneficial for spiritual development.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"k3nsgy3j7u","text":"By initiating profound personal changes through the awakening of Kundalini and meditation, Shri Mataji taught people how to strive for and achieve higher goals than mere material success or power. \"We must reach peace inside,\" she said.","type":"text"}},{"type":"media","data":{"id":"voig2omrzlr","items":[{"image":{"id":419,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/419/small_BC084_Belgium_1985_ColinH1.jpg"},"alt":"Shri Mataji in Belgium","caption":"","credit":""}],"type":"image","quantity":"single","position":"center","size":"normal","mediaFiles":[419],"decorations":{}}}],"version":"2.16.0","media_files":[],"markupVersion":3}

translations.name: Shri Mataji
translations.content: {"time":1591958741717,"blocks":[{"type":"textbox","data":{"id":"d82007b48a6c6d1a","image":{"id":211,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/211/small_founder.jpg"},"title":"Fondatrice de Sahaja Yoga","text":"Shri Mataji Nirmala Devi a découvert une méthode unique de méditation appelée \"Sahaja Yoga\" qui permet la réalisation de l'illumination intérieure et révèle le vrai potentiel de l'humanité. Shri Mataji a consacré toute sa vie au développement et à la diffusion de cette méthode, et aujourd'hui, dans le monde entier, des centaines de milliers de personnes pratiquent Sahaja Yoga.","action":"","url":"","type":"image","background":"white","color":"dark","position":"left","spacing":"overlap","mediaFiles":[211],"decorations":{"sidetext":{"text":"La fondatrice"},"circle":true}}},{"type":"textbox","data":{"id":"e4f4a9194877fff6","image":{"id":212,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/212/small_master-of-yoga.jpg"},"title":"Une Grande Professeure de Yoga","text":"Shri Mataji a montré qu'il y a une énergie spirituelle maternelle appelée Kundalini en chacun de nous, dont l'éveil conduit à un état de méditation spontanée. Contrairement à de nombreux professeurs qui jadis ne pouvaient partager cette expérience qu'avec quelques personnes, Shri Mataji a pu élever la Kundalini  de milliers de personnes en même temps, ce qui était considéré auparavant comme impossible.\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003eLa possibilité d'éveiller cette énergie spirituelle intérieure distingue Sahaja Yoga des autres méthodes de méditation. C'est une expérience extraordinaire et vive qui nous permet d'atteindre un état de paix et de satisfaction, de toucher l'essence même de nos êtres et de découvrir nos plus belles qualités.","action":"","url":"","type":"image","background":"image","color":"dark","position":"left","spacing":"overlap","mediaFiles":[212],"decorations":{"triangle":{"alignment":"left"}}}},{"type":"textbox","data":{"id":"e20aeb9d32494d79","image":{"id":214,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/214/small_social-work.jpg"},"title":"Une Vie Dévouée à l'Humanité","text":"Shri Mataji n’a pas seulement fondé et diffusé la méthode de Sahaja Yoga dans le monde entier. Elle a aussi créé de nombreuses organisations à but non lucratif dans divers domaines de la vie publique.\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003eQu'il s'agisse d'un centre pour femmes et orphelins démunis, d'écoles internationales avec un programme d'études complet et équilibré, de centres de santé utilisant les méthodes de Sahaja Yoga à des académies d'enseignement des arts classiques, les accomplissements de Shri Mataji frappent par leur diversité.","action":"","url":"","type":"image","background":"white","color":"dark","position":"left","spacing":"overlap","mediaFiles":[214],"decorations":{"sidetext":{"text":"Travail social"},"gradient":{"alignment":"right","color":"blue"}}}},{"type":"textbox","data":{"id":"73c46d073db8a0d5","image":{"id":215,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/215/small_family.jpg"},"title":"La Vie parmi des Personnalités Hors Normes","text":"Shri Mataji a toujours été entourée de personnes exceptionnelles. Ses parents étaient des universitaires et des militants politiques qui ont joué un rôle important dans le mouvement de libération de l'Inde. Ils ont cherché l'indépendance de leur pays auprès du  Mahatma Gandhi, qui avait remarqué l'extraordinaire potentiel de la jeune Shri Mataji et l'avait consultée sur des questions spirituelles.\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003eTout au long de sa vie, Shri Mataji  a souvent fait partie des cercles de personnalités politiques et publiques éminentes par le métier de son mari. Sir Chandrika Prasad Srivastava, a commencé en tant que jeune officier de la fonction publique indienne et a gravi les échelons pour devenir secrétaire privé du Premier ministre indien, Lal Bahadur Shastri. Il a ensuite été nommé Secrétaire général de l'Organisation maritime internationale des Nations Unies à Londres et a occupé ce poste pendant quatre mandats successifs. Son dévouement sans faille à la fonction publique et ses réalisations exceptionnelles lui ont valu la chevalerie de la reine Elizabeth II. Il a été le premier Indien à recevoir un tel honneur après l'indépendance de l'Inde.","action":"","url":"","type":"image","background":"white","color":"dark","position":"right","spacing":"overlap","mediaFiles":[215],"decorations":{"sidetext":{"text":"La Famille"}}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"5ffb8c84bfbc2d6b","text":"Les Premières Années","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"26da9f96c664d768","text":"Shri Mataji est né le 21 mars 1923 à Chindwara, en Inde, sous le nom de Nirmala Salve au sein d'une famille vraiment exceptionnelle. Issue de la dynastie royale indienne des Shalivahana, elle a grandi dans la religion chrétienne suite à la décision de ses ancêtres d'abandonner l'hindouisme, compte tenu du traitement cruel que cette religion infligeait aux veuves. Ses parents étaient très instruits ; son père était un avocat et un scientifique, parlant couramment 14 langues, célèbre pour avoir traduit le Coran en hindi, et sa mère a été la première femme en Inde à être diplômée en mathématiques.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"1859b545171f08f0","text":"Ses parents ont aussi participé activement à la lutte de l'Inde pour son indépendance de l'occupation britannique, et tous deux ont été emprisonnés à plusieurs reprises pour cela. Shri Mataji elle-même a souvent visité l'ashram du Mahatma Gandhi lorsqu'elle était enfant, discutant avec lui des stratégies pour amener son pays à la libération sociale et spirituelle. En 1942, Shri Mataji, alors adolescente, a même été détenue et torturée par des soldats britanniques pour avoir participé au mouvement de libération. Cependant, cela était considéré comme un sacrifice nécessaire - tant était grande la conviction que la libération intérieure des gens ne pouvait venir qu'après la libération du pays de la domination étrangère.","type":"text"}},{"type":"media","data":{"id":"16342ec19c541dbe","items":[{"image":{"id":216,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/216/small_early-years.jpg"},"alt":"La jeune Shri Mataji avec sa famille","caption":"Shri Mataji avec sa famile, elle est la deuxième en partant de la gauche - au milieu, ses parents.","credit":""}],"type":"image","quantity":"single","position":"center","size":"normal","mediaFiles":[216],"decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"b5b6ad72a0dd827e","text":"En 1947, Shri Mataji  a épousé un jeune cadre de l’administration indienne, Chandrika Prasad, plus tard connue sous le nom de Sir C.P. Ils ont eu deux filles. Shri Mataji était femme au foyer et a élevé ses filles alors que Sir CP aidait à développer le pays nouvellement libéré, gravissant les échelons politiques et occupant divers postes dans la hiérarchie de l'État. Cependant, Shri Mataji s'est toujours souvenue de son vrai destin - la recherche d'une méthode pour l'illumination spirituelle de l'humanité.","type":"text"}},{"type":"textbox","data":{"id":"f6faa449f5037ae7","text":"Quand vas-tu enfin commencer ton travail spirituel? Maintenant que tu es libre, tu devrais commencer.commencer.","credit":"Le Mahatma Gandhi","caption":"en conversation avec Shri Mataji la veille de son assassinat","type":"text","style":"hero","alignment":"center","decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"4a173ab985b71356","text":"Les Fondations de ‘Sahaja Yoga’","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"e64ad489f0e38c7c","text":"Shri Mataji Shri Mataji a toujours su que le sens de sa vie était de trouver un moyen d'enseigner la vérité de la méditation au plus grand nombre possible. Elle savait que seule la transformation intérieure de chacun permettra à l'ensemble de la société de changer.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"726dde74d63d9378","text":"Elle a également vu combien de personnes essaient d'apprendre la vérité et combien de soi-disant \"gourous\" ont utilisé cette impulsion pure pour leur enrichissement personnel. Après avoir assisté à une conférence d'un de ces pseudo-enseignants, elle a vu comment il manipulait les gens et en a été dégoûtée. Shri Mataji a passé toute la nuit sur une plage de Nargol, dans l'ouest de l'Inde, à contempler ce dilemme. Elle savait que pour avoir une conscience plus élevée d'eux-mêmes, les gens devaient pouvoir dépasser leur mental et se connecter à leur être subtil.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"v389vjf7w6","text":"Pgée dans une profondément méditation, elle a senti sa propre Kundalini s'élever le long de sa colonne vertébrale, traverser tous ses chakras jusqu'à percer le dernier, le Sahasrara, au sommet de sa tête. À ce moment, elle a connu un état de sérénité totale et a su que c'était la réponse à ce que tant de personnes recherchaient. Ainsi, le 5 mai 1970, elle a découvert la méthode pour atteindre l'état de méditation, qu'elle a appelé plus tard Sahaja Yoga, qui en sanskrit signifie \"union spontanée.\"","type":"text"}},{"type":"textbox","data":{"id":"hsujh51bf5n","text":"“J'ai vu le tout s'ouvrir et une pluie torrentielle de brise fraîche a commencé à s’écouler de ma tête partout... et j'ai senti que j’étais perdu maintenant. Je n'existais plus. Il n’y avait que la Grâce qui est là, qui était là. J'ai vu cela m’arriver complètement.\"","credit":"","caption":"","type":"text","style":"hero","alignment":"center","decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"f4d3d6cddec0a32e","text":"De Nirmala à ‘Shri Mataji’","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"9d6c1bc696018578","text":"Bientôt, Shri Mataji a commencé à enseigner cette nouvelle méthode à quelques-uns en Inde, éveillant leur Kundalini pour leur donner une Réalisation du Soi. Depuis les temps anciens, après des années de dévouement et de travail, seuls quelques Yogis avaient réussi à atteindre un tel éveil.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"4340f3ee54b7a0f7","text":"Cependant, Shri Mataji a permis à ses premiers élèves de ressentir une brise fraîche sur les paumes et au-dessus de la tête. Ils lui ont donné le nom de Shri Mataji, ce qui signifie littéralement ”sainte mère respectée.”","type":"text"}},{"type":"textbox","data":{"id":"896211ff5572d869","image":{"id":220,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/220/small_ShriMataji_18.jpg"},"title":"Partager l'Expérience","text":"La méthode de méditation découverte par Shri Mataji a vraiment commencé quand elle et sa famille se sont installées à Londres. Ses premiers étudiants étaient hébergés chez elle à Londres. Elle leur a donné leur Réalisation du Soi, leur a enseigné les bases de la méditation et a progressivement reconstruit leurs corps subtils endommagés.\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003ePeu de temps après, elle donnait des interviews à la télévision et à la radio et tenait des conférences dans des salles publiques à travers le pays. Elle a toujours passé beaucoup de temps à répondre patiemment aux questions individuelles. Shri Mataji n'a jamais pris d'argent pour ces conférences en insistant sur le fait que c'est le droit de chaque individu d’accéder à sa propre liberté intérieure.","action":"","url":"","type":"image","background":"white","color":"dark","position":"left","spacing":"overlap","mediaFiles":[220],"decorations":{"sidetext":{"text":"TRANSMETTRE"},"gradient":{"alignment":"right","color":"blue"}}}},{"type":"textbox","data":{"id":"4f0749860c6b17ef","image":{"id":218,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/218/small_vision.jpg"},"title":"Une Vision Globale","text":"À partir des années 1980, Shri Mataji a commencé à parcourir le monde pour apporter ses connaissances à tous ceux qui souhaitaient les recevoir. En commençant par l'Europe, l'Amérique du Nord et l'Australie, puis en Amérique du Sud, en Asie et dans la région du Pacifique.\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003eRien qu'en 1990, Shri Mataji a assisté à plus de 200 événements officiels dans 26 pays et a eu beaucoup plus de réunions informelles entre les deux. Qu'il s'agisse d'un discours dans le hall principal d'une capitale ou d'une conversation informelle dans la maison d'un villageois, chaque conversation et expérience était d'égale importance pour elle.\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003eSa vision était globale. Elle a cherché à rencontrer tous ceux qui voulaient évoluer, en donnant à chaque personne, sans distinction de race, de religion ou de circonstance, une méthode par laquelle elle pourrait réaliser une transformation intérieure et trouver sa vraie personnalité.","action":"","url":"","type":"image","background":"white","color":"dark","position":"right","spacing":"overlap","mediaFiles":[218],"decorations":{"sidetext":{"text":"La Vision"},"triangle":{"alignment":"left"}}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"s7sm8pmjt0o","text":"Le Développement Intérieur comme Fondement d'une Société Saine","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"oiq2bydz29k","text":"Shri Mataji, dans ses conférences et conversations, a prêté attention à de nombreux aspects de la vie d'une personne, affirmant que l'état intérieur éclairé par la pratique de la méditation doit trouver une manifestation extérieure dans toutes les sphères de la vie humaine.","type":"text"}},{"type":"textbox","data":{"id":"v9z84p7xdy","image":{"id":223,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/223/small_IMG_6200.jpg"},"title":"Éducation Éclairée","text":"Shri Mataji a accordé une attention particulière à la création d'une base solide pour le développement de l'individu, soulignant ainsi l'importance de l'éducation préscolaire. Elle a noté que l'éducation ne devait pas seulement assurer le développement intellectuel et affectif des enfants mais aussi jeter les bases de la moralité et de la spiritualité.\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003ePour former les enfants en développant l’estime de soi, Shri Mataji attachait une grande importance à la discipline basée sur l'amour et le respect. \"Il est de notre devoir de voir que nos enfants deviennent des gens formidables. Plus grands que nous\", a déclaré Shri Mataji. \"Ils doivent prendre soin de ce monde.\".\"\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003eShri Mataji a proposé d’intégrer la méditation Sahaja Yoga au système éducatif. Au sein d’un programme d'études complexe, on trouve des moments pour des séances de méditation réguliers. La méditation aide les élèves à améliorer leur attention et leur concentration, et développe un sentiment de confiance en soi, en établir une harmonie intérieure et vis à vis des autres. \u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003eLes jeunes de différents pays reçoivent avec succès une éducation décente et établissent des relations harmonieuses basées sur l'empathie et la collectivité, dans des écoles organisées par Shri Mataji en Inde, en Italie, au Canada, en Autriche, aux États-Unis, en République tchèque et en Australie.\u003cbr\u003e","action":"","url":"","type":"image","background":"white","color":"dark","position":"left","spacing":"overlap","mediaFiles":[223],"decorations":{"circle":false,"gradient":{"alignment":"right","color":"blue"},"sidetext":{"text":"Éducation"}}}},{"type":"textbox","data":{"id":"6mxb05rf9w7","image":{"id":230,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/230/small_PhotoSM-150.jpg"},"title":"Pure Créativité","text":"Tout au long de sa vie, Shri Mataji a consacré beaucoup de temps et d'énergie au développement des arts. Elle considérait l'art comme l'un des moyens d'expression les plus beaux mais aussi comme un moyen de soutenir les cultures du monde. En particulier, Shri Mataji a cherché à préserver les riches traditions artistiques de l'Inded.\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003eEn 2003, Shri Mataji et son frère ont fondé une Académie des Arts au Maharashtra en Inde. Des étudiants de différents pays sont venus à l'académie pour étudier la musique classique indienne, la danse et la peinture dans un paisible village indien. Shri Mataji a personnellement supervisé le projet architectural du bâtiment de l'Académie.\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003eAu fil des ans, Shri Mataji a parrainé certains des plus célèbres représentants de la musique et de la danse indiennes classiques, les invitant à se produire à divers concerts et programmes. Les interprètes qui ont joué en sa présence décrivent cette expérience comme un tournant dans leur chemin artistique. Beaucoup ont noté que la forte énergie créative de Shri Mataji les avait grandement inspirés à approfondir la maîtrise de leurs compétences et à réaliser leur plein potentiel.\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003eLes efforts de Shri Mataji dans le développement des arts comprenaient un soutien actif au théâtre. Elle a inspiré un groupe d'acteurs talentueux à créer le «Théâtre des valeurs éternelles». Formé en 1996 à Gand, en Belgique, le TEV continue tourner des productions originales qui abordent les thèmes de la spiritualité et de la sensibilisation, développés par des écrivains tels que William Blake, Shakespeare et Léon Tolstoï.\u003cbr\u003e","action":"","url":"","type":"image","background":"white","color":"dark","position":"right","spacing":"overlap","mediaFiles":[230],"decorations":{"sidetext":{"text":"Les arts"},"triangle":{"alignment":"left"}}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"x9e0wfd2mmi","text":"Approche Holistique de la Santé","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"ah06fh9onsu","text":"Shri Mataji a étudié la médecine pendant plusieurs années jusqu'à ce que les émeutes liées à la partition de l’Inde la forcent à quitter l'école en urgence. Élevée dans une tradition qui reconnaissait le lien entre la spiritualité et la santé, Shri Mataji s'est consacrée à étudier la méditation et à observer comment elle agit sur une personne aux niveaux mental et physique.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"5t121rat8pg","text":"Shri Mataji a observé le comportement humain et son influence sur le système subtil - des chakras (plexus nerveux) et des canaux (systèmes nerveux sympathiques et parasympathiques). Elle a vu comment un comportement extrême au niveau physique, mental et émotionnel, pouvait conduire à une détérioration de la santé. Elle savait qu’une énergie féminine, appelée \"Kundalini\" dans les anciens écrits indiens, pouvait apporter un équilibre à cet état physique et émotionnel. Et elle a trouvé un moyen d'éveiller cette énergie féminine nourrissante chez tous.","type":"text"}},{"type":"textbox","data":{"id":"pd5ey9ut9fo","text":"\"Cette Kundalini, quand elle passe par ces six centres, illumine ces centres, les nourrit et les intègre - donc vous êtes totalement bien. Ce n'est pas comme si une partie du corps était traitée, une autre partie était négligée - en totalité, avec un équilibre total. Et elle vous met sur le chemin central de l'équilibre.\"","credit":"","caption":"","type":"text","style":"hero","alignment":"center","decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"jj1j16owv8n","text":"Shri Mataji a souligné que Sahaja Yoga améliore la santé, mais son objectif n'est pas de guérir, c'est un bénéfice de l'éveil de la kundalini par la Réalisation du Soi.","type":"text"}},{"type":"media","data":{"id":"cz4d0dmmz1k","items":[{"image":{"id":232,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/232/small_IMG0006a.jpg"},"alt":"Shri Mataji donnant une conférence sur le système subtil","caption":"","credit":""}],"type":"image","quantity":"single","position":"center","size":"normal","mediaFiles":[232],"decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"gwuufmcmb1n","text":"Par exemple, le Dr Ramesh Manocha, médecin généraliste et chercheur au Département de thérapie naturelle du Royal Hospital for Women à Sydney en Australie, cite des résultats convaincants de l'influence positive de la méditation Sahaja Yoga dans le traitement et la prévention de divers troubles, notamment l'hypertension, l'asthme, et l’hyperactivité. Selon le Dr Manocha, le silence mental établi pendant la méditation, est associé à un caractère unique d'activité physiologique. Il note que parmi les nombreuses méthodes de méditation et de relaxation, la méditation par la méthode de Sahaja Yoga s'est révélée efficace en termes de traitement thérapeutique.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"2spzejmccz8","text":"En 1996, Shri Mataji a fondé le Centre international de recherche et de bien-être Sahaja Yoga à Belapur, près de Mumbai, en Inde. La clinique accepte maintenant des patients du monde entier. Le diagnostic et le traitement impliquent l'utilisation de de méthodes Sahaja Yoga en plus de la pratiques médicale ayurvédique. Par rapport à la médecine occidentale traditionnelle, l'utilisation de la méditation dans le traitement conduit à une stabilisation significative de la pression artérielle, à une réduction des niveaux de stress et au renforcement du système immunitaire, et des études sur d'autres effets sont en cours .","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"0a20b5b2e1cea873","text":"Reconnaissance Mondiale","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"mjpoynue08d","text":"Tout au long des 41 années que Shri Mataji a passées à diffuser Sahaja Yoga, elle a reçu de nombreux prix, nominations et distinctions de la part de chefs d'État et d'institutions notables du monde entier.","type":"text"}},{"type":"textbox","data":{"id":"i4kl3m115lr","text":"“Une source d'espoir pour l'humanité”","credit":"Claes Nobel, petit-neveu d'Alfred Nobel","caption":"Discours public au  Royal Albert Hall, Londres, 1997","type":"text","style":"hero","alignment":"center","decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"5xsnsj28tdv","text":"En 1996, elle a été nominée pour le prix Nobel de la paix et en 1997, elle a reçu une reconnaissance personnelle de Claes Nobel, le petit-neveu d'Alfred Nobel. Dans un discours public au Royal Albert Hall de Londres, Nobel a parlé avec un profond respect pour la vie et l'œuvre de Shri Mataji, décrivant Sahaja Yoga comme 'un point de référence pour déterminer le bien du mal.'","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"18wjh32vvf1","text":"En accordant le titre de membre honoraire de l'Académie des arts et des sciences de Petrovskaya à Saint-Pétersbourg, une distinction jamais reçue par 12 personnes, dont Einstein, l'institution a félicité Shri Mataji avec les mots `` Vous êtes encore plus haut que la science ''. et l'admiration de représentants de tous les secteurs de la société qui met en évidence la valeur des enseignements de Shri Mataji.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"hecf7bvn0v5","text":"Quelques moments marquants de la vie de Shri Mataji:","type":"text"}},{"type":"layout","data":{"id":"9d0d8a670a94521b","items":[{"title":"Italie, 1986","text":"Le gouvernement italien proclame Shri Mataji personnalité de l'année."},{"title":"Moscou, Russie, 1989","text":"Suite à la réunion de Shri Mataji avec le ministre de la Santé de l'URSS, Sahaja Yoga reçoit le plein soutien du gouvernement, y compris le financement de la recherche scientifique."},{"title":"Saint-Pétersbourg, Russie, 1993","text":"Élue membre honoraire de l'Académie Petrovsky des arts et des sciences. Shri Mataji ouvre la Conférence internationale sur la médecine et la connaissance de soi, qui devient par la suite une conférence annuelle."},{"title":"Brasilia, Brésil, 1994","text":"Shri Mataji est accueillie à l'aéroport par le maire de Brasilia, qui lui présente les clés de la ville puis qui parraine de tous ses programmes.\u003cbr\u003e"},{"title":"New York, USA, 1994","text":"Le 26 septembre est déclaré \"Journée Shri Mataji Nirmala Devi\". Shri Mataji se voit offrir une escorte policière pour un défilé en son honneur."},{"title":"Colombie-Britannique, Canada, 1994","text":"\u0026nbsp;Au nom du peuple canadien, le premier ministre de la province de la Colombie-Britannique, M. Mike Harcourt, adresse une lettre de bienvenue à\nShri Mataji."},{"title":"Bucarest, Roumanie, 1995","text":"Obtention d'un doctorat honorifique en sciences cognitives par le professeur D Drime, directeur de l'Université écologique de Bucarest."},{"title":"Pékin, Chine 1995","text":"Le gouvernement chinois invite Shri Mataji à être une conférencière officielle à la 4e Conférence des Nations Unies sur les femmes."},{"title":"Pune, Indie, 1996","text":"Shri Mataji s’adresse au \"World Philosophers Meet ‘96 - A Parliament of Science, Religion and Philosophy\", où elle est célébrée pour l’établissement de Sahaja Yoga."},{"title":"États-Unis, 105e congrès, 1997 et 106e congrès, 2000","text":"Considérations lues dans le dossier du Congrès par le membre du Congrès Eliot Engle, qui félicite Shri Mataji pour son travail dévoué et infatigable pour l'humanité.\u003cbr\u003e"},{"title":"Cabella Ligure, Italie, 2006","text":"Le gouvernement italien décerne à Shri Mataji la citoyenneté d’honneur, suivie de la remise de la première pierre de la \"Fondation mondiale Shri Mataji Nirmala Devi de Sahaja Yoga\" à Cabella Ligure."}],"type":"grid","mediaFiles":[]}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"6wqw0botj","text":"Son Héritage","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"wl7gf8v9po","text":"Shri Mataji a créé des jardins d'enfants et des écoles, des centres médicaux et des maisons pour les défavorisés, des académies d'art et des projets sociaux, mais son héritage est bien plus important que tout cela. Aucun monument ni organisation non gouvernementale ne pourrait démontrer le véritable héritage de Shri Mataji Nirmala Devi: il va bien au-delà de tout cela.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"xtylm2sudfo","text":"La vision de Shri Mataji n'était pas de créer des organisations - son message est centré sur la personne, sur le \"je\" intérieur. Elle a également insisté sur la liberté de l'individu: avec Sahaja Yoga, il n'y a pas de prescriptions générales, il n'y a que la conscience intérieure de ce qui est bénéfique pour le développement spirituel de chacun .","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"3wg4lye6r81","text":"En initiant de profonds changements personnels à travers l'éveil de la Kundalini et la méditation, Shri Mataji a enseigné aux gens comment viser et atteindre des objectifs plus élevés que le simple succès matériel ou le pouvoir. \"Nous devons parvenir à la paix intérieure\", a-t-elle déclaré. Shri Mataji a noté que seul le dévouement aux valeurs spirituelles universelles peut résoudre les problèmes mondiaux de l'humanité.","type":"text"}},{"type":"textbox","data":{"id":"az63q3sdsms","text":"\"Les préparer pour qu'ils puissent résoudre leurs problèmes, c'est ce que je dois faire ... Vous devez être un médecin pour vous-même. Vous devez être un gourou pour vous-même.\"","credit":"","caption":"","type":"text","style":"hero","alignment":"center","decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"yicrepepgl","text":"Son héritage n'est pas une philosophie, une doctrine ou un concept. C'est une expérience transformatrice extraordinaire - la Réalisation du Soi. Reconnaître son essence spirituelle et le pouvoir de changer notre monde par la racine en commençant par soi-même, voilà le véritable héritage de la vie de Shri Mataji.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"k3nsgy3j7u","text":"Son travail a conduit à la création d'une communauté internationale dynamique en développement, qui rassemble des praticiens de Sahaja Yoga dans plus de 95 pays. Tous sont unis par le désir d'une transformation spirituelle intérieure et d'un changement global.","type":"text"}},{"type":"media","data":{"id":"voig2omrzlr","items":[{"image":{"id":419,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/419/small_BC084_Belgium_1985_ColinH1.jpg"},"alt":"Shri Mataji en Belgique","caption":"","credit":""}],"type":"image","quantity":"single","position":"center","size":"normal","mediaFiles":[419],"decorations":{}}}],"version":"2.16.0","media_files":[],"markupVersion":3}

translations.name: Շրի Մատաջի
translations.content:
{"time":1583153072277,"blocks":[{"type":"textbox","data":{"id":"d82007b48a6c6d1a","image":{"id":211,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/211/small_founder.jpg"},"title":"Սահաջա յոգայի հիմնադիրը","text":"Շրի Մատաջի Նիրմալա Դևին հայտնաբերեց «Սահաջա յոգա» մեդիտացիայի եզակի մեթոդը, որը թույլ է տալիս յուրաքանչյուրին հասնել ներքին լուսավորության՝ բացահայտելով մարդկության իրական ներուժը: Շրի Մատաջին իր ամբողջ կյանքը նվիրել է այս մեթոդի մշակմանը և տարածմանը, և այսօր ամբողջ աշխարհի հարյուր հազարավոր մարդիկ գործնականում կիրառում են Սահաջա յոգան:","action":"","url":"","type":"image","background":"white","color":"dark","position":"left","spacing":"overlap","mediaFiles":[211],"decorations":{"sidetext":{"text":"The Founder"},"circle":true}}},{"type":"textbox","data":{"id":"e4f4a9194877fff6","image":{"id":212,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/212/small_master-of-yoga.jpg"},"title":"Յոգա","text":"Շրի Մատաջին ցույց տվեց, որ յուրաքանչյուր մարդու ներսում կա մայրական հոգևոր էներգիա, որը կոչվում է «Կունդալինի»: Վերջինիս արթնացումը մարդուն տանում է դեպի ինքնաբուխ մեդիտացիայի վիճակի: Ի տարբերություն հնագույն ժամանակաշրջանի շատ ուսուցիչների, որոնք միայն մի քանի անհատների հետ էին կարողանում կիսել այս փորձը, Շրի Մատաջին կարողացավ հազարավոր մարդկանց մոտ բարձրացնել Կունդալինին, ինչը նման ծավալով նախկինում համարվում էր անհնար:

Հենց այս ներքին հոգևոր էներգիան արթնացնելու հնարավորությունն է, որն առանձնացնում է Սահաջա Յոգան մեդիտացիայի այլ տեսակներից: Դա զարմանահրաշ, կենդանի փորձ է, որը մեզ թույլ է տալիս մեր ափերի մեջ զգալ մեր էներգետիկ համակարգի խնդիրները, բացահայտել մեր լավագույն որակները և հասնել լիակատար խաղաղության և բավարարվածության:","action":"","url":"","type":"image","background":"image","color":"dark","position":"left","spacing":"overlap","mediaFiles":[212],"decorations":{"triangle":{"alignment":"left"}}}},{"type":"textbox","data":{"id":"e20aeb9d32494d79","image":{"id":214,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/214/small_social-work.jpg"},"title":"Կյանք նվիրված մարդկությանը","text":"Շրի Մատաջին ոչ միայն հիմնեց և տարածեց Սահաջա յոգայի մեթոդն ամբողջ աշխարհում, այլև ստեղծեց բազմաթիվ ոչ առևտրային կազմակերպություններ հասարակական կյանքի տարբեր ոլորտներում:

Աղքատ կանանց և որբերի համար նախատեսված կենտրոններից և միջազգային դպրոցներից մինչև առողջապահական կենտրոններ, որոնք օգտագործում են Սահաջա յոգայի մեթոդները, դասական արվեստներ դասավանդող ակադեմիաներ. Շրի Մատաջիի նվաճումների ցանկը զարմանալի է իր բազմազանությամբ:
","action":"","url":"","type":"image","background":"white","color":"dark","position":"left","spacing":"overlap","mediaFiles":[214],"decorations":{"sidetext":{"text":"Social Work"},"gradient":{"alignment":"right","color":"blue"}}}},{"type":"textbox","data":{"id":"73c46d073db8a0d5","image":{"id":215,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/215/small_family.jpg"},"title":"Կյանքը մեծ մարդկանց շարքում","text":"Ի սկզբանե Շրի Մատաջին միշտ շրջապատված էր ակնառու մարդկանցով: Նրա ծնողները գիտնականներ էին և քաղաքական ակտիվիստներ, ովքեր կարևոր դեր էին խաղում Հնդկաստանի ազատագրական շարժման մեջ ՝ իրենց երկրի անկախությունը որոնելով Մահաթմա Գանդիի հետ միասին, ով էլ նկատել էր երիտասարդ Շրի Մատաջիի արտառոց ներուժը և խորհրդակցում էր նրա հետ հոգևոր հարցերի շուրջ:

հասնել տարիների նվիրվածության և աշխատանքի միջոցով:","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"4340f3ee54b7a0f7","text":"Շրի Մատաջիի համբերատար աշխատանքը մարդկանց հետ թվում էր, որ այս գործընթացի շարժիչ ուժն էր, և որոշ ժամանակ անց նրա սաները հասան ներքին ազատության և թեթևության այս զարմանալի վիճակին, ինչպես նաև զգացին զով քամին ափի մեջ և գլխի վերևում. Շրի Մատաջիի ներկայության ժամանակ ունեցած արտասովոր զգացողության և մարդկանց վրա նրա անխոնջ, սիրով լեցուն և անձնուրաց աշխատանքի շնորհիվ է, որ իր ուսանողները նրան տվել են «Շրի Մատաջի» անվանումը, որը բառացիորեն նշանակում է «հարգելի սուրբ մայր»:","type":"text"}},{"type":"textbox","data":{"id":"896211ff5572d869","image":{"id":220,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/220/small_ShriMataji_18.jpg"},"title":"Փորձի փոխանակում","text":"Շրի Մատաջիի կողմից հայտնաբերված մեդիտացիայի մեթոդը սկսեց տարածվել ամբողջ աշխարհում այն բանից հետո, երբ նա իր ընտանիքի հետ տեղափոխվեց Լոնդոն: Սկսելով իր առաջին աշակերտների հետ, որոնց Շրի Մատաջին ապաստան էր տրամադրել Լոնդոնի իր տանը, նա նրանց տվեց Ինքնագիտակցում, սովորեցրեց մեդիտացիայի հիմունքները և աստիճանաբար վերակառուցեց նրանց փշրված նուրբ մարմինները:
Դրանից առաջ նա հեռուստատեսությամբ և ռադիոյով հարցազրույցներ էր տալիս և դասախոսություններ էր ունենում հանրապետության հանրային դահլիճներում: Դրանից հետո նա միշտ շատ ժամանակ էր ծախսում ունկնդիրներին՝ անհատական ուշադրություն դարձնելով յուրաքանչյուրին և համբերատար պատասխանելով նրանց հարցերին: Շրի Մատաջին երբեք որևէ գումար չի գանձել այդ դասախոսությունների համար, ոչ էլ ինքնագիտակցման փորձով կիսվելու համար ՝ պնդելով, որ դա յուրաքանչյուր անհատի վերածնունդ է:","action":"","url":"","type":"image","background":"white","color":"dark","position":"left","spacing":"overlap","mediaFiles":[220],"decorations":{"sidetext":{"text":"Spreading the Word"},"gradient":{"alignment":"right","color":"blue"}}}},{"type":"textbox","data":{"id":"4f0749860c6b17ef","image":{"id":218,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/218/small_vision.jpg"},"title":"Համաշխարհային տեսլականը","text":"1980-ականներից սկսած Շրի Մատաջին սկսեց ճանապարհորդել աշխարհով մեկ ՝ իր գիտելիքները փոխանցելու համար բոլոր նրանց, ովքեր ցանկանում էին այն ստանալ: Սկսելով Եվրոպայից, Հյուսիսային Ամերիկայից և Ավստրալիայից և հետագայում տեղափոխվելով Արևելյան Եվրոպա, Հարավային Ամերիկա, Ասիա և Խաղաղ օվկիանոսի տարածաշրջան, նա անխոնջ կերպով ուսուցանում էր Սահաջա Յոգան բոլոր նրանց, ովքեր հետաքրքրություն էին ցուցաբերում:

Միայն 1990թ.-ին Շրի Մատաջին մասնակցեց 26 երկրներում ավելի քան 200 պաշտոնական միջոցառումների և շատ ավելի ոչ պաշտոնական հանդիպումներ ունեցավ: Բայց անկախ նրանից, դա ելույթ էր մայրաքաղաքի գլխավոր դահլիճում, թե գյուղացու տանը հասարակ զրույց, յուրաքանչյուր խոսակցություն և փորձ իր համար կարևոր նշանակություն ուներ:

Նրա տեսլականը գլոբալ էր, ճանապարհորդելով և հանդիպելով մարդկանց աշխարհի տարբեր ծայրերից՝ նա ձգտում էր գիտակցել այդ փաստը: Այս տեսլականն էր փոխելու աշխարհը դեպի լավը, յուրաքանչյուր անձին անկախ ռասայից, կրոնից կամ այլ հանգամանքից տալով մի մեթոդ, որով նրանք կարող են հասնել ներքին վերափոխման և դառնալ իրենց իսկական եսը:","action":"","url":"","type":"image","background":"white","color":"dark","position":"right","spacing":"overlap","mediaFiles":[218],"decorations":{"sidetext":{"text":"Vision"},"triangle":{"alignment":"left"}}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"s7sm8pmjt0o","text":"Ներքին զարգացումը ՝ որպես առողջ հասարակության հիմք","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"oiq2bydz29k","text":"Շրի Մատաջին իր դասախոսությունների և խոսակցությունների ընթացքում ուշադրություն է դարձրել մարդկային կյանքի բազում ասպեկտների վրա ՝ ասելով, որ մեդիտացիայի պրակտիկայով լուսավորված ներքին վիճակը պետք է գտնի արտաքին դրսևորում մարդկային կյանքի բոլոր բնագավառներում:","type":"text"}},{"type":"textbox","data":{"id":"v9z84p7xdy","image":{"id":223,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/223/small_IMG_6200.jpg"},"title":"Լուսավորյալ կրթություն","text":"Շրի Մատաջին հատուկ ուշադրություն է դարձրել անհատի զարգացման համար ամուր հիմքի ստեղծմանը, դրանով իսկ ընդգծելով նախադպրոցական կրթության կարևորությունը: Նա նշել է, որ կրթությունը ոչ միայն պետք է ապահովի երեխաների մտավոր և հուզական զարգացումը, այլև դառնա բարոյականության և հոգևորի հիմքեր:

Երեխաների արժանի պահվածքի ու ինքնասիրության զգացում ձևավորելու հարցում Շրի Մատաջին մեծ կարևորություն է տվել կարգապահությանը ՝ սիրո և հարգանքի վրա հիմնված կարգապահությանը: Շրի Մատաջին ասում էր. «Մեր պարտքն է տեսնել, որ մեր երեխաները մեծ մարդկանց մեջ են աճում: Նրանք պետք է հոգ տանեն այս աշխարհի մասին»: Գործնականում գիտակցելով իր տեսլականը ՝ Շրի Մատաջին ստեղծեց կրթական համակարգ ՝ հիմնված «Սահաջա յոգայի» վրա: Դասընթացը ներառում է բարդ ուսումնական պլանի յուրացում և կանոնավոր մեդիտացիայի դասեր: Մեդիտացիան օգնում է ուսանողներին բարելավել իրենց ուշադրությունը և մոտիվացիան, զարգացնում է ինքնավստահության զգացողություն, թույլ է տալիս հասկանալ սեփական անձը, ներդաշնակություն հաստատել ներսում:
Տարբեր երկրներից երիտասարդները հաջողությամբ զարգանում են, ստանում պատշաճ կրթություն և ներդաշնակ կապեր են հաստատում Շրի Մատաջիի կողմից Հնդկաստանում, Իտալիայում, Կանադայում, Ավստրիայում, ԱՄՆ-ում, Չեխիայում և Ավստրալիայում կազմակերպված դպրոցների ընկերների հետ:
","action":"","url":"","type":"image","background":"white","color":"dark","position":"left","spacing":"overlap","mediaFiles":[223],"decorations":{"circle":false,"gradient":{"alignment":"right","color":"blue"},"sidetext":{"text":"Education"}}}},{"type":"textbox","data":{"id":"6mxb05rf9w7","image":{"id":230,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/230/small_PhotoSM-150.jpg"},"title":"Մաքուր ստեղծագործականություն","text":"2003-ին Շրի Մատաջին իր եղբոր հետ միասին հիմնեց Արվեստի ակադեմիա Մահարաշտրայում (Հնդկաստան): Տարբեր երկրներից ուսանողներ գալիս են ակադեմիա ՝ սովորելու հնդկական դասական երաժշտություն, պար և նկարչություն հնդկական հանգիստ գյուղերում: Շրի Մատաջին անձամբ վերահսկում էր Ակադեմիայի շենքի ճարտարապետական նախագիծը, ինչպես նաև մարդասիրական նպատակներով այլ հաստատությունների ստեղծումը: Նման նախագիծ է Նիրամալա Պրեմի կենտրոնը Դելի (Հնդկաստան) որբերի համար:
Տարիներ շարունակ Շրի Մատաջին հովանավորել է դասական հնդկական երաժշտության և պարի ամենահայտնի ներկայացուցիչներից մի քանիսին ՝ նրանց հրավիրելով հանդես գալու տարբեր համերգների և հաղորդումների: Երաժիշտներն, ովքեր կատարում էին Շրի Մատաջիի ներկայությամբ, այս փորձը նկարագրում էին որպես շրջադարձային իրենց ստեղծագործական ուղու մեջ: Շատերը նշել են, որ Շրի Մատաջիի ուժեղ ստեղծագործական էներգիան մեծապես ոգեշնչել է իրենց՝ գիտակցել իրենց ներուժը՝ խորացնելով կատարման վարպետությունը:

Արվեստի զարգացման գործում Շրի Մատաջիի ջանքերն ուղղվել են թատրոնի ակտիվ աջակցությանը: Նա ոգեշնչեց թատրոնների մի խումբ տաղանդավոր դերասանների`միավորվելու և ստեղծելու «Հավերժական արժեքների թատրոնը»: Այն հիմնադրվել է 1993 թվականին Գենտում (Բելգիա): Ասոցիացիան շարունակում է շրջագայել ամբողջ աշխարհով և ներկայացնում է մեծ դրամատուրգների (Վ. Բլեյք, Վ. Շեքսպիր, Լ. Տոլստոյ) գործերը ՝ անդրադառնալով հոգևորի թեմաներին, ինքնազարգացմանը ՝ այդպիսով ներշնչելով հանդիսատեսին:
