translations.content: {"time":1591196000363,"blocks":[{"type":"media","data":{"id":"i84hm2e3o4r","items":[{"image":{"id":253,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/253/small_Imperial-_small.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"“L'odeur de l'hôtel impérial associé à le vénération de la Déesse et de toutes les divinités. Je déjeune dans l'odeur de l'hôtel impérial. \"","credit":""}],"type":"image","quantity":"single","position":"center","size":"normal","mediaFiles":[253],"decorations":{}}},{"type":"textbox","data":{"id":"u517ahkmish","text":"\"J'aime à croire que nous ne sommes que des instruments d'une muse ou d'un génie ... tout ce qui est créé spontanément, avec un pur désir est le souvenir de ce moment propice entre l'instrument et le créateur. \"","credit":"","caption":"","type":"text","style":"hero","alignment":"center","decorations":{}}},{"type":"media","data":{"id":"7hj7orwpe1","items":[{"image":{"id":254,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/254/small_Prayer-_small.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"\"Peut-être que je désire un jardin sur le Nil où planter mes roses. Un géographe sur un fauteuil pour me diriger vers Bethléem. Aucunes de ces lampes n'éclairent mes fautes sur les lettres que j'écris à ceux qui m'oublient. Un Maharaj, plutôt grand, pour me prêter des rubis aussi gros que des grenades... Oui, ça aussi.\"","credit":""},{"image":{"id":256,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/256/small_Prayer_detail_2.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""},{"image":{"id":255,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/255/small_Prayer_detail.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""},{"image":{"id":257,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/257/small_Palladio_-_small.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"\"J'ai vu qui je voulais être dans les miroirs du Palladio à Jaipur. Mais il y avait aussi la peur, la peur de toujours se sentir bleu dans une ville rose.\"","credit":""},{"image":{"id":261,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/261/small_Palladio_detail_2.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""},{"image":{"id":260,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/260/small_Palladio_detail.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""},{"image":{"id":262,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/262/small_Meditation_-_small.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"\"La méditation pour moi, c'est comme se raccrocher au sari de sa mère.\"","credit":""},{"image":{"id":263,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/263/small_Meditation_detail_2.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""},{"image":{"id":264,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/264/small_Meditation_detail.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""},{"image":{"id":265,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/265/small_Imperial-_small.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""},{"image":{"id":266,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/266/small_Imperial_detail_2.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""},{"image":{"id":267,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/267/small_Imperial_detail.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""}],"type":"image","quantity":"gallery","position":null,"size":"normal","mediaFiles":[254,256,255,257,261,260,262,263,264,265,266,267],"decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"b3jv6w52vgc","text":"About the illustrations","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"k7tv7nm1wic","text":"Les illustrations sont les souvenirs de mes voyages. J'ai toujours apprécié le bizarre dans une situation, le particulier qui est aujourd'hui très difficile à trouver; comme une autruche sur un lit ou une poule couverte de rubis. Je laisse parler mon imagination sans avoir peur de créer des situations improbables.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"son1uky0vh8","text":"Je ne peux pas dire que j'ai été intéressée par l'art en tant que tel, je n'ai jamais étudié l'art. Mais j'ai toujours eu besoin de beauté pour m'entourer et tout ce qui était beau est devenu une forme d'art. En fait, la littérature était mon premier amour. La façon dont les mots pouvaient composer un tableau dans mon imagination était extrêmement puissante. J'ai commencé à écrire sur un monde que j'avais imaginé, et plus tard j'ai trouvé un moyen de dessiner ce même monde, un monde que je ne pouvais exprimer qu'une fois dans mon journal.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"26r2z1s7bh4h","text":"J'aime à croire que nous ne sommes tous que des instruments d'une muse ou d'un génie (les Romains croyaient qu'il y avait une nature divine au sein d'une personne, un ange gardien de naissance, nous inspirant). Ensuite, on pourrait presque dire que tout ce qui est créé spontanément, avec un pur désir est le souvenir de ce moment propice entre l'instrument et le créateur.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"d3t0rsrisxb","text":"Ayant récemment commencé à dessiner, j'étais très timide et hésitais à montrer quoi que ce soit à qui que ce soit; c'est mon mari qui m'a poussé et m'a dit: \"Si tu apportes de la joie à une seule personne avec simplement un ton de couleur, alors pendant un moment tu seras un instrument, ce que vous souhaitez être.\" Et il m'a convaincu.","type":"text"}}],"version":"2.16.0","media_files":[],"markupVersion":3}

translations.content: {"time":1582137682529,"blocks":[{"type":"media","data":{"id":"i84hm2e3o4r","items":[{"image":{"id":253,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/253/small_Imperial-_small.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"“L'odore dell'hotel imperiale. Un Maharaj, uno piuttosto grande, per prestarmi rubini grandi come melograni. Passi che portano a Madre. E forse un altare. Sì, anche quello.\"","credit":""},{"image":{"id":256,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/256/small_Prayer_detail_2.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""},{"image":{"id":255,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/255/small_Prayer_detail.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""},{"image":{"id":257,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/257/small_Palladio_-_small.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"\"Ho visto la donna che volevo diventare negli specchi del Palladio a Jaipur. Ma c'era anche paura, la paura di sentirmi sempre triste come il blu, in una città Rosa.\"","credit":""},{"image":{"id":261,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/261/small_Palladio_detail_2.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""},{"image":{"id":260,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/260/small_Palladio_detail.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""},{"image":{"id":262,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/262/small_Meditation_-_small.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"\"La meditazione, per me, è aggrapparsi al suo sari.\"","credit":""},{"image":{"id":263,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/263/small_Meditation_detail_2.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""},{"image":{"id":264,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/264/small_Meditation_detail.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""},{"image":{"id":265,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/265/small_Imperial-_small.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"“L'odore dell'hotel Imperial. L'odore che associo all'adorazione della Dea e di tutte le sue divinità. Faccio colazione nell'odore dell'hotel Imperial.\"","credit":""},{"image":{"id":266,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/266/small_Imperial_detail_2.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""},{"image":{"id":267,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/267/small_Imperial_detail.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""}],"type":"image","quantity":"gallery","position":null,"size":"normal","mediaFiles":[254,256,255,257,261,260,262,263,264,265,266,267],"decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"b3jv6w52vgc","text":"Sulle illustrazioni","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"k7tv7nm1wic","text":"Le illustrazioni sono souvenirs dei miei viaggi. Mi è sempre piaciuto il bizzarro della situazione, la particolarità che oggi è molto difficile da trovare; come uno struzzo su un letto o una gallina ricoperta di rubini. Lascio che la mia immaginazione parli e non ho paura di creare situazioni improbabili.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"son1uky0vh8","text":"Non posso dire di essere mai stata interessata all'arte stessa, non ho mai studiato arte. Ma ho sempre avuto bisogno di essere circondata dalla bellezza e tutto ciò che era bello è diventato una forma d'arte. In realtà, il mio primo amore è stato la letteratura. Il modo in cui le parole potevano comporre un dipinto nella mia immaginazione era estremamente potente. Ho iniziato a scrivere di un mondo immaginario e in seguito ho trovato un modo in cui poter disegnare quello stesso mondo, un mondo che una volta avrei potuto esprimere solo nel mio diario.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"26r2z1s7bh4h","text":".Mi piace credere che siamo tutti solo strumenti di una musa o di un genio (i Romani credevano che esistesse una natura divina dentro le persone, un angelo custode che ci ispira dalla nascita). Si potrebbe persino dire che qualsiasi cosa creata spontaneamente, con un puro desiderio, è il ricordo di quel momento propizio tra lo strumento e il creatore.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"d3t0rsrisxb","text":"Avendo iniziato a disegnare solo di recente, mi vergognavo di mostrare il mio lavoro; è stato mio marito che mi ha spinto e mi ha detto: \"Se porti gioia a una sola persona semplicemente con una tonalità di colore, per un momento sei stato uno strumento, che è quello che desideri essere\". E mi ha convinta.","type":"text"}}],"version":"2.16.0","media_files":[],"markupVersion":3}

translations.name: Ilustrações majestosas
translations.content: {"time":1591236372898,"blocks":[{"type":"media","data":{"id":"i84hm2e3o4r","items":[{"image":{"id":253,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/253/small_Imperial-_small.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"“O cheiro do hotel Imperial. O cheiro eu associo com  adorar a Deusa e com as suas divindades. Eu tomei café da manhã com o cheiro do hotel Imperial.”","credit":""}],"type":"image","quantity":"single","position":"center","size":"normal","mediaFiles":[253],"decorations":{}}},{"type":"textbox","data":{"id":"u517ahkmish","text":"“Eu gosto de acreditar que todos nós somos só instrumentos de um museu ou de um gênio... qualquer coisa espontaneamente criada com  puro desejo é a lembrança daquele momento auspicioso entre o instrumento e o criador.”","credit":"","caption":"","type":"text","style":"hero","alignment":"center","decorations":{}}},{"type":"media","data":{"id":"7hj7orwpe1","items":[{"image":{"id":254,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/254/small_Prayer-_small.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"\"Perhaps I desire a garden on the Nile where I can plant my roses. A geographer on an armchair to point me towards Bethlehem. None of these luminaries to illuminate my spelling mistakes on letters I write to those forgetting me. A Maharaj, one rather large, to lend me rubies as large as pomegranates. Steps that lead to Mother. And maybe an altar. Yes, that too.\"","credit":""},{"image":{"id":256,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/256/small_Prayer_detail_2.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""},{"image":{"id":255,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/255/small_Prayer_detail.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""},{"image":{"id":257,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/257/small_Palladio_-_small.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"\"I saw who I wanted to be in the mirrors of the Palladio in Jaipur. But there was fear too, a fear of always feeling blue in a Pink city.\"","credit":""},{"image":{"id":261,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/261/small_Palladio_detail_2.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""},{"image":{"id":260,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/260/small_Palladio_detail.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""},{"image":{"id":262,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/262/small_Meditation_-_small.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"\"Meditation to me, is holding onto her sari.\"","credit":""},{"image":{"id":263,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/263/small_Meditation_detail_2.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""},{"image":{"id":264,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/264/small_Meditation_detail.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""},{"image":{"id":265,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/265/small_Imperial-_small.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"“The smell of the Imperial hotel. The smell I associate with worshipping the Goddess and all her deities. I have breakfast within the smell of the Imperial hotel.\"","credit":""},{"image":{"id":266,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/266/small_Imperial_detail_2.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""},{"image":{"id":267,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/267/small_Imperial_detail.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""}],"type":"image","quantity":"gallery","position":null,"size":"normal","mediaFiles":[254,256,255,257,261,260,262,263,264,265,266,267],"decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"b3jv6w52vgc","text":"About the illustrations","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"k7tv7nm1wic","text":"The illustrations are souvenirs of my travels. I always enjoyed the bizarre in a situation, the peculiar that today is very hard to come by; like an ostrich on a bed or a hen covered in rubies. I allow my imagination to speak and I’m not afraid to create unlikely situations.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"son1uky0vh8","text":"I can’t say I was ever interested in art itself, I never studied art. But I always needed beauty to surround me and everything that was beautiful became a form of art. Actually, literature was my first love. The way in which words could compose a painting in my imagination was extremely powerful. I began to write about a world I visioned, and later I found a way in which I could draw that same world, a world  that once I could only express in my diary.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"26r2z1s7bh4h","text":"I like to believe we are all only instruments of a muse or a genius, (the Romans believed there was a divine nature within a person, a guardian angel from birth, inspiring us). Then you could almost say that anything created spontaneously, with a pure desire is the souvenir of that auspicious moment between the instrument and the creator.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"d3t0rsrisxb","text":"Having only recently started drawing, I was very timid with showing anything to anyone; it was my husband who pushed me and said, “If you bring joy to just one person with simply a colour tone, then for a moment you were an instrument, which is what you wish to be.” And he convinced me.","type":"text"}}],"version":"2.16.0","media_files":[],"markupVersion":3}

translations.name: Изысканные Иллюстрации
translations.content: {"time":1586032639633,"blocks":[{"type":"media","data":{"id":"i84hm2e3o4r","items":[{"image":{"id":253,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/253/small_Imperial-_small.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"“Запах отеля Империал. Запах у меня ассоциируется с поклонением Богине и всем её аспектам. Я завтракаю в запахе отеля Империал. \"","credit":""}],"type":"image","quantity":"single","position":"center","size":"normal","mediaFiles":[253],"decorations":{}}},{"type":"textbox","data":{"id":"u517ahkmish","text":"\"Мне нравится верить, что все мы – всего лишь инструменты музы или гения... всё, что было создано спонтанно с чистым желанием – это сувенир на память о том особом, благоприятном моменте союза инструмента и его создателя. \"","credit":"","caption":"","type":"text","style":"hero","alignment":"center","decorations":{}}},{"type":"media","data":{"id":"7hj7orwpe1","items":[{"image":{"id":254,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/254/small_Prayer-_small.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"\"Возможно, я хочу сад в долине Нила, где я могу посадить свои розы. Географ на кресле, чтобы указать мне на Вифлеем. Ни один из этих светил не освещал мои орфографические ошибки в письмах, которые я пишу тем, кто забыл меня. Махарадж, довольно большой, чтобы одолжить мне рубины размером с гранаты. Шаги, которые ведут к Матери. И, возможно, алтарь. Да, алтарь тоже.\"","credit":""},{"image":{"id":256,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/256/small_Prayer_detail_2.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""},{"image":{"id":255,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/255/small_Prayer_detail.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""},{"image":{"id":257,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/257/small_Palladio_-_small.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"\"В Джайпуре в зеркалах Палладио я видела, кем я хочу быть. Но был и страх, страх всегда чувствовать себя синим в розовом городе.\"","credit":""},{"image":{"id":261,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/261/small_Palladio_detail_2.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""},{"image":{"id":260,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/260/small_Palladio_detail.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""},{"image":{"id":262,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/262/small_Meditation_-_small.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"\"Для меня медитация – это держаться за её сари.\"","credit":""},{"image":{"id":263,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/263/small_Meditation_detail_2.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""},{"image":{"id":264,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/264/small_Meditation_detail.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""},{"image":{"id":265,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/265/small_Imperial-_small.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"“Запах отеля Империал. Запах у меня ассоциируется с поклонением Богине и всем её аспектам. Я завтракаю в запахе отеля Империал.\"","credit":""},{"image":{"id":266,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/266/small_Imperial_detail_2.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""},{"image":{"id":267,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/267/small_Imperial_detail.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""}],"type":"image","quantity":"gallery","position":null,"size":"normal","mediaFiles":[254,256,255,257,261,260,262,263,264,265,266,267],"decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"b3jv6w52vgc","text":"Об иллюстрациях","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"k7tv7nm1wic","text":"Для меня иллюстрации – это сувениры с моих путешествий. Я всегда любила необычные вещи, что-то особенное, что сегодня редко встретишь. Например, страус на кровати или курица, покрытая рубинами. Я позволяю своему воображению летать, и не боюсь создавать невероятные ситуации.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"son1uky0vh8","text":"Не могу сказать, что меня когда-то интересовало само искусство, я никогда не изучало его специально. Но мне всегда было важно, чтобы меня окружало что-то прекрасное, и всё, что было красиво, стало для меня искусством. На самом деле, сначала я влюбилась в литературу. Сам факт, что слова могут составить целую картину в моём воображении, невероятно впечатлял меня. Я начала писать о мире, который видела вокруг, а позже поняла, что могу нарисовать этот мир – мир, который когда-то я могла создавать только на страницах своего дневника.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"26r2z1s7bh4h","text":"Мне нравится верить, что все мы – всего лишь инструменты музы или гения. (Римляне верили, что в человеке существует Божественная природа, что у каждого из нас есть ангел-хранитель от рождения, вдохновляющий нас.) Тогда можно сказать, что почти всё, что было создано спонтанно с чистым желанием – это сувенир на память о том особом, благоприятном моменте союза инструмента и его создателя.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"d3t0rsrisxb","text":"Так как я начала рисовать совсем недавно, я неохотно показываю кому-нибудь свои работы. На творчество меня вдохновил мой муж, сказав: \"Если тебе удастся принести радость даже одному человеку с помощью просто цветового тона, то на мгновение ты станешь инструментом, которым ты так хочешь быть\".","type":"text"}}],"version":"2.16.0","media_files":[],"markupVersion":3}

Ama korkum da vardı, pembe bir şehirde her zaman maviyi hissetme korkusu.\"","credit":""},{"image":{"id":261,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/261/small_Palladio_detail_2.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""},{"image":{"id":260,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/260/small_Palladio_detail.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""},{"image":{"id":262,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/262/small_Meditation_-_small.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"\"Benim için meditasyon, sarisine tutunmaktır.\"","credit":""},{"image":{"id":263,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/263/small_Meditation_detail_2.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""},{"image":{"id":264,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/264/small_Meditation_detail.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""},{"image":{"id":265,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/265/small_Imperial-_small.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"\"İmparatorluk otelinin kokusu. Tanrıçaya ve onun tüm tanrısal varlıklarına ibadetle ilişkilendirdiğim koku. Imperial otelinin kokusu içinde kahvaltı ediyorum.\"","credit":""},{"image":{"id":266,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/266/small_Imperial_detail_2.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""},{"image":{"id":267,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/267/small_Imperial_detail.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""}],"mediaFiles":[254,256,255,257,261,260,262,263,264,265,266,267],"type":"image","quantity":"gallery","position":"center","size":"narrow","decorations":{}}},{"id":"aPyG7xIMPz","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"b3jv6w52vgc","text":"İllüstrasyonlar Hakkında","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"TkzdkGpPgS","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"k7tv7nm1wic","text":"Çizimlerim seyahatlerimden anılarımı yansıtır. Bugün elde etmenin çok zor olduğu bir tuhaflıktan, her zaman zevk almışımdır; yataktaki bir devekuşu ya da yakutla kaplı bir tavuk gibi. Hayal gücümün konuşmasına izin veriyorum ve imkansız durumlar yaratmaktan korkmuyorum.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"ViHi467Xen","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"son1uky0vh8","text":"Sanatın kendisiyle ilgilendiğimi söyleyemem, hiç sanat okumadım. Ama her zaman etrafımı saran güzelliğe ihtiyacım oldu ve güzel olan her şey bir sanatsal dışavurum haline geldi. Aslında edebiyat benim ilk aşkımdı. Kelimelerin hayal gücüm üzerinden bir tabloyu ortaya çıkarma şekli son derece güçlüydü. Hayal ettiğim bir dünya hakkında yazmaya başladım ve daha sonra aynı dünyayı çizebileceğim bir yol buldum, bir zamanlar sadece günlüğümde ifade edebildiğim bir dünya.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"pFYOtx8Hbu","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"26r2z1s7bh4h","text":"Hepimizin yalnızca bir ilham perisi ya da dehanın enstrümanları olduğumuza inanmayı seviyorum (Romalılar her bir insanın içinde ilahi bir tabiat olduğuna, doğuştan itibaren koruyucu bir meleğin bize ilham verdiğine inanıyorlardı). O zaman, neredeyse kendiliğinden, saf bir arzuyla yaratılan her şeyin, enstrüman ve yaratıcı arasındaki o hayırlı anın hatırası olduğunu söyleyebilirsiniz.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"YtgIqwCfGc","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"d3t0rsrisxb","text":"Daha yeni çizmeye başladığım için birine bir şey göstermekten çekiniyordum; beni zorlayan kocam oldu ve dedi ki: \"Yalnızca bir renk tonuyla bir kişiye neşe getirebiliyorsan, o zaman bir an için bir enstrüman oldun demektir, ki bu olmak istediğin şeydir.\" Ve beni ikna etti.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}}],"version":"2.23.2","markupVersion":3,"mediaFiles":[]}

translations.name: Величні ілюстрації
translations.content: {"time":1625571897283,"blocks":[{"type":"media","data":{"id":"i84hm2e3o4r","items":[{"image":{"id":253,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/253/small_Imperial-_small.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"«Цей запах готелю Імперіал. Запах, який в мене асоціюється з поклонінням Богині та всім її божествам. Я снідаю посеред цього запаху готелю Імперіал».","credit":""}],"type":"image","quantity":"single","position":"center","size":"normal","mediaFiles":[253],"decorations":{}}},{"type":"textbox","data":{"id":"u517ahkmish","text":"«Мені подобається вважати, що ми є просто інструментами якоїсь музи або генія… Будь-що, створене спонтанно з чистим бажанням, є спогадом про ту сприятливу мить, що виникла між інструментом та творцем».\u003cbr\u003e","credit":"","caption":"","type":"text","style":"hero","alignment":"center","decorations":{}}},{"type":"media","data":{"id":"7hj7orwpe1","items":[{"image":{"id":254,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/254/small_Prayer-_small.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"«Певно, мені хотілося б, щоб був садочок на Нілі, де я зможу вирощувати троянди. І щоб географ у кріслі вказував на Віфлеєм. Ніяких світил, які б висвітлювали помилки моїх листів, написаних тим, хто мене забуває. Магараджа, чималого за розміром, який позичив би мені чималі рубіни, завбільшки з гранат. Сходи, що ведуть до Матері. Та, мабуть, вівтар. Так, його теж».","credit":""},{"image":{"id":256,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/256/small_Prayer_detail_2.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""},{"image":{"id":255,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/255/small_Prayer_detail.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""},{"image":{"id":257,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/257/small_Palladio_-_small.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"«Я бачила, ким я хочу бути в дзеркалах Палладіо в Джайпурі. Проте, там був і страх, страх почуватися блакитною в Рожевому місті».","credit":""},{"image":{"id":261,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/261/small_Palladio_detail_2.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""},{"image":{"id":260,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/260/small_Palladio_detail.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""},{"image":{"id":262,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/262/small_Meditation_-_small.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"«Медитація для мене — це як триматися за її сарі».","credit":""},{"image":{"id":263,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/263/small_Meditation_detail_2.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""},{"image":{"id":264,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/264/small_Meditation_detail.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""},{"image":{"id":265,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/265/small_Imperial-_small.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"«Цей запах готелю Імперіал. Запах, який в мене асоціюється з поклонінням Богині та всім її божествам. Я снідаю посеред цього запаху готелю Імперіал».","credit":""},{"image":{"id":266,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/266/small_Imperial_detail_2.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""},{"image":{"id":267,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/267/small_Imperial_detail.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""}],"type":"image","quantity":"gallery","position":null,"size":"normal","mediaFiles":[254,256,255,257,261,260,262,263,264,265,266,267],"decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"b3jv6w52vgc","text":"Про ілюстрації","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"p6b0w8pagx","text":"Ілюстрації — це спогади про мої подорожі, привезені, немов сувеніри. Я завжди насолоджувалася химерністю ситуації, своєрідністю, на яку сьогодні дуже важко натрапити; як страус на ліжку або курка вкрита рубінами. Я даю своїй уяві висловитися та не боюся створювати малоймовірні ситуації.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"lwktv0xqdfk","text":"Не можу сказати, що я коли-небудь цікавилася мистецтвом, я ніколи не вивчала його. Але я завжди потребувала краси довкола мене та щоб усе красиве було виражено через мистецтво. Насправді література стала моїм першим коханням. Те, як слова могли складатися в живопис у моїй уяві, було надзвичайно потужним. Я почала писати про світ, який уявляла, та пізніше знайшла спосіб намалювати той самий світ, який раніше могла тільки описати в щоденнику.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"8e4h5j2up7","text":"«Я хочу вірити, що ми є просто інструментами музи або генія (римляни вірили, що всередині людини є щось божественне, янгол-охоронець, даний нам при народженні, що надихає нас). Тоді можна сказати, що будь-що, створене спонтанно, з чистим бажанням, є спогадом про ту сприятливу мить між інструментом та творцем».","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"zp1k84j8oz9","text":"Коли я тільки почала малювати, я соромилася показувати що-небудь будь-кому. Саме мій чоловік заохотив мене, сказавши: «Якщо ти принесеш радість хоч одній людині просто поєднанням кольорів, тоді на якусь мить ти станеш інструментом, це саме те, чого ти бажаєш». Так він мене переконав.","type":"text"}}],"version":"2.16.0","media_files":[],"markupVersion":3}

translations.content: {"time":1588229529597,"blocks":[{"type":"media","data":{"id":"q5mxys11oqg","items":[{"image":{"id":275,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/275/small_Maria_Theresa_3.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""}],"type":"image","quantity":"single","position":"center","size":"normal","mediaFiles":[275],"decorations":{}}},{"type":"textbox","data":{"id":"wnxsswrt25d","text":"\"Pro mě je ideálním umělcem někdo, kdo přináší trochu magie nebe na zem tím, že ji učiní viditelnou nebo vnímatelnou.
