Le canal central correspond au système nerveux parasympathique, qui régit nos réponses de \"retour au calme\" ou qui gère des fonctions généralement activées lorsque nous dormons.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"2sgtqeym1lx","text":"Le but de la méditation est de réduire l'activité du système nerveux sympathique, c'est-à-dire d'éviter le stress et les déséquilibres, et d'activer le système nerveux parasympathique, ce qui n'est possible qu'après la réalisation. Il a été prouvé qu'un état véritablement méditatif, où le mental est complètement silencieux, active plus ce système que le repos normal.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"zbttyooyvlp","text":"\u003cb\u003eLes Centres Énergétiques\u003c/b\u003e","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"o9kgku9o3sp","text":"Font également partie de ce système nerveux central des plexus nerveux, qui correspondent aux centres énergétiques, où les nerfs se croisent. Ces plexus, placés le long de notre colonne vertébrale, régissent des fonctions spécifiques de notre cerveau et de notre corps, et correspondent aux centres énergétiques ou chakras.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"1w3vozr97q4","text":"En guidant notre énergie \"vivante\" vers les centres où il y a un problème, nous pouvons naturellement et sans effort résoudre les déséquilibres de la nature la plus subtile.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"kkpsrlx1bza","text":"Cette énergie ‘\u003ca href=\"https://wemeditate.co/subtle-system/kundalini\"\u003eKundalini\u003c/a\u003e’ a été mentionnée dans toutes les cultures et religions anciennes, et son existence peut être vécue par la méditation.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"dbpp5v25o0l","text":"En savoir plus sur le \u003ca href=\"https://wemeditate.co/subtle-system\"\u003ecentral nervous system\u003c/a\u003e.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"iicmhy88aw","text":"Les Effects de la Méditation","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"097kv3tflyu4","text":"\u003cb\u003eLes effects de la méditation sont de grande envergure et à multiples facettes .\u003c/b\u003e","type":"text"}},{"type":"media","data":{"id":"cp8qb7d4yn6","items":[{"image":{"id":663,"preview":"https://assets.wemeditate.co/uploads/media_file/file/663/small_08437aadce.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""}],"type":"image","quantity":"single","position":"center","size":"normal","mediaFiles":[663],"decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"u1sfy9pwqca","text":"\u003cb\u003eLes effects de la méditation sur le mental\u003c/b\u003e","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"whv2isegede","text":"La méditation est un outil incroyablement puissant et efficace pour faire le vide. Les pensées viennent lorsque nous réfléchissons au passé ou que nous envisageons l'avenir. La méditation fait taire le mental et nous laisse être au présent, tout en nous permettant  de regarder les choses sans forcément y réagir.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"ugdx00yam79","text":"On reçoit continuellement des vagues de pensées, et plus le mental est actif, plus l’intervalle entre deux pensées est court. La pratique régulière de la méditation accroit cet espace de liberté sans pensée, et nous rend capables de faire l’expérience sensible de périodes  où nous n'avons plus de pensées mis où notre attention est très vive.","type":"text"}},{"type":"media","data":{"id":"fw3vchb77ao","items":[],"type":"image","quantity":"single","position":"center","size":"normal","mediaFiles":[],"decorations":{"triangle":{"alignment":"right"}}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"5n1wfcqmm79","text":"Quelques secondes sans aucune pensée suffisent pour procurer une grande détente psychique dont les effets durent au-delà de la séance de méditation. Avec des périodes répétées de conscience sans pensée , le mental devient moins enclin à la suractivité. En conséquence, il devient moins enclin à l’inquiétude, au stress ou à l’anxiété.[3]","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"2k6qj2hv11","text":"Plus encore, le calme du mental favorise le sentiment de joie! Outre l’apaisement procuré par la méditation, de nombreux pratiquants font part d’une sensation de joie intérieure profonde dans l’état de conscience sans pensée.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"2h6qkoqe2dn","text":"\u003cb\u003e Les effects de la méditation sur le corps\u003c/b\u003e","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"ecdv34gq88i","text":"Sur le plan physique, la méditation peut être une grande source de soulagement des tensions, douleurs, lourdeurs ou agitations que nous pouvons ressentir. Les effets immédiats de la méditation sur le corps peuvent être ressentis comme un relâchement des muscles, un ralentissement de la respiration et un sentiment de légèreté générale.","type":"text"}},{"type":"media","data":{"id":"73v8pzybtjd","items":[{"image":{"id":664,"preview":"https://assets.wemeditate.co/uploads/media_file/file/664/small_bebf8f59e1.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"Fréquence respiratoire pour les pratiquants de la Méditation Sahaja Yoga [4]","credit":""}],"type":"image","quantity":"single","position":"left","size":"normal","mediaFiles":[664],"decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"wa3v1krawe","text":"Lors d'un test randomisé contrôlé, les sujets pratiquant la Méditation Sahaja Yoga ont constaté une baisse constante de leur fréquence respiratoire pendant la méditation. L'effet était d'autant plus prononcé que la personne pratiquait la méditation depuis  longtemps.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"8razjr7emrq","text":"Lorsque la méditation est pratiquée régulièrement, des déséquilibres à plus long terme peuvent être corrigés en travaillant sur notre système subtil. Des problèmes tels que l'hypertension, l'insomnie et l'asthme peuvent tous être considérablement réduits, voire éradiqués, en allant au cœur même du problème, et non pas seulement les symptômes.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"b13k9nlb3f","text":"La méditation est également un excellent outil lorsque nous nous sentons fatigués, lourds ou en manque d'énergie. En méditant, on recharge ses batterie puis on peut puiser une énergie que  nous ignorions avoir. D'autre part, lorsque nous nous sentons agités ou incapables de nous détendre, la méditation apporte un bien-être physique qui détend le corps.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"uftbm9vjuw","text":"\u003cb\u003eEffects de la méditation sur les émotions\u003c/b\u003e","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"aicmw46e758","text":"On peut parfois avoir l'impression d'avoir peu de contrôle sur nos émotions mais la méditation nous donne la capacité de nous libérer spontanément des émotions négatives du moment, graduellement pour celles qui sont plus enfouies car elle favorise les émotions positives. En utilisant la nouvelle conscience reliée à notre système subtil qui gère toute notre activité émotionnelle, on a la garantie d'avoir une état émotionnel sain sans analyse ou effort particuliers.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"h9you94srok","text":"On a souvent du mal à exprimer ou à identifier nos émotions mais par la méditation, on peut facilement mesurer notre état émotionnel et en corriger les déséquilibres. Par la pratique régulière de la méditation, on devient sensible aux blocages subtils sur notre système subtil, blocages qui nous empêchent de nous sentir joyeux, inspiré, en sécurité. Avec le temps, on peut vraiment renforcer nos centres d'énergie, comme les études scientifiques le montrent:  ceux qui méditent sont moins sujets aux émotions négatives, et plus naturellement enclins aux émotions positives.[1]","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"ni97bb36jae","text":"Ressentir des émotions négatives fait partie  de la vie quotidienne. Mais si on est incapable de les gérer, on peut se retrouver pris dans un cycle d'émotions négatives. En réalité, quand on éprouve de la tristesse, de l'insécurité, de la culpabilité, de la peur ou de la colère, on ne ressent pas notre soi véritable. La méditation nous permet de nous détacher de ces émotions, nous laissant libre d'apprécier notre vraie nature.","type":"text"}},{"type":"media","data":{"id":"j4ntc8vn7or","items":[{"image":{"id":666,"preview":"https://assets.wemeditate.co/uploads/media_file/file/666/small_ac511ba10b.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""}],"type":"image","quantity":"single","position":"center","size":"normal","mediaFiles":[666],"decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"s8mjwutdnci","text":"Méditation et santé","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"bbjo0twhuct","text":"La méditation est en accord avec une approche holistique de la santé car elle influence tous les domaines de notre bien-être. Souvent, les problèmes de santé que nous avons ne se confinent pas aux symptômes physiques, mentaux ou émotionnels dont on a conscience. Par exemple, beaucoup des douleurs et des maux que l'on éprouve au niveau physique résultent en fait d'un stress mental ou émotionnel qui provoque des blocages sur le système nerveux central. Par conséquent, traiter seulement les symptômes physiques est souvent une approche inefficace.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"caala2ajomd","text":"En se connectant à notre système subtil, on peut avoir une image globale de notre bien-être et traiter toutes les questions à la racine du problème. Plus on expérimente l'état de silence mental, plus on devient sensible à l'activité de notre système nerveux central. Ceci nous permet de détecter les petits déséquilibres intérieurs et de les corriger en douceur avant qu'ils n'amènent à des problèmes à long terme.","type":"text"}},{"type":"action","data":{"id":"o9n19wo0nxi","action":"Try Online Guided Meditation","url":"/meditations","type":"button","decorations":{"leaves":true}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"ymekhsei0ms","text":"Un des plus grands avantages de la méditation pour rester en bonne santé, c'est que c'est complètement naturel et que cela ne coûte rien!  La Méditation de  Sahaja Yoga est la pratique qui axée sur le silence mental, elle n'a pas d'effet secondaire négatif. Elle est sans danger et s'adresse à tous, à tout âge et antécédent médical. Tout le monde peut essayer les Méditations de Sahaja Yoga guidées en ligne, gratuitement. Des cours sont disponibles dans des centaines de villes dans le monde entier, et toujours entièrement gratuites.","type":"text"}},{"type":"action","data":{"id":"n70rxmj48hd","action":"Find a Class Near Me","url":"/page/classes-near-me","type":"button","decorations":{"leaves":true}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"4j4n2n6pelb","text":"Études sur la Méditation","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"eybit3mi0x5","text":"Des études menées sur les effets de la Méditation Sahaja Yoga ont montré qu'elles avaient un impact significatif sur la santé mentale, physique et émotionnelle.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"y9z359r02i","text":"Bien qu'il existe de nombreuses preuves autoproclamées qui soutiennent les effets bénéfiques de la méditation, le corpus de preuves empiriques rigoureuses est étonnamment petit, à l'appui de nombreuses formes de méditation. Comme l'a souligné le Dr Ramesh Manocha, cela est principalement dû à des idées inexactes sur la méditation en tant qu'activité \"visant à susciter un état de relaxation\", dont les conclusions mènent à une différence d'impact assez faible entre la méditation et le simple repos.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"012qajgkr4y6","text":"Cependant, lorsque la méditation est considérée comme un état de silence mental, comme dans la méditation Sahaja Yoga, elle obtient des résultats nettement supérieurs à ceux des techniques comparatives. Des études cliniques ont documenté les effets bénéfiques de la Méditation Sahaja Yoga pour les patients atteints d'épilepsie, d'hypertension artérielle, d'asthme, de symptômes de la ménopause, de troubles d'hyperactivité avec déficit de l'attention, d'anxiété et de stress lié au travail.[5]","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"g9kd8kqg626","text":",De plus, des études sur les effets de la Méditation Sahaja Yoga sur le cerveau montrent un changement prononcé dans les schémas d'ondes cérébrales, passant des ondes bêta de la pensée consciente éveillée aux ondes alpha et thêta qui dominent le cerveau pendant les périodes de relaxation profonde [6 ]. Plus important encore, la pratique à long terme de cette méditation s'est avérée augmenter la matière grise dans les régions du cerveau associées à une attention soutenue, à la maîtrise de soi, à la compassion et à la perception intéroceptive. [7]","type":"text"}},{"type":"media","data":{"id":"86vswecqjff","items":[{"image":{"id":668,"preview":"https://assets.wemeditate.co/uploads/media_file/file/668/small_3f39afe15f.png"},"alt":"","caption":"Zones où les méditants ont affiché un volume de matière grise plus important que les non-méditants","credit":""}],"type":"image","quantity":"single","position":"center","size":"normal","mediaFiles":[668],"decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"bavc15l6d3u","text":"Exercises de Méditation","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"jp0k9qryrv","text":"\u003cb\u003ePremières méditations\u003c/b\u003e","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"kzqg3jdgz2j","text":"Le premier exercice, lorsque vous commencez à méditer, c'est de suivre le protocole d'éveil de la \"Kundalini\", l'énergie vivante intérieur située dans le sacrum en bas de la colonne vertébrale.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"9zksi0wdnyg","text":"Ce processus simple et naturel d'éveil de cette énergie est communément appelé la Réalisation du Soi. Lorsque nous nous déconnectons de nos pensées, nous faisons l'expérience de la vraie nature de nous-mêmes et du monde qui nous entoure, au-delà de nos constructions mentales et de nos conditionnements.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"10upunf9vm3","text":"\u003cb\u003eDécouvrez la Réalisation du Soi maintenant avec cette méditation guidée toute simple.\u003c/b\u003e","type":"text"}},{"type":"catalog","data":{"id":"3p73dpoyw3d","title":"","items":[38],"type":"meditations","style":"image","decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"g391jp221nj","text":"\u003cb\u003eÉquilibrer ses chakras\u003c/b\u003e","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"7e8y96n2w3f","text":"Une fois que vous avez éveillé votre énergie intérieure par la Réalisation du Soi, vous vous connectez au système subtil, un réseau de centres d'énergie subtils ou chakras, qui  corresponde au niveau physique au système nerveux central. C'est grâce au nettoyage doux du système subtil que nous pouvons équilibrer nos chakras, ce qui équilibre le reste de nos activités mentales, émotionnelles et physiques.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"72jt5kpxoy5","text":"La Kundalini est une énergie nourrissante qui, lorsqu'elle est guidée vers un centre énergétique,  supprime toutes tensions ou blocages, afin d'équilibrer ce centre. Ces blocages se produisent lorsque nous subissons un choc physique ou émotionnel, c'est pourquoi certains centres mettent plus de temps à être rééquilibrés. Grâce à la méditation, nous pouvons équilibrer peu à peu l'ensemble de notre système subtil sans avoir à analyser les chose ni essayer de faire un retour sur notre passé.","type":"text"}},{"type":"media","data":{"id":"ltrgltqyex","items":[{"image":{"id":674,"preview":"https://assets.wemeditate.co/uploads/media_file/file/674/small_5c1937fe41.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"Diagramme des centres d'énergie du système subtil\n","credit":""}],"type":"image","quantity":"single","position":"right","size":"normal","mediaFiles":[674],"decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"hrznsbkbke","text":"En équilibrant un chakra, nous développons les qualités liées à ce centre énergétique. Par exemple, notre chakra du cœur, nous pouvons automatiquement nous sentir plus en sécurité et capables d'aimer inconditionnellement. Grâce à la pratique régulière de la méditation, nous devenons de plus en plus sensibles à l'activité de notre système subtil.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"dr9xsmcb5k","text":"Un système subtil équilibré nous permet de vivre des périodes de conscience sans pensée plus longues et plus profondes. Le plus grand avantage de la conscience sans pensée, c' est de vivre une expérience vraiment sublime de joie pure intérieure. Cette joie inconditionnelle renforce notre personnalité et transmet un épanouissement dans la vie.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"x62gztixfoe","text":"\u003ca href=\"https://wemeditate.co/subtle-system\"\u003eDiscover more about the Subtle System\u003c/a\u003e","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"k59sr6ldix","text":"\u003cb\u003eMéditation quotidienne\u003c/b\u003e","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"m8mqwh9mi9o","text":"Méditer quotidiennement est essentiel pour maintenir l'équilibre de votre système. Cela peut sembler un gros engagement, mais quelques minutes de méditation par jour suffisent pour lancer l'effet domino et amélioration notre état intérieur. Plus vous connaîtrez souvent l'état de conscience sans pensée, moins vous serez susceptible d’être choqué ou maltraité par les aléas de la vie car la source de votre joie ou de votre équilibre ne sera plus extérieure. Et donc plus votre expérience de méditation est facile et profonde.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"ux41mjqasfn","text":"Il peut être difficile au début d’établir une routine pour cette nouvelle activité. C’est pourquoi il est suggéré de tenter l’expérience pendant quinze jours ou un mois pour l’établir.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"27pwziz8gc1","text":"Au début, un peu de discipline peut être nécessaire, mais plus vous ressentez les avantages de la méditation, plus elle deviendra facile. Une fois que votre système prend goût à ce soulagement quotidien de l’esprit, vous retrouverez avec plaisir ces moments personnels de méditation.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"mvlx20gpru","text":"Conseils pour la Méditation","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"4xug5nhsr0n","text":"\u003cb\u003eQue vous soyez complètement novice en méditation ou que vous pratiquiez depuis un certain temps, voici quelques conseils qui peuvent vraiment booster votre expérience et vous aider à atteindre la conscience sans pensée.\u003c/b\u003e","type":"text"}},{"type":"media","data":{"id":"bgcl9zjtk5","items":[{"image":{"id":670,"preview":"https://assets.wemeditate.co/uploads/media_file/file/670/small_b8551d1395.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""}],"type":"image","quantity":"single","position":"center","size":"normal","mediaFiles":[670],"decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"5p2mk3v70v3","text":"\u003cb\u003eQuand méditer?\u003c/b\u003e","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"nhxat9ae00o","text":"Les pratiquants expérimentés signalent que leurs meilleures méditations ont généralement lieu le matin au réveil, ou juste avant de se coucher.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"b272t0wtav","text":"Au réveil, avant de commencer les activités de la journée, il  y a moins d’activité mentale,   aussi il est plus facile  d’atteindre  l’état de conscience sans pensée. Le soir, lorsque l’on n’a plus rien à faire, quelques minutes de méditation sont un excellent moyen de se débarrasser de toutes les pensées de la journée et de s’assurer une bonne nuit de sommeil.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"rnxq0vcuqwd","text":"Pour trouver le bon moment pour méditer, donnez-vous au moins une semaine pour voir comment vous vous sentez. L'esprit et le corps peuvent mettre un certain temps à s'adapter, alors continuez pendant un certain temps avant d'essayer autre chose.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"oq0plhbchs","text":"\u003cb\u003eOù méditer?\u003c/b\u003e","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"3uycsu3cr7k","text":"S'il est possible d'entrer en conscience sans pensée, où que vous soyez, il est vrai que certains environnements y sont plus propices que d'autres.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"9d9ez6avkh","text":"À la maison, essayez de vous créer un petit espace, suffisamment calme et peu chargé. Si vous êtes très entourés,  votre chambre sera parfaite pour vous sentir à l'aise sans être dérangé.","type":"text"}},{"type":"media","data":{"id":"oyxpysd7bb7","items":[{"image":{"id":669,"preview":"https://assets.wemeditate.co/uploads/media_file/file/669/small_0c3dbfc06b.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""}],"type":"image","quantity":"single","position":"center","size":"normal","mediaFiles":[669],"decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"fy90moc5m3r","text":"La méditation en plein air peut être une expérience très spéciale, car elle nous permet d'être plus connectés à la nature. S'asseoir directement sur le sol pendant la méditation permet à l'élément terre d’absorber les énergies négatives qui sont en nous. Respirer de l'air frais calme le corps et à apporte de l'oxygène au cerveau. Si vous vivez près de la mer ou d'une rivière, méditer les pieds dans l’eau permet de se  libérer d’un excès de chaleur et de stress.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"5s0vandwzrk","text":"\u003cb\u003eMusique et méditation\u003c/b\u003e","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"p4r0q777hj","text":"La musique peut être d'une grande aide pour la méditation. Certaines musiques   qui agissent sur le système nerveux central, favorisent en effet un état méditatif. C'est pourquoi certains genres de musique sont plus propices à la méditation que d'autre.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"qr4edv7bbjr","text":"Avoir une bonne sélection de musique de méditation à la demande est un excellent moyen de vous permettre d'avoir une session rapide où que vous soyez. Au travail, dans le parc, en déplacement - il suffit de brancher vos écouteurs et de laisser le monde s'évanouir.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"cij2tgnq6gp","text":"Nous avons créé une sélection de musiques spécialement conçues pour élever votre expérience de la méditation.","type":"text"}},{"type":"action","data":{"id":"tfqg78bkiv","action":"Listen to music for meditation","url":"","type":"button","decorations":{"leaves":true}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"q3xlsvewdp9","text":"\u003cb\u003eMéditer en groupe\u003c/b\u003e","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"h42cu8f4xn","text":"Méditer en groupe donne un énorme coup de pouce à votre expérience individuelle. En effet, dans groupe, quand tout le monde a l’attention à l'intérieur et est conscience sans pensée, l'impact énergétique peut être beaucoup plus important que lorsque vous faites le même exercice tout seul.","type":"text"}},{"type":"media","data":{"id":"iag6xvsaudf","items":[{"image":{"id":671,"preview":"https://assets.wemeditate.co/uploads/media_file/file/671/small_8c7f2d184f.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""}],"type":"image","quantity":"single","position":"center","size":"normal","mediaFiles":[671],"decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"22t0i9u7mii","text":"Assister à un cours local vous permet d'approfondir votre expérience de la méditation, et  aussi d'obtenir l'attention personnelle de pratiquants expérimentés et de poser toutes les questions que vous pourriez avoir. Partager vos expériences avec d'autres personnes est un excellent moyen d'améliorer votre compréhension des mécanismes subtils en nous, et de vous connecter avec d'autres personnes à un niveau plus élevé que celui des interactions quotidiennes normales.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"t9w2tzwdet","text":"Un cours hebdomadaire local peut également être une bonne source de motivation pour vous encourager à poursuivre vos méditations quotidiennes à la maison. Inspirez-vous des expériences des autres et faites-vous de nouveaux amis avec des objectifs communs.","type":"text"}},{"type":"action","data":{"id":"vl2imwlul3","action":"Find a class near me","url":"","type":"button","decorations":{"leaves":true}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"agot33fxdxd","text":"Méditation et Religion","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"9l4wulqn96e","text":"Les premiers écrits faisant allusion à la pratique de la méditation apparaissent vers 1500 avant notre ère: ce sont les Védas, les anciens textes sanscrits fondateurs de l'hindouisme. Et vers 400 avant notre ère, Patanjali rédige le plus ancien exposé systématique sur le Yoga, les Yoga sutras, où le but ultime de la pratique de la méditation est  la destruction de l'ignorance et la réalisation de sa vraie nature, le Soi.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"23n4ej5x8dk","text":"La méditation est également une pratique clé du bouddhisme en tant que moyen d'illumination. Ici, l'objectif principal du méditant est de prendre le contrôle de son esprit pour devenir plus paisible, concentré et conscient.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"x7zh92kh7mb","text":"Et dans la plupart des religions, ainsi dans le judaisme, le christianisme, et l’Islam (en particulier dans le soufisme), il existe un état qui est appelé \"recueillement\",  ou bien \"contemplation\" où le silence est la base pour calmer le cœur et se connecter à son Dieu.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"gqjcoi8nuvc","text":"La méditation fait donc partie des pratiques religieuses dans le monde, mais n'est pas en soi une religion. C'est un moyen d'être connecté à soi-même et à la dimension fondamentale de l'humanité.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"4lirsgk0n2j","text":"Méditation et Yoga","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"6nuziy93ct7","text":"Beaucoup associent le terme \"yoga\" à une série de postures et d'exercices qui augmentent la force physique et la flexibilité. Mais l'activité moderne telle que nous la connaissons a des origines bien plus profondes. Le yoga est un mot sanscrit qui signifie littéralement \"union\", une connexion avec la réalité universelle. Les exercices que nous connaissons ne sont qu'une très petite partie des pratiques anciennes conçues pour réaliser cette union expérientielle.","type":"text"}},{"type":"media","data":{"id":"t7tbi1m4v1","items":[{"image":{"id":672,"preview":"https://assets.wemeditate.co/uploads/media_file/file/672/small_60038a5cdb.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""}],"type":"image","quantity":"single","position":"right","size":"normal","mediaFiles":[672],"decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"9zuiolbvzx4","text":"C’est Patanjali qui a en premier systématisé dans les Aphorismes du Yoga en 500 avant JC en le yoga comme étant une combinaison de facteurs liés au mode de vie, d'exercices psychophysiologiques, d'observances ethniques et de perspectives métaphysiques. Puis, le yoga a été contenu au sein de petits groupes d'élites mystiques en Inde pendant des milliers d'années. Ceux qui se sont montrés dignes de recevoir un enseignement aussi précieux ont dû subir des austérités et faire preuve de dévouement avant que certains soient capables de vivre le véritable état de yoga.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"bftxmp3bxt4","text":"Ce n'est qu'à partir du début du XIVe siècle environ que le yoga a émergé d'une manière qui pouvait être compréhensible. Depuis des siècles, les pratiques, la méditation et les exercices physiques ont été les éléments les plus courants pour atteindre les populations dominantes, en commençant par l'Inde, la Chine et le Japon, puis se répandant à travers le monde occidental ces dernières années.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"8gvb9py9lw7","text":"Bien que le yoga physique soit devenu un élément populaire de la forme physique et du mode de vie modernes, il était d'abord un moyen de se préparer à la pratique de la méditation. D'autre part, il faudrait connaître l'état subtil de ses chakras pour pouvoir exécuter les positions ou asanas ayant un effet bénéfique voire curatif sur ceux-ci.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"7zen6e3pqqj","text":"Cet état, où le mental est complètement silencieux mais éveillé, se produit lorsque la fontanelle, est transpercé par l’énergie vivante Kundalini. En ce moment, la conscience du méditant dépasse le mental et se confond avec l'énergie universelle qui nous entoure. C’est un processus spontané que tous les êtres humains sont capables de vivre.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"1mmhp0i9439h","text":"Méditation et Connaissance de soi","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"ccjj8l0zecj","text":"Chez les psychologues et les philosophes, la connaissance de soi est un aspect clé pour trouver le bonheur dans la vie. Le philosophe grec Socrate, lorsqu'on lui a demandé de résumer toutes ses connaissances et sa sagesse en un point clé à retenir, il a répondu \"connais-toi toi-même\".","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"iokhgp253wo","text":"Mais qu'est-ce que la connaissance de soi? En psychologie, cela signifie les informations auxquelles l'individu se réfère lorsqu'il répond à la question: \"Qui suis-je?\". Mais d'où viennent ces informations? Souvent, pour nous définir, nous nous référons à ce que nous connaissons comme fondement de notre environnement: notre nationalité, notre appartenance ethnique, notre travail, notre famille ou nos intérêts. Mais la connaissance de soi signifie comprendre notre nature intrinsèque en tant qu'individus - ce qui nous motive, ce qui nous émeut et ce qui nous satisfait.","type":"text"}},{"type":"media","data":{"id":"ic8balqod7n","items":[{"image":{"id":673,"preview":"https://assets.wemeditate.co/uploads/media_file/file/673/small_f330d6fe9c.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""}],"type":"image","quantity":"single","position":"left","size":"normal","mediaFiles":[673],"decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"a0jdivz608n","text":"Ces questions peuvent être difficiles à comprendre sur le plan mental, et en effet les idées que nous pouvons avoir sur nous-mêmes sont aussi influencées par nos émotions.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"ghql0z1kzgv","text":"Mais ce que nous sommes, ce n'est pas seulement cela, au niveau de la méditation, c'est ce qui bloque un chakra ou le frais qui en ressort qui nous indique qui nous sommes vraiment, que sont nos défauts et qualités.  Par conséquent, en sentant simplement où nos énergies sont concentrées, nous pouvons comprendre quel genre de personne nous sommes et ce dont nous avons besoin pour nous équilibrer et nous sentir joyeux et épanouis dans la vie.","type":"text"}},{"type":"action","data":{"id":"volk19t6je","action":"Meditate Now","url":"/meditations","type":"button","decorations":{"leaves":true}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"gaoahsnjhbl","text":"\u003cb\u003eReferences\u003c/b\u003e","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"54h2m3f1col","text":"[1] Sergei V. Pavlov et al, “Impact of long-term meditation practice on cardiovascular reactivity during perception and reappraisal of affective images”, International Journal of Psychophysiology 95 (2015) 363-371","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"s1dptlk685","text":"[2] Mishra R et al, “Plasma beta endorphin levels in humans: effect of Sahaja Yoga.”, Paper presented at the “Medical Aspects of Sahaja Yoga”, Medical conference, held in New Delhi India, 1993.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"i8qk9ufouw","text":"[3] Manocha R. et al, “A Randomized, Controlled Trial of Meditation for Work Stress, Anxiety and Depressed Mood in Full-Time Workers.”, Evidence-Based Complementary and Alternative Medicine. Volume 2011","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"8mbyfbvnlqi","text":"[4] Rai U.C. et al, “Some effects of Sahaja Yoga and its role in the prevention of stress disorders.”, Journal of International Medical Sciences 1988, 19-23","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"ny26bdi30w","text":"[5] Manocha R. et al, “Sahaja Yoga: Reconciling Western Science and Eastern Traditions of Meditation”, Australian Journal of Clinical Hypnotherapy and Hypnosis; Spring 2005; 26, 1/2; PsycINFO","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"ci13b7235te","text":"[6] Aftanas, L.I., \u0026amp; Golocheikine, S.A. translations.name: Ի՞նչ է մեդիտացիան
translations.content: {"time":1587475519202,"blocks":[{"type":"media","data":{"id":"pj30jsqtqpd","items":[{"image":{"id":653,"preview":"https://assets.wemeditate.co/uploads/media_file/file/653/small_155ee94d14.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""}],"type":"image","quantity":"single","position":"center","size":"normal","mediaFiles":[653],"decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"4tolvh65dhl","text":"Մեդիտացիան օր օրի դառնում է տարածված պրակտիկա, որն օգտագործում են բոլոր տարիքի և ազգության մարդիկ ՝ ներքին խաղաղություն հաստատելու և սեփական բարեկեցությունը բարելավելու համար: Պարզ տեխնիկայի միջոցով դուք կարող եք զգալ հսկայական առավելություններ, ինչպիսիք են ՝ նվազեցված սթրեսը և ինքնաբուխ ուրախությունը: Այստեղ մենք առաջարկում ենք ամբողջական ուղեցույց ՝ հասկանալու, թե ինչ է մեդիտացիան և ինչպես դա կարող է օգնել ձեզ:","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"03a8fuglobfg","text":"Մեդիտացիայի սահմանումը","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"5lyp9wpwu5","text":"\u003cb\u003eՄաքրելով Ձեր միտքը\u003c/b\u003e","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"9rqmnsv09bw","text":"Պարզապես, մեդիտացիան անմիտք գիտակցության վիճակ է, որն ի հայտ է գալիս այն ժամանակ, երբ միտքը լուռ է, բայց արթուն: Դա գործողություն չէ, այլ խորը խաղաղության վիճակ՝ զերծ մտքի անընդմեջ գործունեությունից:","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"j8qwsjjg93g","text":"Կարող եք ցանկացած պահի կատարել մեդիտացիա, անկախ նրանից, նստած եք լոտոսի դիրքում, թե մտածում եք ձեր ամենօրյա գործունեության մասին: Մաքուր միտքը թույլ է տալիս հասնել ավելի բարձր տեղեկացվածության, ապրել ներկա պահը և դրանով իսկ հասնել ձեր իրական ներուժին:","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"k159z1lwchd","text":"\u003cb\u003eMeditation debunked\u003c/b\u003e","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"w3bd4un9hj","text":"Meditation is often associated with many practices which can help you to feel more calm, but are not the true experience of meditation. Engaging in such practices might provide a temporary escape from our usual thought patterns, but do not have a profound lasting effect on our state.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"s60cqeokui","text":"Some techniques involve concentrating on a particular sound, object or idea. However this still occupies the mind and therefore does not free the attention.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"hpfeerdr6cq","text":"Other methods employ physical exercises such as postures or breathing. While these may help to relax the body and establish a more peaceful mood, they are not sufficient to bring about a state of true thoughtlessness.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"sv2pc8e9mq","text":"Practitioners of certain types of meditation report sounds, voices, colours or even involuntary movements. However, these are symptoms of a loss of control over some part of ourselves and prevent one from reaching a pure state of silence within.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"cwoswio0eq","text":"\u003cb\u003eMeditation vs. mindfulness\u003c/b\u003e","type":"text"}},{"type":"media","data":{"id":"rkiqguh26l","items":[{"image":{"id":659,"preview":"https://assets.wemeditate.co/uploads/media_file/file/659/small_72229acd1c.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""}],"type":"image","quantity":"single","position":"right","size":"normal","mediaFiles":[659],"decorations":{"triangle":{"alignment":"left"}}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"ikvjr8tb4v7","text":"Mindfulness meditation is a practice which involves paying close attention to the present moment without any judgment. The technique is viewed as a training of the mind in order to promote mindfulness during the day. It does not, however, place any emphasis on emptying the mind.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"gmsaifds099","text":"While the practice of mindfulness may help you to distance yourself from negative thoughts and emotions, it does not remove them, nor does it prevent them from occurring. The training of the mind is in fact a mental effort, and therefore does not bring the relief of a silent mind.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"6gpqqoboyk","text":"It is true that many report the personal benefits of mindfulness, but the practice still lacks convincing empirical evidence and is subject to much hype and misinformation. Furthermore, in some cases the continuous focused attention on one’s thoughts and feelings has led to a state of paranoia and anxiety.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"z6qe597ho","text":"Meditation, on the other hand, spontaneously cleanses the mind of negative thought patterns. The state of thoughtless awareness brings with it a sense of peace and detached joy. Thus the occurrence of negative thoughts and emotions is naturally reduced without effort. Even experiencing a few seconds of a pure meditative state can have astonishingly long-lasting effects.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"x5tqr3ramj8","text":"Why Meditate","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"8ncdcov4s86","text":"\u003cb\u003eThe power of meditation\u003c/b\u003e","type":"text"}},{"type":"media","data":{"id":"ud1d8idw3a","items":[{"image":{"id":662,"preview":"https://assets.wemeditate.co/uploads/media_file/file/662/small_db1e16e636.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""}],"type":"image","quantity":"single","position":"right","size":"normal","mediaFiles":[662],"decorations":{"triangle":false}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"c4tvyt8arww","text":"Modern life is full of obstacles which prevent us from experiencing a joyful, peaceful state throughout the day. Stress, anxiety and depression are just a few of the symptoms of lives overloaded with thoughts.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"sppcf3arjt","text":"Meditation has the power to relieve you of all weights and tensions on the mental, emotional and physical levels. Thus, through simple techniques your wellbeing and overall enjoyment of life can be vastly improved.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"cfkgdho9bj6","text":"In a state where you are free from worries and insecurities, your true nature is revealed. Like a child you can easily express and receive love, providing fulfilment for yourself and those around you.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"wwq5wrcz8wm","text":"\u003cb\u003eInner growth\u003c/b\u003e","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"kmzgg3pkvci","text":"Everyone has the potential to become the best versions of themselves; all you need are the tools to achieve this. Qualities which you’ve long aspired to, such as confidence and or creativity, are actually naturally occurring in all human beings. Only, some more than others experience mental or emotional barriers that inhibit us from expressing those qualities.","type":"text"}},{"type":"textbox","data":{"id":"ee5d038iedj","image":"Drag images here to upload","title":"","text":"","action":"","url":"","type":"image","background":"white","color":"dark","position":"left","spacing":"overlap","mediaFiles":null,"decorations":{"triangle":{"alignment":"left"}}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"2hk2a2f7zkp","text":"Through a natural and spontaneous process, meditation goes right to the core of the inner blockages which prevent us from becoming the person we want to be. By relieving the tensions that are occurring on the most subtle levels of our central nervous system, that we are often unaware of, our true potential is revealed.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"o3p5rrs3wjr","text":"Many practitioners of regular meditation report their great surprise at the personal transformation which they experience, often noting the ease and rapidity of their inner growth. More importantly, it is an enjoyable process which does not involve any mental analysis. While introspection is important to achieving personal growth, it merely encompasses observation of our meditation experiences rather than any kind of psychotherapy.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"4vgqqh3geq8","text":"The Benefits of Meditation","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"9hqy2turdz","text":"\u003cb\u003eMeditation is the solution for many common problems which disrupt our daily lives\u003c/b\u003e","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"ilosokb2mt","text":"\u003cb\u003eMeditation for stress\u003c/b\u003e\u003cb\u003e \u003c/b\u003e","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"10la3j8ksiun","text":"Stress occurs when we are unable to relieve our minds of thoughts about the past or the future and focus on what is happening right now. We can often come up with many justifications for allowing our mind to wonder: this thing is very important; if I don’t think about it, who will?","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"1diw2pn2f1h","text":"But ultimately, stress does not help us to achieve anything now. An overworked mind is not efficient or dynamic. What's more, it has a direct detrimental effect on our physical and emotional wellbeing.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"8zfm7l2w6os","text":"Emptying the mind and removing stress from our system allows you to focus on what needs to be done now. Thus you can steadily yet effectively move towards achieving our goals while maintaining balance.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"7mknwz3pn3e","text":"\u003cb\u003eTry this short guided meditation to calm your mind and reduce stress.\u003c/b\u003e","type":"text"}},{"type":"catalog","data":{"id":"fkhpyhmzzha","title":"","items":[21],"type":"meditations","style":"image","decorations":{"sidetext":false}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"mxv4olh46ph","text":"\u003cb\u003eMeditation for anxiety\u003c/b\u003e","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"l0lbuyzn53","text":"Anxiety hits when we are nervous or apprehensive about something with an uncertain outcome. In severe cases it can lead to panic attacks. Whether it is concerning studies, work or family, many things that have a large impact on our daily life are out of our control.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"ltp1ig0sx9n","text":"Uncertainty always has and always will be a part of human life. However, in an ever-increasingly competitive world, the ability to cope with this fact is becoming more and more difficult. Scientific studies show that meditators are better able to cope with the anticipation of a negative event, lowering the impact of the event when it occurs. [1]","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"n6v2vkace0n","text":"Meditation provides a sense of security and detachment which soothes feelings of anxiety and fosters an outlook of acceptance. Therefore when unexpected outcomes or changes arise, you are in a state which allows you to deal with the new circumstances, free from the weight of anxiety that might have preceded them.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"4wrseyajthf","text":"\u003cb\u003eTry this short guided meditation to relieve anxiety.\u003c/b\u003e","type":"text"}},{"type":"catalog","data":{"id":"2ujcx11a1jl","title":"","items":[15],"type":"meditations","style":"image","decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"81lbxajvm3u","text":"\u003cb\u003eMeditation for depression\u003c/b\u003e","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"ellc90ez69r","text":"Depression is much more than just feeling a bit down and unmotivated. Sufferers of depression experience recurrent periods of negative moods which may last for days, weeks, months or even years. Symptoms of depression include sadness, anger, guilt, fatigue, lack of self-worth and a general lack of interest in day-to-day life.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"8beu5ohb8zm","text":"In some cases depression is triggered by a particular negative event, such as the loss of a loved one or redundancy, but often it is hard for a sufferer to pinpoint exactly why they’ve lost the joy in their life and escape the cycle of negativity.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"wmam1nsp6tc","text":"Meditation allows you to detach from any negative thoughts and emotions which are weighing you down, and naturally corrects the internal imbalances which are causing them to occur. Furthermore, studies show that when we reach a state of mental silence we activate the limbic area of the brain which releases the neurochemicals which cause us to feel love and joy [2].","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"ggrfzn9ybt","text":"Free from your thoughts you can experience a spontaneous state of bliss which does not rely on any external stimulus.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"m40wk790ic","text":"\u003cb\u003eTry this short guided meditation to lift depression and experience pure joy.\u003c/b\u003e","type":"text"}},{"type":"catalog","data":{"id":"odbp66ajw3h","title":"","items":[12],"type":"meditations","style":"image","decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"glq157v4m5l","text":"\u003cb\u003eMeditation for sleep\u003c/b\u003e","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"plfbavzxa3f","text":"Ever had difficulty dropping off at night? You’re not alone. Around 30% of the US population report some level of insomnia, due to stress, anxiety and depression. Often a sufferer of insomnia is actually unaware of exactly what is causing the lack of sleep, leading to frustration and worry.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"4rnihjyi4c","text":"While lying awake at night is an unpleasant experience in itself, it also leads to fatigue during the day, which brings a host of other problems such as lack of focus, irritability, and severe mood swings. Something so small can quickly lead to a deterioration in physical, mental and emotional wellbeing and greatly reduce our overall enjoyment of life.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"ja4tuya7yv","text":"Meditation not only helps to relieve the symptoms of insomnia, but also goes straight to the cause of the condition. By removing subtle imbalances and stresses on our central nervous system, it facilitates complete relaxation of the mind and body. A few seconds of a true state of meditation, when we are in thoughtless awareness, can be enough to ensure a good night’s sleep.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"kdktu5tumo","text":"\u003cb\u003eTry this short guided meditation to facilitate restful sleep\u003c/b\u003e","type":"text"}},{"type":"catalog","data":{"id":"c8dt75g6x8d","title":"","items":[37],"type":"meditations","style":"image","decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"1slc3ob4h17","text":"The Science of Meditation","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"il0g1daaufa","text":"While mediation is an ancient practice, associated with many religious and cultural beliefs, it is also a verified scientific process with direct effects","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"nj3l1ruysdn","text":"\u003cb\u003eMeditation and the central nervous system\u003c/b\u003e","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"ol19gamrcin","text":"The practice of true meditation works on our central nervous system, which controls all of the physical, mental and emotional activities within us. By correcting any imbalances within this system, we can remove any obstacles which prevent us from experiencing a state of mental silence.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"rs5odfydzpa","text":"\u003cb\u003eThe sympathetic and parasympathetic nervous systems\u003c/b\u003e","type":"text"}},{"type":"media","data":{"id":"8uoef4dxc1b","items":[{"image":{"id":661,"preview":"https://assets.wemeditate.co/uploads/media_file/file/661/small_f261552509.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"Diagram of the autonomic nervous system","credit":""}],"type":"image","quantity":"single","position":"left","size":"normal","mediaFiles":[661],"decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"ydsuog9duyi","text":"The autonomic nervous system is divided into three channels: left, right and center. The left and right channels form the sympathetic nervous system, which is responsible for all of our ‘fight or flight’ responses which are engaged for our daily activities. The central channel is the parasympathetic nervous system, which governs our ‘rest and digest’ responses, usually activated when we sleep.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"2sgtqeym1lx","text":"The aim of meditation is to reduce activity in the sympathetic nervous system, i.e. remove stress and imbalances, and to activate the parasympathetic nervous system, bringing complete rest to the mind and body. A truly meditative state, where the mind is completely silent, has actually been proven to activate this system more than normal rest.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"zbttyooyvlp","text":"\u003cb\u003eEnergy centres\u003c/b\u003e","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"o9kgku9o3sp","text":"Also part of this central nervous system are nerve plexuses, or energy centres, placed along our spine where the nerves intersect. These plexuses govern specific functions of our brain and body, and it is for this reason that energy centres - ‘Chakras’-  are associated with certain qualities, determined by the nerves which meet there.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"1w3vozr97q4","text":"By guiding the living energy within us to the centers where we are experiencing a problem, we can naturally and effortlessly address imbalances of the most subtle nature.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"kkpsrlx1bza","text":"This balancing effect takes place when we connect to the dormant energy that lies at the base of our spine, called in Sanskrit as ‘\u003ca href=\"https://wemeditate.co/subtle-system/kundalini\"\u003eKundalini\u003c/a\u003e’, which nourishes and cleanses our system of any blockages. This energy has been referred to in all ancient cultures and religions, and its existence can be experienced through meditation.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"dbpp5v25o0l","text":"Discover more about the \u003ca href=\"https://wemeditate.co/subtle-system\"\u003ecentral nervous system\u003c/a\u003e.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"iicmhy88aw","text":"The Effects of Meditation","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"097kv3tflyu4","text":"\u003cb\u003eThe effects of meditation are far-reaching and multi-faceted.\u003c/b\u003e","type":"text"}},{"type":"media","data":{"id":"cp8qb7d4yn6","items":[{"image":{"id":663,"preview":"https://assets.wemeditate.co/uploads/media_file/file/663/small_08437aadce.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""}],"type":"image","quantity":"single","position":"center","size":"normal","mediaFiles":[663],"decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"u1sfy9pwqca","text":"\u003cb\u003eEffects of meditation on the mind\u003c/b\u003e","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"whv2isegede","text":"Meditation is an incredibly powerful and efficient tool for clearing your mind. Thoughts come when we are reflecting on the past, or considering the future. Meditation silences the mind and brings us into the present moment, allowing us to simply witness without reacting.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"ugdx00yam79","text":"Thoughts come through the mind as waves, and so the more active our mind is, the smaller the gap between one thought receding and another thought approaching. The regular practice of meditation extends this gap until we are able to experience noticeable periods where we have no thoughts at all.","type":"text"}},{"type":"media","data":{"id":"fw3vchb77ao","items":[],"type":"image","quantity":"single","position":"center","size":"normal","mediaFiles":[],"decorations":{"triangle":{"alignment":"right"}}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"5n1wfcqmm79","text":"Just a few seconds of being completely thoughtless is enough to entirely relax the mind, the effects of which last beyond the meditation session. With repeated periods of thoughtlessness, the mind actually becomes less prone to overactivity. A calmer mind reduces occurrences of worrying, stress and anxiety.[3]","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"2k6qj2hv11","text":"Another characteristic of a calm mind is joy! We experience pure joy when we are not thinking about anything, as we feel completely fulfilled. Although meditation is a soothing process, many practitioners report the sensation of bubbling joy within at the moment of thoughtless awareness.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"2h6qkoqe2dn","text":"\u003cb\u003e Effects of meditation on the body\u003c/b\u003e","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"ecdv34gq88i","text":"On the physical level, meditation can serve as a great source of relief from any tensions, pains, heaviness or agitation that we may be feeling. The immediate effects of meditation on the body can be felt as a relaxation of the muscles, a slowing in breathing, and an overall lightness.","type":"text"}},{"type":"media","data":{"id":"73v8pzybtjd","items":[{"image":{"id":664,"preview":"https://assets.wemeditate.co/uploads/media_file/file/664/small_bebf8f59e1.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"Respiratory rates for practitioners of Sahaja Yoga meditation [4]","credit":""}],"type":"image","quantity":"single","position":"left","size":"normal","mediaFiles":[664],"decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"wa3v1krawe","text":"In a controlled randomised test, subjects practising Sahaja Yoga meditation saw a consistent fall in their respiratory rate during meditation. The effect was more pronounced the longer the individual had been practising meditation.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"8razjr7emrq","text":"When meditation is practiced regularly, more long-term imbalances can be corrected by working on our central nervous system. Problems such as hypertension, insomnia and asthma can all be significantly reduced or even eradicated by going to the very core of the problem, as opposed to merely treating the symptoms.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"b13k9nlb3f","text":"Meditation is also a great tool for balancing our energy levels and bringing the body into a more centered state. When we find ourselves feeling tired, heavy or lacking in energy, meditation can refresh our system and tap into energy we didn’t know we had. On the other hand, when we are feeling restless, agitated or unable to relax, meditation brings calm and relief to the body.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"uftbm9vjuw","text":"\u003cb\u003eEffects of meditation on emotions\u003c/b\u003e","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"aicmw46e758","text":"It can sometimes feel like we have little control over our emotions, but meditation gives us the ability to naturally and spontaneously cleanse ourselves of negative emotions and foster positive emotions. By working on the central nervous system, which governs all of our emotional activity, we can ensure ourselves a healthy emotional state without any particular effort or analysis.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"h9you94srok","text":"Emotions are often difficult to articulate or identify, but through meditation we can easily gauge our emotional state and correct any imbalances. Through the regular practice of meditation we can become sensitive to the subtle blockages on our central nervous system which prevent us from feeling joyful, inspired, secure and open-hearted. Over time we can actually strengthen our energy centers, as illustrated by studies show that meditators are less susceptible to negative emotions, and more naturally prone to positive emotions.[1]","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"ni97bb36jae","text":"Experiencing negative emotions is a natural part of everyday life, but without an effective way of dealing with them we can get stuck in a negative emotional cycle. In reality, when we experience sadness, insecurity, guilt, fear or anger, we are not experiencing our real selves. Meditation allows us to detach from these emotions, leaving us free to enjoy our true nature.","type":"text"}},{"type":"media","data":{"id":"j4ntc8vn7or","items":[{"image":{"id":666,"preview":"https://assets.wemeditate.co/uploads/media_file/file/666/small_ac511ba10b.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""}],"type":"image","quantity":"single","position":"center","size":"normal","mediaFiles":[666],"decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"s8mjwutdnci","text":"Meditation and Health","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"bbjo0twhuct","text":"Meditation provides a holistic approach to health as it impacts all areas of our wellbeing. Often the health problems we have are not confined to the physical, mental or emotional symptoms that we are consciously aware of. For example, many aches and pains we feel on the physical level are actually caused by mental or emotional stress which causes blockages on the central nervous system. Therefore merely treating the physical symptoms is often an ineffective approach.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"caala2ajomd","text":"By connecting to our subtle system we can get an overall picture of our wellbeing, and address any issues from the root of the problem. The more frequently you experience the state of mental silence, the more sensitive you become to the activity on your central nervous system. This allows you to detect small imbalances within and gently correct them before they lead to any long-term issues.","type":"text"}},{"type":"action","data":{"id":"o9n19wo0nxi","action":"Try Online Guided Meditation","url":"/meditations","type":"button","decorations":{"leaves":true}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"ymekhsei0ms","text":"One of the greatest benefits of using meditation to keep yourself healthy and balanced is that it is completely natural and costs nothing! One practice which focuses on mental silence is Sahaja Yoga meditation, which contrary to other forms of medication, treatments and therapies has no known negative side effects. It is safe and suitable for everyone, of all ages and medical backgrounds. Anyone can try out Sahaja yoga online guided meditations for free, and Sahaja Yoga meditation classes are offered in hundreds of cities all around the world - always 100% free of charge.","type":"text"}},{"type":"action","data":{"id":"n70rxmj48hd","action":"Find a Class Near Me","url":"/page/classes-near-me","type":"button","decorations":{"leaves":true}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"4j4n2n6pelb","text":"Meditation Studies","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"eybit3mi0x5","text":"Studies conducted on the effects of Sahaja Yoga meditation have found it to have a significant impact on mental, physical and emotional health.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"y9z359r02i","text":"While there is a lot of self-reported evidence which supports the beneficial effects of meditation, the body of rigorous empirical evidence to back it up is surprisingly small for many forms of meditation. As pointed out by Dr Ramesh Manocha, this is mostly due to inaccurate ideas of meditation as an activity ‘aimed at eliciting a state of relaxation’ which lead to conclusions where meditation has little difference in impact than simple rest.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"012qajgkr4y6","text":"However, where meditation is taken as a state of mental silence, such as in Sahaja Yoga meditation, it has significantly greater results than comparative techniques. Clinical studies have documented beneficial effects of Sahaja yoga meditation for patients with epilepsy, essential hypertension, asthma, menopausal symptoms, attention deficit-hyperactivity disorder, anxiety and work-related stress.[5]","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"g9kd8kqg626","text":"Furthermore, studies of the effects of Sahaja Yoga meditation on the brain show a pronounced change in brain-wave patterns, shifting from the beta waves of aroused, conscious thought to the alpha and theta waves that dominate the brain during periods of deep relaxation [6]. More importantly, the long-term practice of this meditation have been proven to increased grey matter in regions of the brain which are associated with sustained attention, self-control, compassion and interoceptive perception. [7]","type":"text"}},{"type":"media","data":{"id":"86vswecqjff","items":[{"image":{"id":668,"preview":"https://assets.wemeditate.co/uploads/media_file/file/668/small_3f39afe15f.png"},"alt":"","caption":"Areas where meditators exhibited larger Grey Matter Volume than non-meditators","credit":""}],"type":"image","quantity":"single","position":"center","size":"normal","mediaFiles":[668],"decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"bavc15l6d3u","text":"Meditation Exercises","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"jp0k9qryrv","text":"\u003cb\u003eBasic meditation\u003c/b\u003e","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"kzqg3jdgz2j","text":"The first exercise when you start meditating is to awaken the living energy within you. This energy has been referred to in practically every ancient civilisation, called in Sanskrit as ‘Kundalini’, and it lies within the sacrum bone at the base of the spine.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"npkd2wvdkfo","text":"When this energy is raised through the energy centers along the spine and pierces the final energy center at the top of the head, we are brought spontaneously to a state of mental silence. This is the moment of true meditation.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"9zksi0wdnyg","text":"The simple and natural process of awakening this energy is commonly called as Self Realisation. When we disconnect from our thoughts we experience the true nature of ourselves and the world around us, beyond our mental constructs and conditionings.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"10upunf9vm3","text":"\u003cb\u003eExperience your Self Realisation now with this simple guided meditation.\u003c/b\u003e","type":"text"}},{"type":"catalog","data":{"id":"3p73dpoyw3d","title":"","items":[38],"type":"meditations","style":"image","decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"g391jp221nj","text":"\u003cb\u003eChakra Balancing\u003c/b\u003e","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"7e8y96n2w3f","text":"Once you have awakened your inner energy through Self Realisation, you get connected to the network of subtle energy centers- or Chakras - corresponding with your central nervous system. It is through the gentle cleansing of the central nervous system that we can balance our chakras, therefore balancing our mental, emotional and physical activities.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"72jt5kpxoy5","text":"The Kundalini is a nourishing energy which when guided towards an energy center will remove any tensions or blockages there, bringing that center into balance. These blockages occur when either physically, mentally or emotionally we are out of balance, causing a disturbance on the subtle level. Therefore, through meditation we can bring our whole system into balance without having to self-assess or mentally analyse.","type":"text"}},{"type":"media","data":{"id":"ltrgltqyex","items":[{"image":{"id":674,"preview":"https://assets.wemeditate.co/uploads/media_file/file/674/small_5c1937fe41.jpg"},"alt":"Diagram of energy centres on the central nervous system","caption":"Diagram of energy centres on the central nervous system","credit":""}],"type":"image","quantity":"single","position":"right","size":"normal","mediaFiles":[674],"decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"hrznsbkbke","text":"Balancing your chakras not only removes any blockages, but also naturally nourishes good qualities within us. For example, by balancing our heart chakra we can automatically feel more secure and able to love unconditionally. Through the regular practice of meditation we become more and more sensitive to the activity on our energetic level, empowering us to keep our systems in balance and strengthen our energy centers.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"dr9xsmcb5k","text":"The greatest benefit of a balanced subtle system is that it enables us to experience longer and deeper periods of thoughtless awareness. This is the real aim of balancing our chakras, as the state of thoughtless awareness is a truly sublime experience which brings us to a greater awareness of ourselves and gives an overall pure joy and fulfilment of everyday life.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"x62gztixfoe","text":"\u003ca href=\"https://wemeditate.co/subtle-system\"\u003eDiscover more about the Subtle System\u003c/a\u003e","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"k59sr6ldix","text":"\u003cb\u003eDaily meditation\u003c/b\u003e","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"m8mqwh9mi9o","text":"Meditating on a daily basis is key to keeping your system in balance. It might sound like a big commitment, but just a few minutes of meditation everyday is enough to kickstart the snowball effect of improving your inner state. The more often you reach the state of thoughtless awareness, the less likely you are to get out of balance in your daily life, and therefore the easier and deeper your meditation experience becomes.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"ux41mjqasfn","text":"It can be hard at first to incorporate a new activity into your routine, but the Kundalini is like a muscle - the more you use it the stronger it becomes. It is suggested that it can take up to a month to establish a new routine before you stop thinking about it.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"27pwziz8gc1","text":"At first a bit of discipline might be required, but the more you experience the benefits of meditation, the easier it becomes. Once your system gets used to this daily relief of the mind, meditating daily isn’t something you even have to think about, like brushing your teeth.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"mvlx20gpru","text":"Meditation Tips","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"4xug5nhsr0n","text":"\u003cb\u003eWhether you’re completely new to meditation, or have been practicing for a while, here are a few tips that can really boost your experience and help you to reach the state of thoughtless awareness.\u003c/b\u003e","type":"text"}},{"type":"media","data":{"id":"bgcl9zjtk5","items":[{"image":{"id":670,"preview":"https://assets.wemeditate.co/uploads/media_file/file/670/small_b8551d1395.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""}],"type":"image","quantity":"single","position":"center","size":"normal","mediaFiles":[670],"decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"5p2mk3v70v3","text":"\u003cb\u003eWhen to meditate\u003c/b\u003e","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"nhxat9ae00o","text":"Experienced practitioners report that their best meditations usually occur when they get up in the morning, or just before bed.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"b272t0wtav","text":"When you first wake up your brain hasn’t had a chance to get started yet, so you can reach thoughtless awareness more easily than when you have already started the day’s activities. In the evening, when you haven’t got anything left to do, a few minutes of meditation is a great way to cleanse yourself of all the day’s thoughts and ensure yourself a good night’s sleep.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"rnxq0vcuqwd","text":"Finding the right time for you to meditate might require a bit of experimentation, but give any new routine at least a week to see how you feel. The mind and the body can take some time to adjust, so keep at it for a while before you try something else.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"oq0plhbchs","text":"\u003cb\u003eWhere to meditate\u003c/b\u003e","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"3uycsu3cr7k","text":"While it is possible to go into thoughtless awareness literally anywhere you are, it is true that some environments can help this process more than others.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"9d9ez6avkh","text":"When meditating at home, try to have a dedicated space which is free from noise and clutter. If you have lots of housemates or family members your bedroom can be a great escape, or sometimes your living room can be more free of personal mess. The most important thing is that you feel comfortable and are unlikely to be disturbed.","type":"text"}},{"type":"media","data":{"id":"oyxpysd7bb7","items":[{"image":{"id":669,"preview":"https://assets.wemeditate.co/uploads/media_file/file/669/small_0c3dbfc06b.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""}],"type":"image","quantity":"single","position":"center","size":"normal","mediaFiles":[669],"decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"fy90moc5m3r","text":"Outdoor meditation can be a very special experience, as it allows us to be more connected to our natural surroundings. Directly sitting on the ground during meditation is especially cleansing, as the earth element absorbs negative energies from within us. Breathing in fresh air also helps to calm the body and get oxygen to the brain. If you live near the sea or a river, dipping your feet in the water while meditating is a great way to release excess heat and stress.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"5s0vandwzrk","text":"\u003cb\u003eMusic for meditation\u003c/b\u003e","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"p4r0q777hj","text":"Music can be a great aid to your meditation experience. Not only does it set the mood and help to bring our attention into the present, but also the vibrations of each sound can actually be perceived on the central nervous system. This is why some genres of music are more conducive to a meditative state than others.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"qr4edv7bbjr","text":"Having a good selection of meditation music on demand is a great way to enable you to have a quick session wherever you are. At work, in the park, on the go - just plug in your headphones and let the world fade away","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"cij2tgnq6gp","text":"We’ve curated a selection of music specifically designed to elevate your meditation experience.","type":"text"}},{"type":"action","data":{"id":"tfqg78bkiv","action":"Listen to music for meditation","url":"","type":"button","decorations":{"leaves":true}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"q3xlsvewdp9","text":"\u003cb\u003eGroup meditation\u003c/b\u003e","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"h42cu8f4xn","text":"Meditating in a group provides a huge boost to your individual experience. When a whole group has their attention within and are together experiencing thoughtless awareness, the energetic impact can be much greater than when you are doing the same exercise alone.","type":"text"}},{"type":"media","data":{"id":"iag6xvsaudf","items":[{"image":{"id":671,"preview":"https://assets.wemeditate.co/uploads/media_file/file/671/small_8c7f2d184f.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""}],"type":"image","quantity":"single","position":"center","size":"normal","mediaFiles":[671],"decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"22t0i9u7mii","text":"Attending a local class not only deepens your meditation experience but also provides the opportunity to get personal attention from experienced practitioners and ask any questions you may have. Sharing your experiences with others is a great way to improve your understanding of the subtle mechanisms within us, and to connect with other people on a higher level than normal day-to-day interactions.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"t9w2tzwdet","text":"A local weekly class can also serve as a good source of motivation to encourage you to keep up your daily meditations at home. Get inspired by others’ experiences and make new friends with common goals.","type":"text"}},{"type":"action","data":{"id":"vl2imwlul3","action":"Find a class near me","url":"","type":"button","decorations":{"leaves":true}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"agot33fxdxd","text":"Meditation and Religion","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"uo5ilis4qh","text":"Meditation in various forms has long been associated with religious practices as a means of connecting with a higher consciousness and experiencing spiritual liberation, often originating from the East.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"6gqeiej45ai","text":"The first appearance of the practice of meditation in written form is in around 1500 BCE in the Vedas, the ancient Sanskrit texts which form the basis for Hinduism. The ultimate goal of meditation, according to Patanjali, the author of two key Hindu texts including the Yoga-Sutras, is the destruction of ignorance and the realisation of the true nature of the self.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"1yyoivml5ew","text":"Meditation is also a key practice in Buddhism as a means of enlightenment. Here, the main aim of the meditator is to take control of their mind to become more peaceful, focused and aware.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"23n4ej5x8dk","text":"In Sufism, a strain of Islam, meditation is called murāqbah and involves the individual watching the heart to gain insight into the heart’s relation with its creator and its own surroundings. The objective of this observation is to rid oneself of baser characteristics and develop a higher personality.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"ue05b0zn9ig","text":"Even in most religions with Western origins, such as Christianity and Judaism, there are quiet periods of contemplation, although there is no emphasis on going thoughtless as such. On the contrary, most use this time as an opportunity to focus on specific thoughts and reflect on their meaning, with regards to their relationship with God.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"x7zh92kh7mb","text":"While meditation appears as a part of religious practices worldwide, in itself it is not a religion. Religion can be seen as connecting to the Divine through the experience of someone else, and is mainly founded upon belief. Meditation, on the other hand, is focused on the experience of the individual, and gaining knowledge from within yourself.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"zcvchnm1rrk","text":"Meditation and Spirituality","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"4grxvn6rggr","text":"Spirituality is an often misperceived concept, which gets mixed up with ideas of religion or spiritualism. In reality, spirituality is something that practically everyone can relate to as it embodies the search for the experience of one’s true nature and meaning in life.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"itr0c3mhpjl","text":"Meditation is strongly linked to spirituality as it enables the meditator to detach from their thoughts and emotions to connect to their inner self - or spirit -, which is constant and immoveable. The experience of one’s true self brings a deep sense of fulfilment and purpose, which is not attached to any material ideas of success or contribution.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"h869p9cwuy","text":"The key word in understanding meditation as a way of pursuing spirituality is experience. Where religion is a doctrine given to you by someone else, and psychology offers mental analysis, meditation enables you to actually feel inside what is the true nature of your being.","type":"text"}},{"type":"textbox","data":{"id":"ebmb8066gag","text":"“if you are a scientist, then you must keep your mind opened out. Then when you listen to my hypothesis, then you can experiment with it. Anything that can be experimented with is a scientific thing. You can see for yourself that whatever I’m saying is true or not.”","credit":"Shri Mataji, Founder of Sahaja Yoga, Public Program in London, 1978","caption":"","type":"text","style":"hero","alignment":"center","decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"wz2tlp3bk0q","text":"This is why it is often suggested that one approaches meditation like a scientist, with an open mind, and treat the whole experience as an experiment where you merely observe the results. This way you can really connect with the part of yourself which is not based on any mental ideas, of yourself or anyone else.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"qtaf0z2v0o","text":"When you are free from thoughts, you can begin to understand not only yourself, but also the world around you. It’s a fact generally known that our idea of reality is based on the information that is available to us. Therefore, based on mental understanding, how can any one of us claim to have all the information required to understand the true nature of reality? Going beyond the mind allows you to surpass mental barriers and opens you to possibilities that you may have never been exposed to on a mental level.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"4lirsgk0n2j","text":"Meditation and Yoga","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"6nuziy93ct7","text":"While many associate the term ‘yoga’ with a series of postures and exercises which increase physical strength and flexibility, the modern-day activity as we know it has far deeper origins. Yoga, a Sanskrit word which literally means ‘union’, is at its core a state of connection with universal reality. The exercises we are familiar with are a very small part of ancient practices designed to achieve this experiential union.","type":"text"}},{"type":"media","data":{"id":"t7tbi1m4v1","items":[{"image":{"id":672,"preview":"https://assets.wemeditate.co/uploads/media_file/file/672/small_60038a5cdb.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""}],"type":"image","quantity":"single","position":"right","size":"normal","mediaFiles":[672],"decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"9zuiolbvzx4","text":"First systemised in Patanjali’s ‘Yoga Aphorisms’ c. 500 BC as a combination of lifestyle factors, psychophysiological exercises, ethnical observances and metaphysical insights, yoga was contained within small elite groups of mystics in India for thousands of years.
