Diğer bir faydası ise, zihninizde sıkışıp kalmadığınız zamanlarda gelen bir açık kalplilik duygusu hissetmektir, aşırı düşünmek, endişelenmek ya da herhangi bir korku ya da endişeye kapılmak yerine, gerçekten de kalbinizden geçeni konuştuğunuzu ve söylediğinizi hissedebilirsiniz. Sahaja Yoga, sosyal kaygı konusunda bana gerçekten yardımcı oldu ama aynı zamanda meditasyon yoluyla daha bütünleşmiş, farkındalığı daha yüksek, başkalarıyla bağlantı kurabilen bir kişi olmamı da sağladı. Sahaja Yoga hakkında en çok zevk aldığım şey, dünyanın her yerinden, aynı zamanda ruhsal bir yolculukta olan insanlarla bağlantı kurabilmek.”","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"ePOjDXxOYL","type":"list","data":{"id":"d6vwvq7c9xj","items":[{"text":"Anna Biggs, 22, öğretmen, Warwickshire, İngiltere."}],"type":"text","style":"unordered"}},{"id":"LlCNTx2xDZ","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"emabknjn30e","text":"“Sahaja Yoga'nın sunduğu uygulama ve tekniklerle meditasyonda zaman geçirmek benim için çok faydalı oldu. Meditasyon yoluyla, gerçekten daha iyiye doğru değiştiğimi hissediyorum ve içimdeki saf varlığın verdiği ilhamları açığa çıkarmak için ***** katmanlarını keşfetmekten keyif alıyorum.”","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"WgaeBlBvyg","type":"list","data":{"id":"ktllolsdvk","items":[{"text":"Chaitanya Abbott, 27, yönetici şef, Maharashtra, Hindistan."}],"type":"text","style":"unordered"}},{"id":"tAQAi_FsMP","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"x6cbbxn4c3","text":"Meditasyon Yapmanın En İyi Yolları","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"IpXv3uoaE6","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"nwkdzbqcp2","text":"Meditasyonun faydaları, hayattaki çoğu şeyde olduğu gibi, sürekli olan bir çabayla çok iyi hissedilebilir ve sürdürülebilir. Yapılacak en iyi şey, meditasyonu günlük yaşamınızın bir parçası haline getirmektir.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"h6p2wcRXpC","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"45bkc7z7d3","text":"Bir yer ayırın","type":"header","level":"h3","decorations":{}}},{"id":"QDEH8wajb2","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"zu4xv4yd2re","text":"İmkanınız varsa, gidebileceğiniz, keyif alacağınız, özellikle meditasyon yapabileceğiniz bir alan oluşturun. Alternatif olarak, hava güzelse ve bir bahçeniz varsa, her zaman toprakta oturabilirsiniz, çünkü bu başlangıçta sizin dikkatiniz için yararlı olacaktır.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"uHo7XWa2fB","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"7mqvyh9dw6d","text":"21 Günlük Meydan Okuma","type":"header","level":"h3","decorations":{}}},{"id":"_Ln0-Q4LnX","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"7w3k8cfg1xs","text":"21 günlük uygulamayı deneyebilirsiniz. 21 gün boyunca sabah 10 dakika ve akşam 10 dakika uyumadan önce (yukarıdaki meditasyon egzersizlerinden herhangi birini veya hepsini kullanarak) meditasyon yapın ve sağlığınızda, mutluluğunuzda ve huzurunuzda kayda değer bir fark olup olmadığına bakın.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"EQYaUgMn9L","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"jfk2afym06q","text":"Günlük Meditasyon","type":"header","level":"h3","decorations":{}}},{"id":"sgqAYWT5mu","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"at0ejf1crq","text":"Her gün meditasyon yapmak çok önemlidir çünkü bu sadece düşüncesiz farkındalık konumuna erişme ve sizin için neyin işe yaradığını görmeye devam etme yeteneğinizi geliştirmekle kalmaz, aynı zamanda Kundalini'nizin gücünü de artırdığınız anlamına gelir.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"u99ZBRvbSW","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"3pfsfxojy63","text":"Kundalini iplikçikler halinde yükselir ve içsel benliğinizle ve dünyanın geri kalanıyla daha derin ve daha bütünleşik bir bağlantı için, başınızın tepesine daha fazla iplikçiğin ulaşmasını istersiniz. Ayrıca, özellikle başlangıçta meditatif konuma ulaşma süreci, bir soğana benzetilebilir, çünkü bazı katmanlar üzerinde çalışmanız gerekebilir (bunlar düşünceler, egonuz, geçmişten gelen şartlanmalar, rahatlama zorlukları vb. olabilir), bu yüzden meditatif kalıplar ve alışkanlıklar oluşturmak için başlangıçta 'zamanları ayarlamak' çok önemlidir.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"tkD1LgK39r","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"dqu373h5tzr","text":"Meditasyonların 10-15 dakikayı aşması gerekmez, ancak istediğiniz kadar meditasyon yapabilirsiniz.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"W4JubA3H7y","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"4867v4s43iw","text":"Meditasyon için Bizden En iyi 3 İpucu","type":"header","level":"h3","decorations":{}}},{"id":"QAIdmUF0Qs","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"xr4fid431wb","text":"İpucu #1: Heryerde Meditasyon Yapın","type":"header","level":"h4","decorations":{}}},{"id":"CCpdLFdpqI","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"chrzi007w6q","text":"İster evde, ister bir görüşmede, ister evin dışında meditasyon konumuna girebilirsiniz.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"knThmfIzQl","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"412lwesvsi8","text":"Bunu deneyin: işaret parmağınızı alın ve başınızın üst kısmının merkezine hafifçe dokunun. Parmağınızı çektikten sonra parmağınızı nereye koymuş olduğunuzu hala hissedebilirsiniz, değil mi? Şimdi, sadece bu hisse dikkatinizi koyun. Bundan sonra ne olursa olsun, o hissi hala başınızın üstünde hissedebilirsiniz. Dikkatinizi başınızın üstünde tutarak gününüze devam edin.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"u1w-zkCSQc","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"lltf6qhhau","text":"İpucu #2: Yaşamın Seslerini Kucaklayın","type":"header","level":"h4","decorations":{}}},{"id":"F9yjNgI3RL","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"lqga66t3qke","text":"Meditasyon yapanlar için ortak bir sorun, yoğun yaşam tarzları ve evdeki aile üyeleridir, meditasyon yapmak için sessiz bir yer bulmak insanlar için çok zor olabilir. Ancak bu hayali bir engeldir. Meditasyonlarımızı sessiz yerler ile sınırlamamıza gerek yoktur. Gerçekten de, böyle düşünmek, meditasyon yapma şansımızı büyük ölçüde kısıtlayabilir, çünkü, yoğun, telaşlı bir dünyada yaşarız. Oysa, herhangi bir arka planda, meditasyon her yerde yapılabilir. Sadece bu durumun, o anda ne duyduğunuzla ilgili olduğunu kabullenin ve düşüncelerinizin sizi onun içine çekilmesine izin vermeyin. Bu ilk başta kolay olmasa da, aslında, etrafınızdaki o seslerin hiçbirine kapılmadan, karışmadan, onları dinleyerek onlardan 'ayrılma' meselesidir. Yukarıdaki ipucuyu gürültülü bir ortamda deneyerek bunu uygulamaya koyabilirsiniz.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"u17TUTFxIJ","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"6ihfuc6tulk","text":"İpucu #3: Tüm Beklentileri Silin","type":"header","level":"h4","decorations":{}}},{"id":"UVoiNoSlfV","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"wrnso4fcoe","text":"Daha önce okuduklarınıza, duyduklarınıza veya deneyimlediklerinize dayanarak, herhangi bir meditasyon seansının nasıl gerçekleşeceğine veya nasıl gerçekleşmesi gerektiğine dair bir beklentiyle yaklaşmak kolay olabilir. Ancak meditasyon, içimizdeki Kundalini enerjimizin yükselmesiyle yönetilen, tamamen kendiliğinden gerçekleşen, doğal bir süreçtir. Bu enerjinin yükselmesi için arzunuzu ifade edebilir ve dikkatinizi içinizde tutabilirsiniz, ancak eninde sonunda olacaklara teslim olmalısınız. Deneyimi tamamen kontrol etmeye çalışmak aslında Kundalini’yi meditasyon deneyiminden uzaklaştırıp, verimli çalışmasını engelleyebilir. Yapabileceğiniz en iyi şey, Kundalini’nin işini yapmasına izin vermek ve onun sadece sizin iyiliğiniz için hareket ettiğini hatırlamaktır.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}}],"version":"2.23.2","markupVersion":3,"mediaFiles":[]}

translations.name: Meditation Experiences
translations.content:
{"time":1675554523721,"blocks":[{"id":"aaAakPJ-d_","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"8y0i730txls","text":"From a simple feeling of satisfaction akin for some to eating a bar of chocolate, to a sense of profound contentment imagined to be attainable, say, with the combination of a puppy, novel, and a crackling fireplace in midwinter, or, for others, a vision of floating ecstatically through the abyss of infinity, living on ‘universe juice’ and stardust–we all come to meditation with certain expectations of what we might experience, with some expectations more ‘out there’ than others.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"IdGr4lAqRc","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"6pdhgeyot1h","text":"Let me be honest. The aim of meditation is not to experience something extraordinary and spectacular, rather it is to become extraordinary. It is the rare experience of going beyond all expectations we've conjured with the mind and instead being simply silent inside. At its essence, it is to be yourself through and true. This is Sahaja Yoga.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"VBFudC4jMO","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"rhu76xggjp","text":"That being said, on the path to self-realisation through meditation different people will have different experiences, ranging from simple to more profound to ecstatic. Yet, as sustained meditation develops and improves, it begins to enhance the way in which we engage with our world on a daily basis.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"FXvKBn8Gs8","type":"catalog","data":{"id":"izn3got2epb","title":"Self-realisation meditation","items":["38"],"type":"meditations","style":"image","decorations":{}}},{"id":"saxWeZX6Hm","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"r497d0vrj7","text":"Common Meditation Experiences","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"OHayK8pnb5","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"lq0kvmkkrg","text":"The Idea behind any meditation is to turn one’s attention from the external world to the internal world. Naturally, as our attention expands across this new space, we become more sensitive to the thoughts, feelings, and emotions that swirl within. But without guidance, our attention can become unmoored and unstable. In Sahaja Yoga, the kundalini sheds light on this inner world, where our subtle system resides.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"3D4IhBWBjO","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"t8b8h4hw0q","text":"It is the activation of the kundalini – this maternal, nourishing energy within us – that guides the process of meditation. She interacts with the intricate network of the subtle system, or in other words the autonomic nervous system, which governs the primary bodily processes, such as blood pressure and the rate of breathing.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"bcCLCoMftk","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"4bc9pehm66z","text":"Due to each individual’s different lifestyle choices and behavioural patterns, we experience varying degrees of cumulative wear and tear on the subtle system, which cause deficiencies, blockages, or ‘catches’ where energy gets stuck. In meditation, the kundalini repairs and resolves these blockages within our subtle system. For many first-time meditators, this repair work of the kundalini energy within us is expressed in various ways, such as sensations in the body, according to the specific blockages addressed by the kundalini. These include:","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"QcVw9l7ITB","type":"list","data":{"id":"hbe6lr661ub","items":[{"text":"Heat or warmth that cascades along areas of the body. This indicates that the kundalini is actively ‘clearing out’ that specific area of the body."},{"text":"Tingling sensations on a localized area of the body. This is another indicator of the kundalini clearing blockages and can feel like pins and needles, but in a not unpleasant way. If this is felt in the legs, it’s most likely just the legs falling asleep as they are not used to staying in one position for too long, as they do when we are sitting in meditation."}],"type":"text","style":"leaf"}},{"id":"QxsoYGj59e","type":"media","data":{"id":"fmk7f1ef70s","poster":{},"items":[{"image":{"id":1397,"preview":"https://assets.wemeditate.com/uploads/media_file/file/1397/small_bc9d9d75fa.jpg?version="},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""}],"mediaFiles":[1397],"youtube_id":"","type":"image","quantity":"single","position":"center","size":"narrow","decorations":{}}},{"id":"kxGHsdZp1O","type":"whitespace","data":{"id":"kbmgfj3ooci","size":"small","decorations":{}}},{"id":"TBeM1utWbN","type":"list","data":{"id":"br9fxfiusq","items":[{"text":"Light and coolness. While the kundalini clears out stresses and imbalances within us, it can be felt in different parts of the body, as mentioned above, but the end result of this clearing is the same–a feeling of lightness and coolness in the body. One feels refreshed and relaxed. Tensions that one might have not observed before, due to having become accustomed to them, suddenly release, filling the body with a sense of relief."},{"text":"A warm or cool ‘breeze’. There can be a noticeable sensation of coolness or heat emanating from the palms or from the top of the head. This indicates that the process of self-realization has taken place. Experiencing the cool or warm breeze does not always happen for everyone during the first couple of sessions, or the experience might be quite subtle and difficult to detect, but for many it is common to  experience this gentle breeze."}],"type":"text","style":"leaf"}},{"id":"Jo1Y-OWGgc","type":"media","data":{"id":"sjs5d1ncg4","poster":{},"items":[{"image":{"id":1398,"preview":"https://assets.wemeditate.com/uploads/media_file/file/1398/small_8ac19be173.jpg?version="},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""}],"mediaFiles":[1398],"youtube_id":"","type":"image","quantity":"single","position":"center","size":"narrow","decorations":{}}},{"id":"nei-399urj","type":"whitespace","data":{"id":"xqcs0vkdj87","size":"small","decorations":{}}},{"id":"Tb753Jebem","type":"list","data":{"id":"xujsnfna1ts","items":[{"text":"Mental relaxation, or stillness of the mind, which is achieved when the attention is fixed within. Why so? Using our attention means we are ‘at tension’ since we focus our mind on a particular external object. By doubling back the attention on itself in meditation, we allow it time to reset and rest."},{"text":"Pressure on the head can be felt in cases when the chain of thought remains unbroken and consistent–when the mind keeps chattering away instead of relaxing. Be wary of not ‘forcing’ or making an effort to meditate, as this mentalizes a method that should be spontaneous and effortless."},{"text":"Drowsiness. During meditation one may start to feel sleepy or drowsy. This often happens if the practitioner has a natural tendency to be active, alert, and constantly thinking–the pendulum swings to the opposite end. This is to be expected as the point of gravity finds its center. "},{"text":"Alertness. The flip side to the above is that if one tends to have a natural tendency to be more passive and lethargic, there can be a shift to a more awake and engaged state."},{"text":"Being alert and relaxed at the same time. This is the sweet spot in between the two modes of behaviour described above. When in the centre, the meditation brings the practitioner feelings of being relaxed, having to expend no effort."},{"text":"Joy. Most of all, meditation brings a feeling of joy, and when the joy begins to flow, you will know. There is not much need to elaborate on this; it is the state in which we grow in silence."}],"type":"text","style":"leaf"}},{"id":"jBBtLBEeSB","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"fesoffdn7in","text":"There are some meditative experiences that may sound dazzling and wonderful, but actually indicate that further clearing is recommended. These include:","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"ZZ46R1Fr8h","type":"list","data":{"id":"w08nsrjpt3","items":[{"text":"Seeing orbs of light or colours that flash even when the eyes are closed reflects an inner state that is off-balance. This could be the expression of an over-exerted sympathetic nervous system (in our terms, being ‘right-sided’. See more about this in our article about the right channel)."},{"text":"Out of body experience. Similar to the above point, a feeling of hovering above one’s body in the external environment is an expression of being extremely right-sided. The whole point of meditation is to establish one’s self within, not to further engage our mind in the world outside. This type of experience is a vain pursuit."}],"type":"text","style":"unordered"}},{"id":"BFfWhiwIt8","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"0va069rff0ck","text":"The bottom line to remember is that the kundalini works in a manner that is gentle and delicate. If after the meditation you consistently feel drained, exhausted, or weary, then this could be an indication of forced mental effort or a severe internal blockage which prevents the kundalini from rising. Our subtle system is like a string instrument: The realization that dawned on the Buddha when he reached the height of his seeking was that the strings of an instrument are to be neither tuned too tight nor too slack.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"P4y5miR-NS","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"h80d5qhn27h","text":"Deep Meditation Experiences","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"hVVg4tFB9T","type":"media","data":{"id":"ghx4e93huus","poster":{},"items":[{"image":{"id":1399,"preview":"https://assets.wemeditate.com/uploads/media_file/file/1399/small_2f55ea2cd6.jpg?version="},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""}],"mediaFiles":[1399],"youtube_id":"","type":"image","quantity":"single","position":"center","size":"narrow","decorations":{}}},{"id":"k7E_4YxEJT","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"d5uqw7ndbsm","text":"When we are able to delve into the depths of joy with ease and effortlessness, know that your meditation is progressing well. You will notice that one meditation will not be quite the same as the next, since being in balance is to be spontaneous. It is a living process that adheres not to rules and regulations but to a law and harmony that is beyond mental conceptions.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"0RCPTSyZfH","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"asr8peoylas","text":"Frustration is a clear indicator of a regimented and lifeless meditation. Be gentle on yourself and avoid feelings of frustration. Always aim to seek that joy within your being, and know that it rests on the knowledge of knowing thyself. In this process, wonderful and sublime experiences will manifest, beginning with:","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"pSNBGINYzJ","type":"list","data":{"id":"hwli6wnf05","items":[{"text":"The opening of the Sahasrara. If you want to hear a good story, ask someone who has been practising Sahaja Yoga for a while about their experience in this regard. When the kundalini rises above the thoughts and pierces the area of the head known as the fontanelle, the rush of joy, bliss, and peace can be tremendous. It is as if an  incandescent light is surging through each and every nerve of your body, moving in unison towards the crown of your head. It feels familiar. It feels like coming home. This is the event of yoga or union with the self. I truly wish you will feel this, too."},{"text":"Thoughtless Awareness. When the kundalini is established beyond the Sahasrara, thoughts cease to bombard one’s mind, rather they stay on the edge of awareness where they can be viewed from a distance as a detached witness. The passing of time is hard to grasp in this state, because there is no urge to plan for the future or ponder the past. In meditation, our attention is established in the present."},{"text":"Vibrations. When our Sahasrara is opened, we develop a new awareness, which is vibratory awareness. We then feel vibrations in various ways. Either they flow like a stream from the palms or the top of the head, or they can be felt as gentle pulsations across or along the spine and skull. It is similar to how light is both a wave and a particle. These pleasant sensations are an actualization of the connection established between yourself and the kundalini. They guide your attention to specific areas of the subtle system that are in need of nourishment or repair"}],"type":"text","style":"leaf"}},{"id":"iWQBeEWBwN","type":"media","data":{"id":"eqarzlsj8fe","poster":{},"items":[{"image":{"id":1400,"preview":"https://assets.wemeditate.com/uploads/media_file/file/1400/small_cb8dc23b54.jpg?version="},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""}],"mediaFiles":[1400],"youtube_id":"","type":"image","quantity":"single","position":"center","size":"narrow","decorations":{}}},{"id":"3ONFAP-rWm","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"f7unv8sm7bu","text":"Sustained meditation allows for a complete shift in how we perceive the world. The following qualities are enhanced in long-term practitioners of meditation:","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"wyAKY_WNuI","type":"list","data":{"id":"g7ti99oxpv","items":[{"text":"Sensitivity towards the mood of your surrounding, such as the peaceful bliss of dawn and its waking light, the majesty of an iridescent sunset; the joyful babble of a river and its locks of hair that undulate and sway free; the intricacy of an effulgent leaf as a silver sun filters through its maze of green pathways; and the laughter of a child that echoes in the park green. Poets become more than a bunch of enigmatic and mysterious introverts."},{"text":"Clarity and precision of thought. There is a luminance to ideas and a clearness in action that springs from knowing one’s purpose and path, knowledge which dawn in our awareness through meditation."},{"text":"Compassion and kindness. When one becomes connected to the source of joy, sharing this joy through compassion and kindness does not drain it but, on the contrary, can be a gain that elevates all."},{"text":"Simplicity in the sense that one does not need to act or put on a mask with others. You can trust yourself and trust others–be what may be. You are genuine for all to see."}],"type":"text","style":"leaf"}},{"id":"mFz5lUhIky","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"ku1qiy7xegm","text":"Spiritual Meditation Experiences","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"TAgypL-uWP","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"uq48ezcfzii","text":"Gregoire de Kalbermatten (1949-2016), a diplomat, UN official, and practitioner of Sahaja Yoga since the late 1970s, had the privilege of learning the technique of meditation directly from Shri Mataji–the founder of Sahaja Yoga. He relates his first experience in great lucidity.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"fARIs2F3gT","type":"textbox","data":{"id":"vfs7qc2cgj","title":"Bliss","subtitle":"","caption":"","credit":"","text":"The room is merged in a golden, moving light or so it seems to my dilated pupils; I feel enveloped in a bath of soothing energy of Joy. HH Shri Mataji is saying: “Kundalini has risen. The parasympathetic nervous system is being activated. You do not need to do anything. The process of your second birth is sahaj, spontaneous.” I am delighted that I am not supposed to mentally strive for something because if my mind is simply to relax and be watchful I am avoiding the danger of suggestion and autosuggestion. On the other hand I am embarrassed to witness something happening to me, which is at the same time obvious and obviously out of my control. I am not in a state of hypnosis though because my intellect can and does argue: “Is it that? Is it really that?” Who is this person, in front of me, who is working as a catalyst of energies unknown to me, energies that I feel coming in my body in waves of vibrations? What about my karmas. Has she dissolved them? Will this bliss last? Suddenly I come to realise that these vibrations have an impact on my awareness also; I am softly entering a dimension where everything in the room has begun to change and yet remain the same; a majestic silence is growing within me. The noises of the mind disappear: it is as if something more real, more intense, reveals itself in the already manifested reality of myself, the air, the yellow curtains and the table: something simple and essential, this very thing I have been hunting for so long. Simple. Direct. Immediate. Obvious. Blissful. Something called Reality. This Reality that I had, in vain, tried to encompass is slowly, gently encompassing me. This is a bit too much! I cannot really face the possibility that I have reached the end of such an intensive and continuous quest. I feel sleepy… and, with HH Mataji’s blessing, go to sleep.[…]

","action":"","url":"","mediaFiles":[],"type":"text","alignment":"center","style":"hero","spacing":"overlap","background":"white","color":"light","position":"left","decorations":{}}},{"id":"Yhs564bW12","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"qcv2zsmobtd","text":"Everyone's meditation experience is different, here I offer my own.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"NpySmZeQRz","type":"textbox","data":{"id":"gogfbw78b6q","title":"Silence and I","subtitle":"","caption":"","credit":"","text":"I have practised Sahaja Yoga from quite a young age. Both of my parents practised meditation. I used to sit with them in the early hours of the morning, trying my best not to fall asleep or think about which kids’ shows I might still be able to see on channel three. Meditation was relaxing. And that was about it. Entering into adolescence, my parents worked odd hours. Mum did night shifts at the childbirth ward while my dad taught music during most of the evening. My siblings and I were left to meditate on our own schedule. As the workload increased during high school, and post-school activities demanded attention, and the navigation of the social side of things pressed upon the mind, I noticed that meditation during the mornings and in the evenings became a necessity to detach and latch on to something stable, some kind of solid footing in a world changing at a breakneck pace. Still, even though my days were filled to the brim, there was an empty space within. There was a growing feeling that I had forgotten something on my way. I was incomplete. Meditation didn't quite hit the spot anymore. I could not understand why. I kept sitting for longer and longer durations of time. The only results were numb legs and a dumb, frustrated mind. I hit a dead end and looked back at the path I was walking. Where was I going? What was I looking for in the first place? Why did I feel incomplete? I stripped my meditation to the bare minimum. Just some silence and I. There, in that silence, I pivoted back to that empty space and watched. The race of thoughts, doubts, and frustrations filled that space, swirling and making a muck of things. The space received it all and took it into itself, leaving no trace behind. The empty space met my gaze, and in that moment of recognition I was embraced by a joy that filled my whole being with a bliss beyond words. Suddenly, a wave of crackling warmth shot up my spine, making my hair stand at an end as it crossed my neck into my head. My mind, a prison of thoughts, became a prism as the waves radiated in all directions. When I thought I could not handle the increasing pressure any more, it gathered force and with a pop, shot straight through the fontanelle. A coolness settled on my head and trickled down to the rest of my body and legs that, surprisingly, were not numb. It felt like a little cool flame, the size of my thumb, rested on the top of the head, while the rest of the body and the mind were drenched in silence. After a short or long duration of time I opened my eyes and let one word drop from my lips: “what?”","action":"","url":"","mediaFiles":[],"type":"text","alignment":"center","style":"hero","spacing":"overlap","background":"white","color":"light","position":"left","decorations":{}}},{"id":"GSsgJsdmyw","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"afiky4kub34","text":"Discover your own meditation experience!","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"27JLwUviX_","type":"action","data":{"id":"dwe2a25fxeu","title":"","subtitle":"","text":"","action":"Meditate now","url":"https://wemeditate.com/meditations","list_id":"","type":"button","form":"signup","spacing":"spaced","decorations":{"leaves":true}}}],"version":"2.23.2","markupVersion":3,"mediaFiles":[]}

translations.name: Най-доброто време за медитация и как да го намерим
translations.content: {"time":1676397035992,"blocks":[{"id":"25clEm-mU8","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"e6vmy54dc","text":"Намирането на подходящото време за медитация може да е трудно. Особено ако сте започнали съвсем от скоро с медитацията или никога преди не сте медитирали. Тогава, кога е най-подходящото време за това? Влияят ли различните части от деня върху преживяването на медитацията? Как да намеря време за медитация, когато вече имам толкова много неща за вършене?","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"3FovJDI_vo","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"nnxoilv445r","text":"В действителност, дори няколко минути в истинско медитативно състояние могат да бъдат достатъчни, за да ви донесат усещане за пълно спокойствие и прозрение.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"Eg0aAKluUU","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"u7yy6fqrb4","text":"Ето няколко съвета за намиране на време за медитация и за превръщането ѝ в постоянен навик.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"QvSdLdFait","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"d6q8b13m6q5","text":"Защо е важно да намирате време за медитация","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"s_SulEH3zZ","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"ec072co684","text":"Идеята за още една ежедневна дейност може да изглежда обезкуражаваща, особено при натоварен график и ограничен запас от енергия. Хубавото на медитацията е, че тя може да ни направи по-ефективни при изпълнението на други задачи и всъщност може да ни спести време и енергия.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"dw7QleIiDh","type":"media","data":{"id":"rfyiol0s96m","poster":{},"items":[{"image":{"id":1386,"preview":"https://assets.wemeditate.com/uploads/media_file/file/1386/small_175d82afda.jpg?version="},"alt":"Man meditating & recharging to full energy","caption":"","credit":""}],"mediaFiles":[1386],"youtube_id":"","type":"image","quantity":"single","position":"center","size":"narrow","decorations":{"triangle":{"alignment":"right"}}}},{"id":"2qWBhXnnrO","type":"whitespace","data":{"id":"5gfuc7h4p29","size":"small","decorations":{}}},{"id":"UV9flFW1HK","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"6v5hw7c8ma9","text":"Стресът и тревожността забавят ума и тялото ни, което затруднява изпълнението дори на прости задачи. Медитацията е ефективен начин за намаляване на стреса и премахване на чувството на тревожност. Така умът става по-ефективен и съсредоточен. Състоянието на медитация се свързва и със спонтанно чувство на радост, а когато сме в по-добро настроение дори намираме нещата за вършене за по-лесни!","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"WITRledurm","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"ximhh6q0vp","text":"Безсънието или недостатъчният сън също правят рутинните ни задачи да изглеждат все повече като досадни. Медитацията помага за отпускане на ума и тялото, осигурява по-спокоен сън и ни оставя енергични и готови да посрещнем деня.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"jbPCnyGqqw","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"a0kghp9sl2c","text":"Има ли най-добро време за медитация?","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"-gCl3tWxY6","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"q1k2oxleefl","text":"Кога трябва да се опитвате да намерите време за медитация? Всъщност, медитацията може да се провежда по всяко време и навсякъде, но ето някои от най-добрите моменти, когато да опитате.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"VJDiWCvOzC","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"adoo04kjjzs","text":"Медитирайте сутрин","type":"header","level":"h3","decorations":{}}},{"id":"wJ5CE96Zi_","type":"media","data":{"id":"q15sn04fe4d","poster":{},"items":[{"image":{"id":1387,"preview":"https://assets.wemeditate.com/uploads/media_file/file/1387/small_acb60ce013.jpg?version="},"alt":"Woman meditating inside in the morning' sunrays","caption":"","credit":""}],"mediaFiles":[1387],"youtube_id":"","type":"image","quantity":"single","position":"center","size":"narrow","decorations":{"triangle":false}}},{"id":"kKl3qC140u","type":"whitespace","data":{"id":"v5xbf1lybii","size":"small","decorations":{}}},{"id":"UaAbCtqeSO","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"c4wb3rri0da","text":"За повечето редовно медитиращи медитацията е първото нещо сутрин. Ефектът дори от няколко минути истинска медитация - когато сте напълно съзнати, но без мисли, продължава дълго след занятието. Така има по-малка вероятност да изпитвате стрес, тревожност и други негативни чувства през деня.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"ONTj-_cLJU","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"4ny3eez3z9","text":"От практическа гледна точка рано сутрин е времето, когато е най-малко вероятно да бъдете обезпокоявани както от собствения си ум, така и от заобикалящата ви среда. Измиването или вземането на душ преди това е добър начин да се уверите, че не сте твърде сънливи, за да влезете в медитация. Опитайте се да медитирате, преди да започнете други рутинни задачи, като например да отговаряте на имейли или да организирате деня си. По този начин имате най-голям шанс да изпитате тишина, преди да се промъкнат мислите за деня.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"yHh_xRYaWR","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"7iulgl7d9mu","text":"По традиция древните форми на медитация са се практикували много рано сутрин, около 4 часа сутринта. В този час е по-лесно да изпаднете в медитативно състояние, тъй като се настройвате към ритъма на природата. Макар че много от нас обикновено не започват деня си толкова рано, това е чудесна цел за всеки да се опитате поне веднъж да изпитате спокойствието на това специално време.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"BU5tlng0nE","type":"textbox","data":{"id":"eghkq8cwb9c","title":"","subtitle":"","caption":"","credit":"Шри Матаджи Нирмала Деви","text":"„Когато ставате рано сутрин, възприемчивостта ви е по-голяма. Не само това, в този ранен час светът е и изключително красив.“","action":"","url":"","image":{"id":1383,"preview":"https://assets.wemeditate.com/uploads/media_file/file/1383/small_9c8f0c86db.jpg?version="},"mediaFiles":[1383],"type":"text","alignment":"center","style":"hero","spacing":"overlap","background":"white","color":"dark","position":"left","decorations":{"gradient":false,"leaves":false,"circle":false,"sidetext":false}}},{"id":"PjB74nHLXW","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"udijrakvvv","text":"Медитиране след работа","type":"header","level":"h3","decorations":{}}},{"id":"gTlqbg42DD","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"ggg4thpuwx9","text":"Работата ни често е източник на стрес, който може да се пренесе и в личния ни живот. Провеждайки кратка медитация, когато се приберем от работа, може да ни помогне да оставим зад гърба си негативните преживявания от деня. Медитацията може да се окаже полезна, дори ако работите у дома. Кратката мисловна тишина може да ни извади от работния режим и да ни помогне да се отпуснем преди лягане.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"WayrYVKcUz","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"2uh9ugx8byt","text":"Ако домът ви не предлага спокойна среда, опитайте да медитирате в парка или на друго тихо място, достъпно за вас. С помощта на водена онлайн медитация, лесно можете да включите слушалките и да се насладите на миг спокойствие, преди да се заемете с други неща.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"dId5i9U21c","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"9n0itbt3jf","text":"Груповите занимания с медитация, независимо онлайн или офлайн, също са чудесен начин да се отпуснете след работа. Колективните медитации предлагат съвсем ново и неповторимо усещане на преживяване. Връзката с положителната енергия на другите е истински стимул за собствената ви практика и може да накара проблемите в работата бързо да се превърнат в далечни спомени.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"Sp7PtcBWHl","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"djdg31kgtju","text":"Медитирайте през нощта","type":"header","level":"h3","decorations":{}}},{"id":"ekz4SrlSUS","type":"media","data":{"id":"hvam6lra2k9","poster":{},"items":[{"image":{"id":1388,"preview":"https://assets.wemeditate.com/uploads/media_file/file/1388/small_e50213ebe9.jpg?version="},"alt":"Man meditating inside at night with a full moon ","caption":"","credit":""}],"mediaFiles":[1388],"youtube_id":"","type":"image","quantity":"single","position":"center","size":"narrow","decorations":{}}},{"id":"ZvTk3JCzSR","type":"whitespace","data":{"id":"9qhdiii4bjg","size":"small","decorations":{}}},{"id":"tIF3P_VhbT","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"dccuf94paok","text":"Добрият сън е важен за много аспекти на нашето здраве и благосъстояние. Стресът, напрежението и дори депресията могат да доведат до нарушаване на съня. За да подобрим нашия сън, трябва да се погрижим за скритите причини, вместо само да разчитаме на лекарства.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"4kDgOruy_Y","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"0ib9ilz9t6z","text":"Психическият, емоционалният и физическият стрес възниква, когато има енергиен дисбаланс на централната ни нервна система. Медитацията балансира дейността на централната нервна система, освобождавайки всякакво напрежение и блокажи в нас. Ето защо медитацията преди лягане може да бъде мощен антидот срещу безсънието, тъй като се насочва директно към корена на проблема, вместо да се занимава само със симптомите.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"8VFjypnGaf","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"pyz4didd9ur","text":"Една чудесна процедура, която можете да изпробвате в комбинация с вечерната си медитация, е накисване на краката. Тази проста техника - медитиране със стъпала накиснати в солена вода, е истински тласък за вътрешното пречистване, което се случва по време на медитация, и е лесен начин да си осигурите спокоен нощен сън.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"lIRNE8T8oZ","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"9j5c8f60qhc","text":"Дори и да нямате проблеми със съня през нощта, все пак е добра идея да медитирате преди лягане. Състоянието ни може да бъде силно повлияно от заобикалящата ни среда през деня, така че вечерната медитация е чудесен начин да коригираме всички вътрешни дисбаланси, които може да сме натрупали от външни влияния.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"LNdjImJuDq","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"d1q8vnxbmk","text":"Медитирайте, когато имате нужда от това","type":"header","level":"h3","decorations":{}}},{"id":"wMYadNwItW","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"yaze6khboup","text":"Освен че трябва да установите редовен режим на медитация, трябва да позволите на медитацията да бъде дейност, която е спонтанна. Можете медитирате винаги, когато се почувствате претоварени от вашите мисли или емоции. Успокояването на мислите и откъсването от заобикалящата ви среда, дори за минута, може да бъде повече от достатъчно, за да се презаредите и да възстановите баланса. Някои хора дори отиват до тоалетната в офиса, за да медитират след особено стресиращо събитие с шефа си. Това наистина може да помогне!","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"Xp9uiIDrWs","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"r2dvo0m251s","text":"Неподправеното състояние на медитация, при което умът е напълно безмълвен, но бдителен, може да има невероятно успокояващо въздействие върху психиката ни. За щастие всеки от нас може да достигне това състояние благодарение на мощната жива енергия в нас, наречена на санскрит „Кундалини”. Когато тази енергия се събуди, тя спонтанно ни пречиства от всякакви напрежения. Така по естествен начин преминаваме в медитация.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"q5S0YlB5bp","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"y698zyfid4e","text":"Научете повече за енергията Кундалини.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"qNpu6t2wuE","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"v7dvd8jjg18","text":"Обособено място","type":"header","level":"h3","decorations":{}}},{"id":"e2nOGwX7b9","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"4hpou8a4q4m","text":"Мястото, на което медитирате може да повлияе и на това кога медитирате. Медитацията след работа може да звучи чудесно, но ако не можете да намерите тихо място, става ясно, че ще бъде затруднено. Въпреки че медитацията има забележителната способност да доставя красива вътрешна тишина, трябва да можете поне да сте седнали удобно, без някой да ви обезпокоява.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"ZKikPw6wDy","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"g54fezujjz","text":"Един съвет е, когато медитирате у дома, да се опитате да сядате всеки път на едно и също място и да поддържате тази част да бъде чиста от безпорядък и бъркотия. Това ще ви помогне да възприемете медитацията като важна част от вашето ежедневие и като уважаван избор, който правите за себе си.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"g7VXPEmwOb","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"g5muqg85qy","text":"Да медитирам преди или след тренировка?","type":"header","level":"h3","decorations":{}}},{"id":"OQ22do09zm","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"73z1kbwxa8a","text":"Подобно на медитацията, физическите упражнения ни помагат да бъдем в равновесие. Важно е двете практики да се допълват, за да се постигне цялостно равновесие. Начинът, по който те работят заедно, зависи много от това по кое време на деня обикновено тренирате.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"WXwwxJKEX-","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"b7qehxn6fhq","text":"Ако обичате да правите упражнения сутрин, тогава опитайте да медитирате преди това. По този начин имате най-добрия шанс да се насладите на тих балансиран ум, преди да се натрупа напрежение от деня. Но ако обикновено тренирате по-късно през деня, тогава медитацията след тренировка е чудесен начин да се отпуснете и да релаксирате напълно ума.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"GY-Yt_bY9r","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"larv9qx0iv","text":"Съвети за намиране на време за медитация","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"LGt9tmj4AY","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"vheesscw33","text":"Един от проблемите, с които се сблъскват много хора е поддържането всеки ден на редовен режим на медитация. Ето няколко прости начина, които ще ви помогнат да превърнете медитацията в неразделна част от ежедневието си.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"dqZj8ZpSLr","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"q91rllub3y9","text":"Meditation time: Form a habit","type":"header","level":"h3","decorations":{}}},{"id":"X98TSG3WJ2","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"imllw3gye4p","text":"Ежедневието ни е изпълнено с множество дребни начинания и задачи, които вършим биз дори да мислим за тях. Опитайте да мислите за медитацията като за ежедневно пречистващо събитие, душевен душ, който си взимате всеки ден по относително едно и също време.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"7zd7bAKII1","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"zljj72ggjnn","text":"There are many small things we do on a daily basis without thinking about it. Try to see meditation as a daily cleansing event, like taking a spiritual shower, which you do at roughly the same time everyday.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"jfEm9SHI9d","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"64w8rjdvd7","text":"Важно е, обаче, медитациите ви не бива да бъдат проведени насила и прекалено строго, в началото самодисциплината е необходима, за да може да е по-лесен пътят след него. Много хора, без дори да се замислят, отделят няколко минути всеки ден само, за да си измият зъбите. Знаем, че е важно и, че ни помага да сме здрави. Подобно трябва да е и отношението ви към медитацията. Здравословен навик, който се отвърждава по естествен път. Бъдете търпеливи със себе си, докато ползите не заглушат всичко, което се опитва да ви омае и разсее.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"OwG8JuaGFH","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"uosdprt5qnd","text":"While it’s important that your meditations do not become forced and regimented, some self-discipline is necessary at first to make things easier. Most of us think nothing of spending a few minutes every day brushing our teeth. We know it is important and helps us stay healthy. Your meditation should be the same. A healthy beneficial habit that comes naturally. Be patient with yourself in the beginning, as the benefits will soon crowd out any procrastination or distractions.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"9AhHToo8cn","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"vphq7a3ak9n","text":"Колективна медитация","type":"header","level":"h3","decorations":{}}},{"id":"R6Czv123dB","type":"media","data":{"id":"fmb9myy9e0i","poster":{},"items":[{"image":{"id":1389,"preview":"https://assets.wemeditate.com/uploads/media_file/file/1389/small_0a5dfad652.jpg?version="},"alt":"Three people meditating together","caption":"","credit":""}],"mediaFiles":[1389],"youtube_id":"","type":"image","quantity":"single","position":"center","size":"narrow","decorations":{"triangle":{"alignment":"left"}}}},{"id":"wjIR6tiCur","type":"whitespace","data":{"id":"hg4s858p1qm","size":"small","decorations":{}}},{"id":"EIQPwukH2I","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"ysymnan2pri","text":"Медитацията в група е чудесен начин да си определите редовен и необходим времеви прозорец за медитация. Освен това, срещите с други хора, които също медитират, могат да послужат като чудесен източник на мотивация, тъй като можете взаимно да се насърчавате и мотивирате.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"wspjdvERQV","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"0192svgr0z17f","text":"Независимо дали онлайн или физически, в стотици градове по света се провеждат седмични колективни медитации. Намерете група близо до вас или се присъединете към онлайн сесия на живо във вашата часова зона, която ще помогне да затвърдите вашата практика и да изпитате силата на колективната медитация.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"aufk2TSrAc","type":"action","data":{"id":"qck6v9taiqb","title":"","subtitle":"","text":"","action":"Join a group meditation","url":"https://wemeditate.com/live","list_id":"","type":"button","form":"signup","spacing":"spaced","decorations":{"leaves":true}}},{"id":"Y1Fjtd4aOy","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"7xeicdavewl","text":"Дни за медитация","type":"header","level":"h3","decorations":{}}},{"id":"miyWAwovwI","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"zatt7sln8gk","text":"Отделянето на цял ден за задълбочаване на медитацията може да бъде фантастичен тласък за редовната ви практика. Намерете спокойна и благоприятна за медитация среда. Това може да включва тихо място в градината или в близкия парк, или дори в група с други практикуващи.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"WWLiynktI8","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"fzgaccb5opw","text":"Много редовни сбирки за медитация предлагат еднодневни събития или дори уикенд за отдих. Целта им е да ви дадат времето и пространството, от които се нуждаете, за да изпитате истинското блаженство на медитацията. Намерете близката до вас сбирка, за да научите повече подробности за дните за медитация, към които можете да се присъедините.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"JK3fKouNi4","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"ri5brrcg6ib","text":"Как да започнем","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"aVF25WlfiZ","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"1srns14qpdt","text":"Редовното провеждане на медитация с водещ може да бъде чудесен начин за установяване на рутина. Нашият модул „Медитирай сега” генерира за вас водена медитация спрямо вашата цел - например, ако искате да се почувствате спокойни, радостни или съсредоточени и т.н., както и колко време имате на разположение.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"fBlFW-CYyi","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"7uwbxe84z7m","text":"„We meditate“ също така предлага ежеседмични медитации онлайн на живо, водени от опитни практикуващи. Не само ще бъдете водени през задълбочена медитативна сесия, но и ще научите повече за процеса на медитация и как да напредвате. Освен това общуването с други хора обикновено води до по-добро преживяване при медитация! Водим всички сесии на доброволни начала, напълно безплатно.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"_TSmztIKDr","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"ir9o66j3jl","text":"Заключение - включване на медитацията в живота ви","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"WaTYA86_3t","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"grvkoub3t1q","text":"Надяваме се, че вече знаете основите на това как да извлечете най-доброто от практикуването на медитация. Основното нещо, когато започвате, е да изпробвате различни варианти, за да видите кой ви подхожда най-добре. Дайте си време, бъдете търпеливи и след кратко време със сигурност ще започнете да усещате истинските ползи от редовната медитация.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"AVw4L-4den","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"3eio0bvaqwg","text":"Не се притеснявайте, ако пропуснете някоя сбирка или ако някоя медитация ви е „трудна”. Просто упорствайте и продължавайте, ден след ден. Не забравяйте, че силата на редовната медитация наистина се проявява, когато се изправите пред предизвикателства в живота. Не се отказвайте само защото сте получили лоши новини или нещата не вървят както трябва. Точно тогава най-много се нуждаете от баланса на медитацията.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"R6VrRTpVz-","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"ucgvunrpnlo","text":"Заключителна бележка: Ако се отнасяте към практиката си за медитация с уважение и отдаденост, тя ще ви се отплати хилядократно. Тя е потенциално променящо живота преживяване за тези, които сериозно желаят да се възползват от ползите от нея. Така че, наслаждавайте се, запазете спокойствие и медитирайте!","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"49sTQ4Z4M4","type":"action","data":{"id":"hv9yd4tuuoo","title":"","subtitle":"","text":"","action":"Meditate online now","url":"https://wemeditate.com/meditations","list_id":"","type":"button","form":"signup","spacing":"spaced","decorations":{"leaves":true}}}],"version":"2.23.2","markupVersion":3,"mediaFiles":[]}

translations.name: Best time to meditate: How to find the best time for you
translations.content: {"time":1675554640706,"blocks":[{"id":"25clEm-mU8","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"e6vmy54dc","text":"Finding the right time to meditate can be tricky. Especially if you're fairly new to meditation or have never meditated before. So when is the best time to do it? Does the time of day affect the experience of meditation? How can I find time to meditate when I already have so much to do? ","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"3FovJDI_vo","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"nnxoilv445r","text":"In reality, even a few minutes of being in a truly meditative state can be enough to bring a sense of complete calmness and clarity.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"Eg0aAKluUU","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"u7yy6fqrb4","text":"Here are a few tips for finding time to meditate and making it a habit that sticks.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"QvSdLdFait","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"d6q8b13m6q5","text":"Why finding time to meditate is important","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"s_SulEH3zZ","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"ec072co684","text":"The idea of yet another daily activity can seem daunting, especially with a busy schedule and a limited supply of energy. The beauty of meditation is it can make us more efficient in other tasks, and can actually save us time and energy.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"dw7QleIiDh","type":"media","data":{"id":"rfyiol0s96m","poster":{},"items":[{"image":{"id":1386,"preview":"https://assets.wemeditate.com/uploads/media_file/file/1386/small_175d82afda.jpg?version="},"alt":"Man meditating & recharging to full energy","caption":"","credit":""}],"mediaFiles":[1386],"youtube_id":"","type":"image","quantity":"single","position":"center","size":"narrow","decorations":{"triangle":{"alignment":"right"}}}},{"id":"2qWBhXnnrO","type":"whitespace","data":{"id":"5gfuc7h4p29","size":"small","decorations":{}}},{"id":"UV9flFW1HK","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"6v5hw7c8ma9","text":"Stress and anxiety slow down our minds and bodies, making it hard to do even simple tasks. Meditation is an effective way of reducing stress and removing feelings of anxiety. So the mind becomes more efficient and focused. The state of meditation is also associated with a spontaneous feeling of joy, and we even find tasks easier when we’re in a better mood!","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"WITRledurm","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"ximhh6q0vp","text":"Insomnia or insufficient sleep also makes our routine tasks seem like more of a chore. Meditation helps to relax the mind and the body, delivers a more restful night's sleep, and leaves us energised and ready to face the day.Is there a best time of day to meditate?","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"jbPCnyGqqw","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"a0kghp9sl2c","text":"Is there a best time of day to meditate?","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"-gCl3tWxY6","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"q1k2oxleefl","text":"So when should you be trying to find that window of time to meditate? In reality, meditation can take place at any time, anywhere, but here are some of the best times to try. ","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"VJDiWCvOzC","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"adoo04kjjzs","text":"Meditate in the morning","type":"header","level":"h3","decorations":{}}},{"id":"wJ5CE96Zi_","type":"media","data":{"id":"q15sn04fe4d","poster":{},"items":[{"image":{"id":1387,"preview":"https://assets.wemeditate.com/uploads/media_file/file/1387/small_acb60ce013.jpg?version="},"alt":"Woman meditating inside in the morning' sunrays","caption":"","credit":""}],"mediaFiles":[1387],"youtube_id":"","type":"image","quantity":"single","position":"center","size":"narrow","decorations":{"triangle":false}}},{"id":"kKl3qC140u","type":"whitespace","data":{"id":"v5xbf1lybii","size":"small","decorations":{}}},{"id":"UaAbCtqeSO","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"c4wb3rri0da","text":"The majority of regular meditators practice first thing in the morning. The effects of even a few minutes of true meditation - when you are completely aware but without thoughts - last well beyond the session. Thus, you are less likely to experience stress, anxiety and other negative feelings throughout the day","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"ONTj-_cLJU","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"4ny3eez3z9","text":"On a practical note, the early morning is when you are least likely to be disturbed, both by your own mind and by your environment. Washing or showering first is a good way to make sure you’re not too sleepy to go into meditation. And do try to meditate before you start other routine tasks, such as answering emails or organising your day. This way you have the best chance of experiencing a silent mind before thoughts of the day creep in.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"yHh_xRYaWR","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"7iulgl7d9mu","text":"Traditionally, ancient forms of meditation were practiced very early in the morning, at around 4am. At this hour it's easier to go into a meditative state, as you tune in with the rhythms of nature. While many of us don't usually start our days so early, it's a great personal goal to try to experience the peace of this special time at least once.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"BU5tlng0nE","type":"textbox","data":{"id":"eghkq8cwb9c","title":"","subtitle":"","caption":"","credit":"Shri Mataji Nirmala Devi","text":"“When you get up early in the morning your receptivity is more. Not only that, at that early hour the world is also extremely beautiful”","action":"","url":"","image":{"id":1383,"preview":"https://assets.wemeditate.com/uploads/media_file/file/1383/small_9c8f0c86db.jpg?version="},"mediaFiles":[1383],"type":"text","alignment":"center","style":"hero","spacing":"overlap","background":"white","color":"dark","position":"left","decorations":{"gradient":false,"leaves":false,"circle":false,"sidetext":false}}},{"id":"PjB74nHLXW","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"udijrakvvv","text":"Meditate after work","type":"header","level":"h3","decorations":{}}},{"id":"gTlqbg42DD","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"ggg4thpuwx9","text":"Our work is often a source of stress, which can overspill into our personal lives. Having a short meditation when we come home from work can help leave behind any negative experiences of the day. Meditation can prove useful even if you work from home. The brief mental silence can bring us out of working mode, and help us unwind before bedtime.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"WayrYVKcUz","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"2uh9ugx8byt","text":"If your home doesn't offer a peaceful environment, try meditating in a park or any other quiet space available to you. With an online guided meditation it can be easy to plug in your headphones and enjoy a moment of peace, before moving on to other things.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"dId5i9U21c","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"9n0itbt3jf","text":"Group meditation classes, either online or offline, are also a great way to unwind after work. Collective meditations offer a whole new and amazing level of experience. Connecting with the positive energy of others is a real boost to your own practice, and can make work problems quickly fade into distant memories.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"Sp7PtcBWHl","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"djdg31kgtju","text":"Meditate at night","type":"header","level":"h3","decorations":{}}},{"id":"ekz4SrlSUS","type":"media","data":{"id":"hvam6lra2k9","poster":{},"items":[{"image":{"id":1388,"preview":"https://assets.wemeditate.com/uploads/media_file/file/1388/small_e50213ebe9.jpg?version="},"alt":"Man meditating inside at night with a full moon ","caption":"","credit":""}],"mediaFiles":[1388],"youtube_id":"","type":"image","quantity":"single","position":"center","size":"narrow","decorations":{}}},{"id":"ZvTk3JCzSR","type":"whitespace","data":{"id":"9qhdiii4bjg","size":"small","decorations":{}}},{"id":"tIF3P_VhbT","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"dccuf94paok","text":"Getting a good night’s sleep is important for many aspects of our health and wellbeing. Stress, tension and even depression can all lead to disturbed sleep. To improve our sleep we need to treat the underlying causes, rather than just rely on drugs.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"4kDgOruy_Y","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"0ib9ilz9t6z","text":"Mental, emotional and physical stress occurs when there are energetic imbalances on our central nervous system. Meditation balances the activity on our central nervous system, releasing any tensions and blockages we have. Therefore meditating before bed can be a powerful antidote to sleeplessness by going straight to the root of the problem, rather than merely addressing the symptoms.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"8VFjypnGaf","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"pyz4didd9ur","text":"One great treatment to try out in combination with your evening meditation is a footsoak. This simple technique - meditating with our feet resting in a bowl of salted water - is a real boost to the inner cleansing that occurs during meditation, and is an easy way to ensure a peaceful night’s sleep.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"lIRNE8T8oZ","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"9j5c8f60qhc","text":"Even if you don’t have any problem sleeping at night, it is still a good idea to meditate before bed. Our state can be heavily affected by our environment during the day, so an evening meditation is a great way to correct any internal imbalances that we may have accumulated from outside influences.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"LNdjImJuDq","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"d1q8vnxbmk","text":"Meditate when you need it","type":"header","level":"h3","decorations":{}}},{"id":"wMYadNwItW","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"yaze6khboup","text":"As well establishing a regular meditation routine, you should also allow meditation to be a spontaneous activity. You can use it whenever you feel overwhelmed by your thoughts or emotions. Calming your thoughts and detaching from your surroundings - even for a minute - can be more than enough to recharge and rebalance. Some people have even been known to retreat to an office restroom stall to meditate after a particularly stressful event with their boss. It really can help!","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"Xp9uiIDrWs","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"r2dvo0m251s","text":"A genuine state of meditation, where the mind is completely silent yet alert, can have an incredibly soothing impact on our psyche. Thankfully all of us can reach this state thanks to a powerful living energy within us called ‘Kundalini’ in Sanskrit. When this energy is awakened it spontaneously cleanses us of any tensions. In this way we naturally transition into meditation.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"q5S0YlB5bp","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"y698zyfid4e","text":"Find out more about the Kundalini energy. ","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"qNpu6t2wuE","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"v7dvd8jjg18","text":"A dedicated space","type":"header","level":"h3","decorations":{}}},{"id":"e2nOGwX7b9","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"4hpou8a4q4m","text":"When you meditate can also be affected by where you meditate. Meditating after work may sound great, but if you can't find somewhere quiet it's clearly going to be tricky. While meditation has the remarkable ability to deliver beautiful inner silence, you should at least be able to sit comfortably without anyone disturbing you.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"ZKikPw6wDy","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"g54fezujjz","text":"One tip is when meditating at home, try sitting in the same spot each time and keep that area free of general clutter and mess. This will help you to see meditation as an important part of your daily routine and a respected choice that you're making for yourself.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"g7VXPEmwOb","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"g5muqg85qy","text":"Should I meditate before or after exercise?","type":"header","level":"h3","decorations":{}}},{"id":"OQ22do09zm","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"73z1kbwxa8a","text":"Like meditation, exercise helps to keep us in balance. It’s important for the two practices to complement each other to achieve overall balance. How they work together depends a lot on what time of day you usually exercise.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"WXwwxJKEX-","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"b7qehxn6fhq","text":"If you like to exercise in the morning, then try meditating beforehand. This way you have the best chance to enjoy a silent balanced mind before the day's pressures build up. If, however, you usually exercise later in the day, then meditating after your workout is a great way to wind down and completely relax the mind.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"GY-Yt_bY9r","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"larv9qx0iv","text":"Tips for finding time to meditate","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"LGt9tmj4AY","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"vheesscw33","text":"One of the problems many people experience is maintaining a regular meditation routine each day. Here are some simple ways to help you make meditation part and parcel of your daily lifestyle.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"dqZj8ZpSLr","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"q91rllub3y9","text":"Meditation time: Form a habit","type":"header","level":"h3","decorations":{}}},{"id":"7zd7bAKII1","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"zljj72ggjnn","text":"There are many small things we do on a daily basis without thinking about it. Try to see meditation as a daily cleansing event, like taking a spiritual shower, which you do at roughly the same time everyday.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"OwG8JuaGFH","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"uosdprt5qnd","text":"While it’s important that your meditations do not become forced and regimented, some self-discipline is necessary at first to make things easier. Most of us think nothing of spending a few minutes every day brushing our teeth. We know it is important and helps us stay healthy. Your meditation should be the same. A healthy beneficial habit that comes naturally. Be patient with yourself in the beginning, as the benefits will soon crowd out any procrastination or distractions.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"9AhHToo8cn","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"vphq7a3ak9n","text":"Group meditation","type":"header","level":"h3","decorations":{}}},{"id":"R6Czv123dB","type":"media","data":{"id":"fmb9myy9e0i","poster":{},"items":[{"image":{"id":1389,"preview":"https://assets.wemeditate.com/uploads/media_file/file/1389/small_0a5dfad652.jpg?version="},"alt":"Three people meditating together","caption":"","credit":""}],"mediaFiles":[1389],"youtube_id":"","type":"image","quantity":"single","position":"center","size":"narrow","decorations":{"triangle":{"alignment":"left"}}}},{"id":"wjIR6tiCur","type":"whitespace","data":{"id":"hg4s858p1qm","size":"small","decorations":{}}},{"id":"EIQPwukH2I","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"ysymnan2pri","text":"Meditating with a group is a great way to mark out a regular and essential time slot for your meditation. On top of that, meeting others who also meditate can serve as a great source of motivation as you can encourage and inspire one another.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"wspjdvERQV","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"0192svgr0z17f","text":"Whether it’s online or at a physical location, there are weekly group meditations happening in hundreds of cities around the world. Find a class near you or join a live session in your timezone to help you establish your practice and experience the power of collective meditation.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"aufk2TSrAc","type":"action","data":{"id":"qck6v9taiqb","title":"","subtitle":"","text":"","action":"Join a group meditation","url":"https://wemeditate.com/live","list_id":"","type":"button","form":"signup","spacing":"spaced","decorations":{"leaves":true}}},{"id":"Y1Fjtd4aOy","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"7xeicdavewl","text":"Meditation days","type":"header","level":"h3","decorations":{}}},{"id":"miyWAwovwI","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"zatt7sln8gk","text":"Setting aside a whole day to go deeper in your meditation can be a fantastic boost to your regular practice. Find a peaceful environment which is beneficial to meditation. This could include a quiet spot in your garden or a nearby park, or even with a group of other practitioners.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"WWLiynktI8","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"fzgaccb5opw","text":"Many regular meditation classes offer one-off day events or even weekend retreats. They aim to give you the time and space you need to experience the true bliss of meditation. Find a class near you to find out more details about meditation days you can join.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"JK3fKouNi4","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"ri5brrcg6ib","text":"How to get started","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"aVF25WlfiZ","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"1srns14qpdt","text":"Following a regular guided meditation can be a great way to establish a routine. Our ‘Meditate Now’ tool generates a guided meditation for you based on your goal - e.g. if you wish to feel calm, joyful or focused etc. - and how much time you have available.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"fBlFW-CYyi","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"7uwbxe84z7m","text":"We Meditate also offers weekly live streamed meditations led by experienced practitioners. Not only will you be guided through an in-depth meditation session, but you will also learn more about the process of meditation and how to progress. Plus, connecting with others usually leads to a better meditation experience! We lead all sessions on a voluntary basis, completely free of charge.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"_TSmztIKDr","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"ir9o66j3jl","text":"Conclusion - embedding meditation in your life","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"WaTYA86_3t","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"grvkoub3t1q","text":"Hopefully you now know the basics of getting the best out of your meditation practice. The key thing when you start is to try out different options to see which suits you best. Give it time, be patient and after a short time you will definitely start to feel the real benefits of regular meditation.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"AVw4L-4den","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"3eio0bvaqwg","text":"Do not worry if you miss a session or if one meditation is 'difficult'. Just persevere and keep going, one day at a time. Remember that the power of regular meditation really comes into its own when you face challenges in life. Don't give up just because you receive some bad news, or things aren't going right. That's the exact time when you need the balance of meditation the most.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"R6VrRTpVz-","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"ucgvunrpnlo","text":"Final note: If you treat your meditation practice with respect and dedication it will repay you a thousand times over. It is a potentially life-changing experience for those who are serious about reaping the benefits. So enjoy, stay calm and meditate on!","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"49sTQ4Z4M4","type":"action","data":{"id":"hv9yd4tuuoo","title":"","subtitle":"","text":"","action":"Meditate online now","url":"https://wemeditate.com/meditations","list_id":"","type":"button","form":"signup","spacing":"spaced","decorations":{"leaves":true}}}],"version":"2.23.2","markupVersion":3,"mediaFiles":[]}

translations.content: {"time":1679143212016,"blocks":[{"id":"DK0pWeFBvn","type":"media","data":{"id":"989kjt4au0u","poster":{},"items":[{"image":{"id":1459,"preview":"https://assets.wemeditate.com/uploads/media_file/file/1459/small_c3f29f4afb.png?version="},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""}],"mediaFiles":[1459],"youtube_id":"","type":"image","quantity":"single","position":"center","size":"narrow","decorations":{}}},{"id":"Pkg56Mz1nw","type":"textbox","data":{"id":"g9ftbjzn9pj","title":"Познанието за корените","subtitle":"","caption":"","credit":"Шри Матаджи Нирмала Деви на Публична програма в Кардиф, Уелс (Англия) 08 август 1984 г.","text":""Много хора нямат никаква идея какво трябва да очакват и също са доста наивни относно структурата или естеството на това Дърво на живота, което е вградено вътре в нас. Онова, за което ще ви говоря, е Познанието за корените. Въпреки нашето развитие, имаме само Познанието за дървото, но трябва да имаме и Познанието за корените, което поддържа дървото. Ако не притежаваме това Познание, един ден огромното дърво, което виждаме и ни изглежда доста стабилно, може напълно да разрушено. Така че е важно за всеки един от нас да има това Познание за корените вътре в нас и в обществото, както и в човешките същества като цяло."
