Words"},"gradient":{"alignment":"left","color":"orange"}}}},{"type":"textbox","data":{"id":"195pc4frs6ph","image":{"id":497,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/497/small_Left_Channel_-_Fire.jpg"},"title":"Fire","text":"Since man’s discovery of fire, it has played a central role in our daily lives, not only as a practical tool for light, heating and warding off danger, but also as a depiction of the human spirit and a sacred element used in rituals and worship.\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003eThe intrinsic relationship between fire and spirituality can be seen across many different cultures and religions throughout the ages. The very same flame which is lit today during the Olympic Games is reminiscent of the flame that the ancient Greeks burnt in honour of Zeus during major religious festivals. In the bible, God comes before man numerous times in the form of a holy fire, such as the burning bush which speaks to Moses. Agni, the Hindu god of fire, is mentioned more times in the Vedic hymns than any other deity and Hindu worship of other gods is mostly through fire rituals. This is because out of the four elements (earth, water, fire and air) fire is the only element which cannot be polluted.\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003eWhile the practices and beliefs surrounding the spiritual significance of fire differ from person to person, what is undeniable is fire’s ability to comfort and soothe us. Whether we’re curled up by the fire on a winter’s evening, or eating dinner by candlelight, just the sight of a flame can burn away any negative feelings and lift our spirits.","action":"","url":"","type":"image","background":"ornate","color":"dark","position":"right","spacing":"overlap","mediaFiles":[497],"decorations":{"sidetext":{"text":"Ancient Knowledge"}}}}],"version":"2.16.0","media_files":[],"markupVersion":3}

translations.content:
{"time":1754929112629,"blocks":[{"id":"CPP_BCCnB7","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"lkbh7cfigw","text":"Calitățile canalului stâng","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"gVae32fmTl","type":"media","data":{"id":"isoxtf7em07","poster":{},"items":[{"image":{"id":957,"preview":"https://assets.wemeditate.co/uploads/media_file/file/957/small_993012dc4d.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""}],"mediaFiles":[957],"youtube_id":"","type":"image","quantity":"single","position":"left","size":"narrow","decorations":{}}},{"id":"RSH3K--cq5","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Canalul stâng al sistemului nervos central guvernează dorințele și emoțiile. Trezirea energiei noastre Kundalini, prin procesul Realizării Sinelui, este facilitată de dorința pură de a ne cunoaște adevăratul Sine.","type":"text"}},{"id":"OEW9cLRLil","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Acest canal se poate bloca dacă suntem prea sentimentali, dacă avem tendința de a ne întrista, de a deveni letargici cu ușurință sau dacă ne reprimăm sentimentele și emoțiile devenind, prin urmare, foarte duri cu noi înșine. Astfel, curățând canalul stâng, putem experimenta emoții absolute, cum ar fi iubirea necondiționată, pacea și bucuria.","type":"text"}},{"id":"9BalTRTtNm","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"b2x48tzrc8b","text":"Canalul stâng corespunde și relației noastre cu trecutul. Atunci când experimentăm emoții negative, motivul poate fi reprezentat de faptul că în subconștient, avem o experiență neplăcută care ne determină să ne închidem inimile și să reacționăm negativ, mai degrabă decât să tratăm situația actuală cu o inimă curată, deschisă. Prin urmare, spunem despre o persoană că este „pe stânga” dacă ea trăiește mai mult în trecut, devine excesiv de sentimentală, este ușor deprimabilă și demotivabilă.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"a4ks4wBaNZ","type":"textbox","data":{"id":"n1iovfjtlsn","title":"Cum echilibrăm Canalul Stâng.","subtitle":"","caption":"","credit":"","text":"Prin manifestarea calităților canalului stâng în viața noastră de zi cu zi, acest canal poate deveni mai puternic, ajutându-ne să aprofundăm meditația și făcându-ne mai puțin sensibili la dezechilibre. Când neglijăm acest canal, putem fie să ne deconectăm de partea emoțională, fie să ne adâncim prea mult în ea și să devenim melancolici sau letargici. Sfaturi pentru echilibrarea canalului stâng: • încercă să te trezești dimineața devreme. Întreaga natură se trezește devreme și energia care rezultă din a fi în armonie cu acest ritm ne ajută să păstrăm o stare de spirit pozitivă • dacă simți că îți este greu uneori să îți exprimi sentimentele, plimbă-te prin soare și permite razelor calde să-ți relaxeze corpul și să-ți deschidă inima • încearcă să meditezi afară pe pământ. Pământul are o capacitate uimitoare de a ne oferi stabilitate și de a ne elibera de sentimente negative

Relația intrinsecă dintre foc și spiritualitate poate fi observată în mai multe culturi și religii diferite de-a lungul veacurilor. Aceeași flacără aprinsă astăzi în timpul Jocurilor Olimpice este o reminiscență a flăcării pe care grecii antici o aprindeau în onoarea lui Zeus în timpul ritualurilor religioase antice. În Biblie, Dumnezeu i se arată omului de nenumărate ori sub forma unui foc sfânt, cum ar fi tufișul arzător care vorbește cu Moise. Agni, zeul focului hindus, este amintit mai mult decât orice altă zeitate în imnurile vedice și adorarea hindusă a altor zei se face mai ales prin ritualuri cu foc. Acest lucru se datorează faptului că dintre cele patru elemente (pământ, apă, foc și aer), focul este singurul element care nu poate fi poluat. Deși practicile și credințele care însoțesc semnificația spirituală a focului diferă de la o persoană la alta, este incontestabilă capacitatea focului de a ne mângâia și de a ne calma. Fie că ne-am înghesuit la foc într-o seară de iarnă, fie că am luat cina la lumina lumânărilor, simplul fapt de a privi flacăra unei lumânări arde sentimentele negative și ne poate schimba starea de spirit.

translations.name: Левый Канал
translations.content: {"time":1588799511663,"blocks":[{"type":"textbox","data":{"id":"57ty1bkqian","image":{"id":450,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/450/small_Left_Channel_1.jpg"},"title":"Качества Левого Канала","text":"Левый канал центральной нервной системы управляет нашими желаниями и эмоциями. Для пробуждения энергии Кундалини необходимо чистое желание познать самого себя, поэтому протокол самореализации проходит по левой стороне. Этот канал блокируется чрезмерной эмоциональностью, незаметно ведущей либо к подавленному настроению и апатии, либо к полному отсутствию эмоций и жестокости по отношению к себе. Очищая левый канал, можно испытать такие совершенные эмоции, как безусловная любовь, умиротворение и радость. \u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003eЛевый канал также представляет нашу связь с прошлым. Часто мы испытываем негативные эмоции лишь потому, что подсознательно цепляемся за неудачный опыт. Неприятный прошлый опыт закрывает наше сердце и влечет за собой негативное отношение к ситуации, вместо того чтобы  с чистым сердцем принять действительность, какой бы она ни была. \"Левосторонний\" человек обычно живёт прошлым, чрезмерно сентиментален, легко впадает в уныние и чувствует себя никому не нужным.  \u003cbr\u003e","action":"","url":"","type":"image","background":"white","color":"dark","position":"right","spacing":"separate","mediaFiles":[450],"decorations":{}}},{"type":"textbox","data":{"id":"n1iovfjtlsn","image":{"id":495,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/495/small_in_life_background.jpg"},"title":"Как сбалансировать левый канал","text":"Проявляя качества левого канала в повседневной жизни, мы укрепляем его, благодаря чему медитации становятся глубже, и мы меньше подвержены дисбалансу. Когда мы пренебрегаем левым каналом, мы либо превращаемся в очень сухого человека, либо слишком погружаемся в эмоции, становясь меланхоличным или апатичным.\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003eСоветы по улучшению состояния левого канала:\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003e- Постарайся вставать рано утром. Вся природа пробуждается рано, и энергия, созвучная ритму природы, помогает выйти из любой затяжной летаргии.\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003e- Если ты чувствуешь, что иногда бывает трудно проявлять свои чувства, попробуй почаще гулять при солнечном свете, позволив теплым лучам солнца расслабить тебя и открыть твоё сердце.\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003e- Попробуй медитировать на природе, на земле. Земля обладает удивительной способностью давать ощущение стабильности и избавлять от неприятных чувств.","action":"","url":"","type":"image","background":"image","color":"light","position":"left","spacing":"overlap","mediaFiles":[495],"decorations":{"sidetext":{"text":"В Жизни"}}}},{"type":"catalog","data":{"id":"nnn652w4nxf","title":"","items":[3,1,4],"type":"treatments","style":"image","decorations":{"sidetext":{"text":"Методы Очистки"}}}},{"type":"vimeo","data":{"id":"bqrg8ujj9lo","items":[{"vimeo_id":"357375134","thumbnail":"https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830579333_1280x720.jpg?r=pad","thumbnail_srcset":"https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830579333_100x75.jpg?r=pad 100w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830579333_200x150.jpg?r=pad 200w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830579333_295x166.jpg?r=pad 295w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830579333_640x360.jpg?r=pad 640w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830579333_1280x720.jpg?r=pad 1280w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830579333_1920x1080.jpg?r=pad 1920w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830579333_640x360.jpg?r=pad 640w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830579333_960x540.jpg?r=pad 960w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830579333_1280x720.jpg?r=pad 1280w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830579333_1920x1080.jpg?r=pad 1920w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830579333_1280x720.jpg?r=pad 1280w","title":"Шри Матаджи о левом канале"}],"quantity":"single","legacy":true,"decorations":{"sidetext":{"text":"Слова Шри Матаджи"},"gradient":{"alignment":"left","color":"orange"}}}},{"type":"textbox","data":{"id":"195pc4frs6ph","image":{"id":497,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/497/small_Left_Channel_-_Fire.jpg"},"title":"Огонь","text":"С тех пор, как человечество открыло огонь, он играет центральную роль в нашей жизни. Огонь используется не только в качестве средства освещения, обогрева и защиты от опасности, но и как образ духа человека и священный элемент в ритуалах и богослужениях. \u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003eНеотделимую связь между огнем и духовностью можно проследить на протяжении веков в разных культурах и вероучениях. Сегодня во время Олимпийских игр зажигается тот же огонь, что зажигался древними греками в честь Зевса при проведении крупных религиозных празднований. В Библии бог много раз предстаёт перед человеком в форме священного огня, в том числе в виде горящего куста, говорящего с Моисеем. Агни, индуистский бог огня, упоминается в ведических гимнах чаще, чем любое другое божество, и огонь используется во множестве религиозных ритуалов, посвящённым другим богам. Это всё потому что из четырех природных элементов (земля, вода, огонь, воздух) огонь является единственным элементом, который не подвластен загрязнению.\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003eХотя способы применения огня в быту и религиозные догматы, связанные с духовным смыслом огня, заметно отличаются в разных религиях, способность огня успокаивать и создавать комфортную обстановку никем не ставится под сомнение. Неважно, свернулся ли ты калачиком в зимний вечер у камина или наслаждаешься ужином при свечах, только при одном лишь созерцании пламени сгорают любые негативные чувства и поднимается настроение.","action":"","url":"","type":"image","background":"ornate","color":"dark","position":"right","spacing":"overlap","mediaFiles":[497],"decorations":{"sidetext":{"text":"Древнее Знание"}}}}],"version":"2.16.0","media_files":[],"markupVersion":3}

{"time":1690641348583,"blocks":[{"id":"4MBjnMCCnC","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"lkbh7cfigw","text":"Sol Kanalın Kaliteleri","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"floPwy1YI4","type":"media","data":{"id":"isoxtf7em07","poster":{},"items":[{"image":{"id":957,"preview":"https://assets.wemeditate.co/uploads/media_file/file/957/small_993012dc4d.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""}],"mediaFiles":[957],"youtube_id":"","type":"image","quantity":"single","position":"left","size":"narrow","decorations":{}}},{"id":"xoqxvkZjCE","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"4lrv5xnqucy","text":"Merkezi sinir sistemimizin sol kanalı arzularımızı ve duygularımızı yönetir. Aydınlanma deneyimi ile Kundalini Enerjisi'nin uyanışı sizin kendi gerçek özünüzü tanımanız için olan saf arzunuz sayesinde kolaylaşır. Bu kanal ya aşırı duygusallıkla, ya da kolayca üzgün ve letarjik olmamız sebebiyle veya duygularımızı tamamen bloke etmekle ve kendimize sert davrandığımızda tıkanır. Sol kanalımızı temizleyerek biz, koşulsuz olan sevgi, huzur ve neşe gibi saf olan duyguları deneyimleyebiliriz.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"_wF73aHoB6","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"me0vkeyljaq","text":"Sol kanal ayrıca geçmişimizle olan ilişkimizle ilgilidir. Bizlerin negatif bir duyguyu hissetmemizin sebebi, şu anda gerçekleşen bir olaya açık temiz bir kalple yaklaşmak yerine, daha çok bilinçaltlarımızda, kalplerimizi kapamamıza ve negatif olarak reaksiyon vermemize sebep olan kötü bir deneyimi tuttuğumuz içindir. Bu yüzden daha çok 'sol kanal' olarak tanımlanabilecek kişiler genellikle geçmişte yaşarlar, aşırı hassas olur ve kolaylıkla kendilerini morali bozuk ve motivasyonsuz hissederler.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"6mRhnNSmCb","type":"textbox","data":{"id":"n1iovfjtlsn","title":"Sol Kanal nasıl dengeye getirilir?","subtitle":"","caption":"","credit":"","text":"Sol kanalımızın kalitelerinin günlük yaşantımızda tezahür etmesiyle, bu kanal daha fazla güçlenir, meditasyonlarımız derinleşir ve bu kanalın dengesizliklerinden daha az etkilenir hale geliriz. Bu kanalı ihmal ettiğimizde, ya duygusal yanımızla tamamen bağlantımız kopar ya da geçmiş içine çok düşeriz veya melankoli ya da letarjik oluruz.                                                                              
Sol kanalımızı geliştirmek için ipuçları:

- Sabah erken saatte kalkmaya çalışın. Tüm doğa erken saatte uyanır ve akan bu enerji ile aynı ritimde olmak kendi üzermizdeki herhangi bir letarjik durumu üzerimizden atmanızı sağlar.

- Eğer bazen duygularınızı ifade etmekte zorlanıyorsanuz, güneş ışığının altında bir yürüyüşe çıkın ve onun ılık ışınlarının bedeninizi rahatlattığını ve kalbinizi açtığını hissedin.

-Dışarda toprak üzerinde meditasyon yapmayı deneyin. Toprağın istikrar veren ve ağır duyguları hafifleten inanılmaz bir kapasitesi vardır.
","action":"","url":"","image":{"id":495,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/495/small_in_life_background.jpg"},"mediaFiles":[495],"type":"image","alignment":"left","style":"hero","spacing":"overlap","background":"image","color":"light","position":"left","decorations":{"sidetext":{"text":"IN LIFE"}}}},{"id":"KWhKn7wr37","type":"catalog","data":{"id":"nnn652w4nxf","title":"","items":[3,1,4],"type":"treatments","style":"image","decorations":{"sidetext":{"text":"CLEANSING TECHNIQUES"}}}},{"id":"TlyUdih_I5","type":"vimeo","data":{"id":"bqrg8ujj9lo","items":[{"vimeo_id":"357375134","thumbnail":"https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830579333_1280x720.jpg?r=pad","thumbnail_srcset":"https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830579333_100x75.jpg?r=pad 100w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830579333_200x150.jpg?r=pad 200w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830579333_295x166.jpg?r=pad 295w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830579333_640x360.jpg?r=pad 640w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830579333_1280x720.jpg?r=pad 1280w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830579333_1920x1080.jpg?r=pad 1920w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830579333_640x360.jpg?r=pad 640w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830579333_960x540.jpg?r=pad 960w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830579333_1280x720.jpg?r=pad 1280w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830579333_1920x1080.jpg?r=pad 1920w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830579333_1280x720.jpg?r=pad 1280w","title":"Shri Mataji on The Left Channel"}],"legacy":true}},{"id":"kACPYDgCH2","type":"textbox","data":{"id":"195pc4frs6ph","title":"Ateş","subtitle":"","caption":"","credit":"","text":"İnsanın ateşi keşfetmesinden beri, ateş hayatlarımızda önemli bir rol oynamıştır; sadece ışık, ısıtma ve tehlikelerden korunmada pratik bir araç olarak kullanılmasıyla değil, aynı zamanda insan ruhunun tasviri ve kutsal bir element olarak dini törenler ve ibadetlerde de büyük önemi vardı. Ruhaniyet ile ateş arasındaki yaradılıştan gelen ilişki çağlar boyunca birçok kültür ve dinlerde görülebilir. Bugün Olimpik Oyunlarda yakılan alev, eski Yunanlıların büyük dini bayramlarında Zeus onuruna yaktıkları alevi anımsatır. İncil'de Tanrı, Hz. Musa'yla konuşan yanan çalı gibi kutsal bir ateş formunda birçok kez insanoğlunun karşısına çıkar. Hindu Ateş Tanrısı Agni'den, Vedik ilahilerde diğer tanrılardan daha fazla bahsedilir ve Hindular diğer tanrılara çoğunlukla ateş ritüelleriyle ibadet ederler. Bunun nedeni, dört element arasından (toprak, su, ateş ve hava) kirletilemeyen tek elementin ateş olmasıdır.

Ateşin ruhani önemini çevreleyen uygulamalar ve inançlar kişiden kişiye farklılık gösterse de, ateşin bizi rahatlatma ve yatıştırma özelliği inkar edilemez. İster bir kış akşamı ateşin yanında kıvrılmış olalım, ister mum ışığında akşam yemeği yerken, bir alevin görüntüsü bile tüm olumsuz duygularımızı yakıp alabilir ve moralimizi düzeltebilir.","action":"","url":"","image":{"id":497,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/497/small_Left_Channel_-_Fire.jpg"},"mediaFiles":[497],"type":"image","alignment":"left","style":"hero","spacing":"overlap","background":"ornate","color":"dark","position":"right","decorations":{"sidetext":{"text":"Ancient Knowledge"}}}}],"version":"2.23.2","markupVersion":3,"mediaFiles":[]}

translations.content: {"time":1627567451719,"blocks":[{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"lkbh7cfigw","text":"Якості лівого каналу","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"type":"media","data":{"id":"isoxtf7em07","items":[{"image":{"id":957,"preview":"https://assets.wemeditate.co/uploads/media_file/file/957/small_993012dc4d.jpg"},"alt":"Лівий канал починається з лівого аспекту Муладхари чакри, перетинає Агію чакру та закінчується справа на голові нашим суперего. Зазвичай зображується синім кольором.","caption":"","credit":""}],"type":"image","quantity":"single","position":"left","size":"normal","mediaFiles":[957],"decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"sgfz8ghrkqa","text":"Лівий канал центральної нервової системи керує нашими бажаннями та емоціями. Оскільки для пробудження енергії Кундаліні в процесі Самореалізації важливим є наше чисте бажання пізнати себе, значна увага під час протоколу Самореалізації приділяється саме лівому каналу. До блокування цього каналу можуть призводити надмірна емоційність, схильність легко піддаватись смутку та апатії, а, з іншого боку, повне пригнічення власних емоцій та жорстоке ставлення до самих себе. Якщо очистити лівий канал, ми зможемо насолоджуватись такими абсолютними емоціями, як безумовна любов, внутрішній мир та радість.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"25cqiibpecj","text":"Лівий канал також слугує нашим зв’язком із  минулим. Часто ми відчуваємо негативні емоції через те, що підсвідомо тримаємось за поганий досвід з минулого, який змушує нас «закриватись» та піддаватись негативу замість того, щоб з відкритим серцем сприймати те, що відбувається зараз, у цей момент. Саме тому людина, яка більшою мірою є «лівосторонньою», як правило, тримається за минуле, стає надміру сентиментальною, швидко занепадає духом та відчуває відсутність мотивації.","type":"text"}},{"type":"textbox","data":{"id":"n1iovfjtlsn","image":{"id":495,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/495/small_in_life_background.jpg"},"title":"Як збалансувати лівий канал","text":"Проявляючи якості цього каналу у повсякденному житті, ми зможемо зміцнити наш лівий канал, що зробить медитацію більш глибокою, а нас – менш схильними до втрати рівноваги. Якщо ж не приділяти уваги цьому каналу, є ризик повністю втратити нашу емоційність, або ж, навпаки, зануритись в неї занадто сильно, перетворившись на меланхолійну чи апатичну людину.\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003eПоради для покращення стану лівого каналу: \u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003e-\tСпробуйте вставати рано вранці. Природа прокидається рано; коли ми налаштовуємось на її ритм та перебуваємо в гармонії з нею, це дає нам енергію, щоб позбутися будь-якої летаргії.\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003e-\tЯкщо ви відчуваєте, що часом вам важко проявляти свої почуття, виходьте на прогулянку на сонце та дозвольте його теплому промінню розслабити ваше тіло та відкрити серце.\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003e-\tСпробуйте медитувати надворі, сидячи на землі. Земля має надзвичайну здатність надавати нам відчуття стабільності та звільняти від важких емоцій.","action":"","url":"","type":"image","background":"image","color":"light","position":"left","spacing":"overlap","mediaFiles":[495],"decorations":{"sidetext":{"text":"В житті"}}}},{"type":"catalog","data":{"id":"nnn652w4nxf","title":"","items":[3,1,4],"type":"treatments","style":"image","decorations":{"sidetext":{"text":"Методи очищення"}}}},{"type":"vimeo","data":{"id":"bqrg8ujj9lo","items":[{"vimeo_id":"563198195","thumbnail":"https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/1201678446_1920x1080?r=pad","thumbnail_srcset":"https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/1201678446_100x75?r=pad 100w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/1201678446_200x150?r=pad 200w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/1201678446_295x166?r=pad 295w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/1201678446_640x360?r=pad 640w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/1201678446_960x540?r=pad 960w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/1201678446_1280x720?r=pad 1280w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/1201678446_1920x1080?r=pad 1920w","title":"Шрі Матаджі про лівий канал"}],"quantity":"single","legacy":true,"decorations":{"sidetext":{"text":"Слова Шрі Матаджі"},"gradient":{"alignment":"left","color":"orange"}}}},{"type":"textbox","data":{"id":"195pc4frs6ph","image":{"id":497,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/497/small_Left_Channel_-_Fire.jpg"},"title":"Вогонь","text":"Відтоді як було винайдено вогонь, він  відігравав важливу роль в житті людини. Вогонь використовувався не лише для практичних цілей як джерело світла, опалення, за допомогою якого можна було відвернути небезпеку, але й слугував символом людського духу та священним елементом під час ритуалів та поклонінь.\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003eПротягом багатьох століть в різних культурах та релігіях простежується нерозривний зв’язок між вогнем та духовністю. Вогонь, який сьогодні запалюють під час Олімпійських ігор, нагадує нам про багаття, яке давні греки запалювали на честь бога Зевса під час основних релігійних святкувань. У Біблії Бог неодноразово являється людині у формі священного вогню, наприклад, як Неопалима Купина, що говорила до Мойсея. Агні, індуїстський бог вогню, згадується в ведичних гімнах частіше за інших божеств, а поклоніння іншим богам в індуїзмі здійснюється здебільшого через ритуали з використанням вогню. Причиною цього є те, що вогонь єдиний з чотирьох елементів (як то земля, вода, вогонь та повітря), який не можна забруднити.\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003eІ хоча способи його використання та вірування, пов’язані з духовним значенням вогню, можуть значно відрізнятись, беззаперечною залишається його здатність розраджувати та заспокоювати людину. Чи то ми зручно вмощуємось біля багаття зимового вечора, чи вечеряємо при свічках, саме лише споглядання вогню здатне спопелити всі негативні відчуття та підняти наш дух.","action":"","url":"","type":"image","background":"ornate","color":"dark","position":"right","spacing":"overlap","mediaFiles":[497],"decorations":{"sidetext":{"text":"Древнє знання"}}}}],"version":"2.16.0","media_files":[],"markupVersion":3}

{"time":1671272615376,"blocks":[{"id":"CPUbyCXowu","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"bl0gaknunbk","text":"Качества на Централния канал","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"isDhSjjzVc","type":"media","data":{"id":"4bg24h5xa2u","poster":{},"items":[{"image":{"id":959,"preview":"https://assets.wemeditate.co/uploads/media_file/file/959/small_8394ebeb78.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""}],"mediaFiles":[959],"type":"image","quantity":"single","position":"left","size":"narrow","decorations":{}}},{"id":"29u9a701uI","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"qmjd1rr8pod","text":"Централният канал е свързан с принципа на издигането и със способността да търсим истината. Когато вече не търсим материално благополучие, а искаме да намерим по-дълбоко чувство на удовлетвореност и цел, именно чрез качествата на централния канал можем да постигнем тази по-висша цел.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"WrRAw0lQy3","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"l52nvmhjfz","text":"Левият канал завършва със суперегото, където са нашите обусловености, десният канал завършва с егото, а между тях преминава централният канал, който води до Сахасрара чакра. Когато тази чакра е отворена, движението на Кундалини по централния канал ни въвежда в състояние на съзнание без мисли. Затова ключът към постигането на истинско състояние на медитация, на блаженство и на просветлено съзнание е да станем по-балансирана личност, която не изпада в крайности в умствено, емоционално или физическо отношение. Това може да бъде постигнато като пречистваме централния си канал и относително често издигаме Кундалини, като по този начин я подсилваме.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"6gZkFIOi_L","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"7ylkjmynxec","text":"Когато централният ни канал е пречистен, светогледът ни по естествен начин се определя от един изначално вроден в нас морал, а действията ни от само себе си започват да подхранват нашето същество, тъй като са балансирани. Този баланс е ключът към извисяването. Когато не изпадаме в крайности с левостранни или десностранни настроения или действия, вниманието ни, а с него и енергията ни, по естествен начин се насочват към това, което е издигащо и благоприятно за нашата духовна еволюция.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"WO5rHkdi_5","type":"textbox","data":{"id":"r7hvw39j2z","title":"Как да балансираме Централния канал","subtitle":"","caption":"","credit":"","text":"Като проявяваме качествата на своя централен канал в ежедневието си, подсилваме този канал, което задълбочава медитациите ни и ни прави по-неподатливи към дисбаланс. Когато го пренебрегваме, може да усещаме липса на баланс в нас и да ни е трудно, когато се опитваме постигнем състояние на умствен тишина.

Съвети за подобряване на централния канал: \n\n- Изправени пред дилема или трудно решение, опитвайте се да намерите балансиран подход, като не защитавате крайни мнения и не се опирате на дългогодишни навици. Намирането на средно положение е ключов фактор в поддържането на балансирано състояние.

- Опитвайте да се фокусирате върху собствените си действия вместо върху действията на другите. Самонаблюдението е от ключово значение за поддържане на баланс.

- Бъдете удовлетворени от тялото си. Важно е да го поддържате в добро здраве, но не пилейте внимание и енергия за друго.

- Не правете разлика между религиите и не осъждайте корените на техните учения. Вместо това търсете истината в тях и не обръщайте внимание на различните интерпретации.","action":"","url":"","image":{"id":502,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/502/small_in_life_background.jpg"},"mediaFiles":[502],"type":"image","alignment":"left","style":"hero","spacing":"overlap","background":"image","color":"light","position":"left","decorations":{"sidetext":{"text":"В живота"}}}},{"id":"IEtBn1UVEX","type":"catalog","data":{"id":"cxeoos7psm","title":"","items":[1,4],"type":"treatments","style":"image","decorations":{"sidetext":{"text":"Cleansing techniques"}}}},{"id":"f84oJf2rKA","type":"vimeo","data":{"id":"b88iecwu3l","items":[{"vimeo_id":"357376311","thumbnail":"https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830578998_1280x720.jpg?r=pad","thumbnail_srcset":"https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830578998_100x75.jpg?r=pad 100w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830578998_200x150.jpg?r=pad 200w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830578998_295x166.jpg?r=pad 295w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830578998_640x360.jpg?r=pad 640w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830578998_1280x720.jpg?r=pad 1280w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830578998_1920x1080.jpg?r=pad 1920w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830578998_640x360.jpg?r=pad 640w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830578998_960x540.jpg?r=pad 960w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830578998_1280x720.jpg?r=pad 1280w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830578998_1920x1080.jpg?r=pad 1920w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830578998_1280x720.jpg?r=pad 1280w","title":"Шри Матаджи говори за Централния канал"}],"legacy":true}},{"id":"g6Oz0YWUNs","type":"textbox","data":{"id":"r8aysxqaejr","title":"Колективно Подсъзнание","subtitle":"","caption":"","credit":"","text":"В западния свят понятието „колективно несъзнавано (колективна неосъзната от човека енергийна сфера)“ е формулирано за първи път през 1916 г. от швейцарския психолог Карл Юнг. Според Юнг съществува изначална личност, присъща на всяко човешко същество, различна от аспектите на индивида, които се изграждат като реакция към околната среда. Юнг описва процес, наречен индивидуализация, при който личността се формира от недиференцираното несъзнавано, върху което се наслагват преживяванията на човека, и в резултат се образува едно добре функциониращо цяло. Това е „спонтанен, естествен и автономен, потенциално даден в психиката на всеки човек, процес, най-често неосъзнаван” (Й. Якоби, „Психологията на Юнг“, с. 140). С други думи, човек изгражда своята личност и действа, напътстван подсъзнателно от една всепроникваща енергия, присъща и достъпна за всички.

Централният канал е от съществено значение за проникване в това колективно несъзнавано. Когато Кундалини се издигане по централния канал и премине отвъд седмата чакра, Сахасрара, навлизаме в състояние на истинска медитация, без мисли. При тази медитация сме в пълно съзнание (за разлика от всякакъв вид транс), но в ума ни цари тишина. В това състояние човек преминава отвъд съзнателния ум и се свързва с колективното несъзнавано.

Процесът, наречен „индивидуализация”, всъщност е това, което човек преживява, когато получи своята Себереализация, когато Кундалини се събуди. По този начин медитацията ни позволява да израснем в личност, която е неразделна част от едно по-голямо цяло.

translations.name: Střední Kanál
translations.content:
{"time":1587913763212,"blocks":[{"type":"textbox","data":{"id":"0ohzg709rl9m","image":{"id":501,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/501/small_Central_Channel_1.jpg"},"title":"Kvality středního kanálu","text":"Střední kanál odpovídá našemu principu vzestupu a naší kvalitě „hledat pravdu“. Když už nehledáme materiální blahobyt, ale přejeme si najít pocit spokojenosti a smysl života uvnitř sebe, je to právě prostřednictvím kvalit uložených v našem středním kanálu.

Zatímco levý kanál kulminuje v superegu nebo našich zvyklostech a pravý kanál v našem egu, střední kanál vede k Sahasrára čakře. Když se naše Kundaliní pohybuje podél našeho středního (centrálního) kanálu a prochází naší Sahasrára čakrou, dostáváme se do stavu bezmyšlenkového vědomí. Klíčem k dosažení skutečného stavu meditace, blaženosti a osvíceného vědomí, je proto stát se více vyrovnanou osobností, která nemá sklony ani k emočním, mentálním ani fyzickým extrémům. Toho lze dosáhnout vyčištěním našeho středního kanálu a opakovaným zvedáním Kundaliní, čímž se náš střední kanál posílí a vyživí.

Když je náš střední kanál čistý, naše názory přirozeně odrážejí vrozený smysl pro morálku a naše činy se pro nás automaticky stanou vyživujícími, protože jsou v rovnováze. Tato rovnováha je klíčem k vzestupu. Aniž bychom šli do extrémů levostranných nebo pravostranných nálad a činností, naše energie a pozornost přirozeně směřují k tomu, co napomáhá a podporuje našemu duchovnímu vývoji.
","action":"","url":"","type":"image","background":"white","color":"dark","position":"right","spacing":"separate","mediaFiles":[501],"decorations":{}}},{"type":"textbox","data":{"id":"r7hvw39j2z","image":{"id":502,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/502/small_in_life_background.jpg"},"title":"Jak vyrovnat Střední kanál","text":"Projevováním kvalit levého kanálu v každodenním životě se může tento kanál posílit, mohou se prohloubit meditace a méně pravděpodobně se budeme dostávat do nerovnováhy. Pokud tento kanál opomíjíme, můžeme se snadno dostávat do nerovnováhy a může být těžké dosáhnout stavu mentálního ticha.

Tipy pro vyrovnání Středního kanálu:

- Když čelíte nějakému dilematu nebo těžkému rozhodnutí, pokuste se najít vyrovnaný přístup, který není založen na žádných extrémních názorech nebo dlouhotrvajících zvycích. Při rozepři je nalezení střední cesty obvykle klíčem k vyřešení a zachování vyrovnaného stavu.

- Pokuste se zaměřit se na své vlastní činy spíše než na činy ostatních lidí. Introspekce je klíčem, jak zůstat ve středu.

- Buďte spokojeni se svým fyzickým tělem. Být celkově zdráv je důležité, ale nemarněte na tom příliš svoji pozornost a energii. - Nerozlišujte mezi náboženstvími ani neodsuzujte základy jejich učení. Spíše se pokuste hledat pravdu v každém z nich a zůstaňte odpoutaní od různých interpretací.","action":"","url":"","type":"image","background":"image","color":"light","position":"left","spacing":"overlap","mediaFiles":[502],"decorations":{"sidetext":{"text":"In life"}}}},{"type":"catalog","data":{"id":"cxeoos7psm","title":"Čistící techniky","items":[1,4],"type":"treatments","style":"image","decorations":{"sidetext":{"text":"Cleansing techniques"}}}},{"type":"vimeo","data":{"id":"b88iecwu3l","items":[{"vimeo_id":"357376311","thumbnail":"https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830578998_1280x720.jpg?r=pad","thumbnail_srcset":"https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830578998_100x75.jpg?r=pad 100w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830578998_200x150.jpg?r=pad 200w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830578998_295x166.jpg?r=pad 295w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830578998_640x360.jpg?r=pad 640w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830578998_1280x720.jpg?r=pad 1280w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830578998_1920x1080.jpg?r=pad 1920w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830578998_640x360.jpg?r=pad 640w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830578998_960x540.jpg?r=pad 960w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830578998_1280x720.jpg?r=pad 1280w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830578998_1920x1080.jpg?r=pad 1920w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830578998_1280x720.jpg?r=pad 1280w","title":"Šrí Mátadží o Středním kanálu"}],"quantity":"single","legacy":true,"decorations":{"gradient":{"alignment":"left","color":"orange"},"sidetext":{"text":"Shri Mataji's words"}}}},{"type":"textbox","data":{"id":"r8aysxqaejr","image":{"id":503,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/503/small_Central_Channel_-_Jung.jpg"},"title":"Kolektivní nevědomí","text":"Zmínku o kolektivním nevědomí v západním světě poprvé představil v roce 1916 Carl Jung, švýcarský psycholog. Podle Junga existuje jakási vnitřní osobnost, která je společná všem lidským bytostem, stranou od všech aspektů jednotlivce, které jsou postaveny jako reakce na své prostředí. Popisuje proces individuace, zatímco jedincova osobnost se vyvíjí z nerozděleného nevědomí a zkušenosti jedincova života se stávají částí dobře fungujícího celku. Jinými slovy jedincova osobnost a činy jsou nevědomě řízeny všeprostupující silou, která je vrozená a přístupná všem. Střední kanál je nástroj pro vstup do tohoto kolektivního nevědomí. Díky vzestupu Kundaliní po středním kanálu až do sedmé čakry na vrcholku hlavy, Sahasráry, jsme přivedeni do stavu skutečné meditace, bez myšlenek. Zde, ačkoliv je člověk naprosto bdělý (na rozdíl od jakéhokoliv druhu transu), je uvnitř naprosté ticho. V tomto stavu člověk překračuje vědomou mysl a stává se připojeným ke kolektivnímu nevědomí. Proces jménem „individuace“ je v podstatě jedincova zkušenost přes Seberealizaci, kdy je probuzena Kundaliní. Tímto způsobem meditace umožňuje člověku růst do osobnosti, která je skutečně částí a součástí jednoho obrovského celku.

translations.name: Zentraler Kanal
translations.content:
{"time":1659991279264,"blocks":[{"id":"L3T1EJqQlB","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"bl0gaknunbk","text":"Die Qualitäten des zentralen Kanals","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"bReNjwWFi8","type":"media","data":{"id":"4bg24h5xa2u","poster":{},"items":[{"image":{"id":959,"preview":"https://assets.wemeditate.co/uploads/media_file/file/959/small_8394ebeb78.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""}],"mediaFiles":[959],"type":"image","quantity":"single","position":"left","size":"narrow","decorations":{}}},{"id":"AD2B9Lp6KF","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Der zentrale Kanal ist der Pfad der Balance und des Aufstiegs. Wenn die Kundalini durch diesen Kanal aufsteigt, werden wir zu einem höheren Bewusstsein geführt, das unsere spirituelle Evolution erleichtert. Es erlaubt uns, einen glückseligen Zustand zu erreichen, der jenseits unseres mentalen Verständnisses liegt. Als balancierte Wesen, frei von Extremen, können wir unser wahres Potenzial erreichen.","type":"text"}},{"id":"ANO2GyMfAt","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Der zentrale Kanal entspricht dem Prinzip des Aufstiegs und unserer Qualität, nach der Wahrheit zu suchen. Wenn wir aufhören, nach materiellem Wohlergehen zu streben und ein angeborenes Gefühl der Zufriedenheit und des Sinns finden wollen, können wir dieses durch die Qualitäten des zentralen Kanals finden.","type":"text"}},{"id":"eqLh1qykMZ","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Wo der linke Energiekanal mit dem Super-Ego, unseren Konditionierungen, und der rechte Kanal mit unserem Ego zusammentreffen, führt der zentrale Kanal schließlich zum Sahasrara-Chakra. Wenn sich also unsere Kundalini entlang des zentralen Kanals bewegt, gelangen wir in einen Zustand des gedankenfreien Bewusstseins. Diesen Zustand erfahren wir, wenn das Sahasrara-Chakra geöffnet ist. Daher ist der Schlüssel zum Erreichen eines wahren Zustands der Meditation und des erleuchteten Bewusstseins, eine zentrierte Persönlichkeit zu werden, die weder in emotionalen, mentalen oder physischen Extremen schwankt. Dies kann erreicht werden, indem wir unser inneres System reinigen und die Kundalini wiederholt anheben, um sie zu stärken und zu nähren.","type":"text"}},{"id":"9q5joS1r8w","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Wenn unser Zentralkanal rein ist, spiegelt unser Wesen ganz natürlich unsere angeborene Moral wider, und unsere Handlungen nähren automatisch unser Wesen, da sie ausgeglichen sind. Diese Balance ist der Schlüssel zum Aufstieg. Ohne in extreme linksseitige oder rechtsseitige Stimmungen und Aktivitäten zu verfallen, strömt unsere Energie und Aufmerksamkeit ganz natürlich zu dem, was erhebend und unserer spirituellen Entwicklung förderlich ist.","type":"text"}},{"id":"F1VB1PVqAY","type":"textbox","data":{"id":"r7hvw39j2z","title":"Wie balanciert man den zentralen Kanal","subtitle":"","caption":"","credit":"","text":"Wir können unseren zentralen Kanal stärken indem wir dessen Qualitäten in unseren alltäglichen Leben zum Ausdruck bringen. Unsere Meditation wird tiefer und macht uns weniger anfällig für unausgeglichenes Verhalten. Wenn wir diesen Kanal vernachlässigen, finden wir uns mitunter aus der Balance geworfen und es kann schwierig werden, den Zustand der mentalen Stille zu erreichen. Tipps, um den zentralen Kanal zu verbessern: - Wenn man mit einem Dilemma oder einer schwierigen Situation konfrontiert ist, dann versuche eine Lösung zu finden die nicht auf extreme Ansichten oder alten Gewohnheiten beruht. Im Zweifel ist die goldene Mitte für gewöhnlich der Schlüssel, um die innere Balance zu erreichen und aufrecht zu erhalten. - Versuche dich auf *dein eigenes Verhalten* und nicht auf das der anderen zu konzentrieren. Introspektion oder Selbstreflektion ist das Mittel, um „im Zentrum“ zu bleiben. - Sei mit deinem Äußeren zufrieden. Ein gesunder ausgeglichener Lebensstil ist allgemeinen wichtig für uns aber verschwende nicht unnötig deine Aufmerksamkeit und Energie auf. - Spiele nicht die einzelnen Religionen gegeneinander aus indem du sie verurteilst. Versuche eher, deren geistigen Ursprung zu entdecken und lasse dich nicht von den verschiedenen Interpretationen voreinnehmen..","action":"","url":"","image":{"id":502,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/502/small_in_life_background.jpg"},"mediaFiles":[502],"type":"image","alignment":"left","style":"hero","spacing":"overlap","background":"image","color":"light","position":"left","decorations":{"sidetext":{"text":"In life"}}}},{"id":"ybkzlH8dNE","type":"catalog","data":{"id":"cxeoos7psm","title":"","items":[1,4],"type":"treatments","style":"image","decorations":{"sidetext":{"text":"Cleansing techniques"}}}},{"id":"YJ5OtS08vC","type":"textbox","data":{"id":"r8aysxqaejr","title":"Das Collective Unterbewusste","subtitle":"","caption":"","credit":"","text":"Die Idee des kollektiven Unterbewussten wurde im Westen zuerst von Carl Jung, ein Schweizer Psychiater, um 1916 formulierte. Gemäß Jung gibt es einen innewohnenden Teil der Persönlichkeit, den alle Menschen haben, ganz im Gegensatz zu den individuellen Bereichen, die als Reaktionen auf die Umgebung aufgebaut sind. Er beschreibt den Prozess der „Individuation“, bei dem sich die Persönlichkeit, ausgehend von einem undifferenzierten Unterbewussten, mit den Lebenserfahrungen zu einem gut funktionierenden Ganzen formt. Diese Entwicklung wird unbewusst von einer allesdurchdringenden inneren Kraft geleitet, die in uns allen existiert. Der Mittlere Kanal ist dabei entscheidend, um sich an das kollektive Bewusstsein anzudocken. Durch das Aufsteigen der Kundalini im Mittleren Kanal bis zum siebenten Chakra ganz oben im Kopf, dem Sahasrara, erlangen wir den Zustand der wahren Meditation, völlig frei von Gedanken. Es herrscht dabei eine innere Stille, obwohl man dabei – im Gegensatz zu einem Trancezustand – vollkommen wach ist. In diesem Zustand ist man jenseits des denkenden Verstandes und mit dem kollektiven Unterbewusstsein verbunden. Der Vorgang der „Individuation” ist nichts anderes als die Erfahrung der Selbstverwirklichung, durch die Erweckung der Kundalini. Auf diesem Weg ermöglicht die Meditation jedem Einzelnen in eine Persönlichkeit zu wachsen, die so ein echter Teil des Großen Ganzen wird.
","action":"","url":"","image":{"id":503,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/503/small_Central_Channel_-_Jung.jpg"},"mediaFiles":[503],"type":"image","alignment":"left","style":"hero","spacing":"overlap","background":"ornate","color":"dark","position":"right","decorations":{"sidetext":{"text":"Ancient Knowledge"}}}}],"version":"2.23.2","markupVersion":3,"mediaFiles":[]}

translations.name: Το κεντρικό κανάλι
translations.content:
{"time":1669220506237,"blocks":[{"id":"vDhTqABrKY","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"bl0gaknunbk","text":"Ποιότητες του κεντρικού καναλιού","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"dxG-JzYcU7","type":"media","data":{"id":"4bg24h5xa2u","poster":{},"items":[{"image":{"id":959,"preview":"https://assets.wemeditate.co/uploads/media_file/file/959/small_8394ebeb78.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""}],"mediaFiles":[959],"type":"image","quantity":"single","position":"left","size":"narrow","decorations":{}}},{"id":"MleHfA7svB","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"p3jjav6x7kh","text":"Το κεντρικό κανάλι σχετίζεται με την αρχή της πνευματικής ανύψωσης και την αναζήτηση της αλήθειας. Όταν  πάψουμε να επιζητούμε την υλική ευημερία και επιθυμούμε να βιώσουμε μια  πραγματικά εγγενή αίσθηση πληρότητας και σκοπού ζωής, είναι οι ποιότητες του  κεντρικού καναλιού που θα μας οδηγήσουν σε αυτό που αναζητάμε.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"2TK6tfkMuD","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"f3piaf272he","text":"Εκεί που το αριστερό κανάλι υπερλειτουργείμε το Υπερεγώ ή με τις εξαρτήσεις  μας και το δεξί κανάλι υπερλειτουργεί με το Εγώ, το κεντρικό κανάλι μας οδηγεί  εν τέλει στο ενεργειακό κέντρο του Σαχασράρα. Έτσι, όταν η Κουνταλίνη ανέρχεται  μέσω του κεντρικού μας καναλιού, ερχόμαστε σε μια κατάσταση συνείδησης χωρίς  σκέψεις, η οποία βιώνεται όταν το κέντρο της κεφαλής μας, το Σαχασράρα, έχει\nανοίξει. Επομένως, το κλειδί για να επιτύχουμε μια πραγματική κατάσταση  διαλογισμού, μακαριότητας και φωτισμένης συνείδησης, είναι να γίνουμε μια  ισορροπημένη προσωπικότητα, που δεν παραπαίει ούτε σε συναισθηματικά ή  διανοητικά άκρα, αλλά ούτε σε σωματικά. Αυτό μπορεί να επιτευχθεί με το  καθαρισμό του κεντρικού μας καναλιού και την ανύψωση της Κουνταλίνης, ξανά και  ξανά, για να την ενδυναμώσουμε και να την «θρέψουμε».","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"0RmXWtWp6t","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"h6ln64l63nb","text":"Όταν το κεντρικό μας κανάλι είναι καθαρό, οι απόψεις μας, με φυσικό τρόπο, καθρεφτίζουν μια έμφυτη\nηθικότητα και οι πράξεις μας αυτόματα γίνονται επωφελείς για την ύπαρξή μας,  επειδή είναι ισορροπημένες. Αυτή η ισορροπία είναι το κλειδί για την ανέλιξή  μας. Όταν δεν πάμε στα άκρα των συναισθημάτων, διαθέσεων και πράξεων της αριστερής  ή της δεξιάς πλευράς, η ενέργειά μας και η προσοχή μας, φυσικά, στρέφεται προς  ό,τι μας ανυψώνει και σχετίζεται με την πνευματική μας εξέλιξη.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"oY7tSNTEss","type":"catalog","data":{"id":"cxeoos7psm","title":"","items":[1,4],"type":"treatments","style":"image","decorations":{"sidetext":{"text":"Cleansing techniques"}}}},{"id":"F8HkXsrFLx","type":"vimeo","data":{"id":"b88iecwu3l","items":[{"vimeo_id":"357376311","thumbnail":"https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830578998_1280x720.jpg?r=pad","thumbnail_srcset":"https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830578998_100x75.jpg?r=pad 100w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830578998_200x150.jpg?r=pad 200w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830578998_295x166.jpg?r=pad 295w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830578998_640x360.jpg?r=pad 640w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830578998_1280x720.jpg?r=pad 1280w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830578998_1920x1080.jpg?r=pad 1920w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830578998_640x360.jpg?r=pad 640w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830578998_960x540.jpg?r=pad 960w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830578998_1280x720.jpg?r=pad 1280w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830578998_1920x1080.jpg?r=pad 1920w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830578998_1280x720.jpg?r=pad 1280w","title":"Shri Mataji on The Central Channel"}],"legacy":true}},{"id":"rlMG5He-Pr","type":"textbox","data":{"id":"r8aysxqaejr","title":"The Collective Unconscious","subtitle":"","caption":"","credit":"","text":"The notion of a collective unconscious was first conceived in the western world in 1916 by Carl Jung, a swiss psychologist. According to Jung, there is an innate personality which is common to every human being, quite apart from the aspects of an individual which are built as a reaction to their environment. He describes a process of individuation, whereby an individual’s personality develops out of an undifferentiated unconscious and the experiences of a person’s life become part of a well-functioning whole. In other words, an individual’s personality and actions become unconsciously guided by an all-pervading force which is innate and accessible to everyone.

The central channel is instrumental in tapping into this collective unconscious. Through the raising of the kundalini up the central channel until it passes through our seventh chakra on the top of our head, the Sahasrara, we are brought into a state of true meditation, without thought. Here, although one is completely aware (as opposed to in any kind of trance) there is silence within. In this state, one goes beyond the conscious mind and becomes connected to the collective unconscious.

The process called ‘individuation’ is in fact what an individual experiences through Self Realisation, when the kundalini is awakened. In this way, meditation allows the individual to grow into a personality which is truly part and parcel of one great whole.
","action":"","url":"","image":{"id":503,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/503/small_Central_Channel_-_Jung.jpg"},"mediaFiles":[503],"type":"image","alignment":"left","style":"hero","spacing":"overlap","background":"ornate","color":"dark","position":"right","decorations":{"sidetext":{"text":"Ancient Knowledge"}}}}],"version":"2.23.2","markupVersion":3,"mediaFiles":[]}

translations.name: Central Channel
translations.content: {"time":1591960882257,"blocks":[{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"bl0gaknunbk","text":"Qualities of the Central Channel","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"type":"media","data":{"id":"4bg24h5xa2u","items":[{"image":{"id":959,"preview":"https://assets.wemeditate.co/uploads/media_file/file/959/small_8394ebeb78.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""}],"type":"image","quantity":"single","position":"left","size":"normal","mediaFiles":[959],"decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":null,"text":"The central channel corresponds to our principle of ascent and our quality of seeking for the truth. When we no longer seek material well being and wish to find a more innate sense of contentment and purpose, it is through the qualities of the central channel that we can find what we are searching for.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":null,"text":"Where the left channel culminates with the superego, or our conditionings, and the right channel culminates with our ego, the central channel leads ultimately to the Sahasrara chakra. Thus when our Kundalini moves along our central channel, we are brought to a state of thoughtless awareness which is experienced when the Sahasrara chakra is opened. Therefore the key to achieving a true state of meditation, bliss and enlightened awareness is to become a more centered personality, which swings neither to emotional, mental or physical extremes. This can be achieved by clearing our central channel and raising the Kundalini repeatedly to strengthen and nourish it.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":null,"text":"When our central channel is clear, our views naturally reflect an innate morality and our actions become automatically nourishing to our being, as they are balanced. This balance is the key to ascent. Without going to the extremes of left-sided or right-sided moods and activities, our energy and attention naturally gravitates towards that which is elevating and conducive to our spiritual evolution.","type":"text"}},{"type":"textbox","data":{"id":"r7hvw39j2z","image":{"id":502,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/502/small_in_life_background.jpg"},"title":"How to balance the Central Channel","text":"By manifesting the qualities of our Central Channel in our daily life, this channel can grow stronger, deepening our meditations and making us less susceptible to imbalances. When we neglect this channel we can find ourselves often out of balance and it can be difficult to achieve a state of mental silence.\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003eTips for improving the Central Channel:\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003e- When faced with a dilemma or a difficult decision, try to find a balanced approach which isn’t based on any extreme opinions or long-standing habits. In a dispute, finding the middle ground is usually the key to maintaining a balanced state.\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003e- Try to focus on your own actions rather than the actions of others. Introspection is the key to staying in the centre.\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003e- Be satisfied with your physical body! Being generally healthy is important, but don’t waste your attention and energy on it otherwise.\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003e- Do not differentiate between religions or condemn the roots of their teachings. Rather, try to seek out the truth in each and remain detached from different interpretations.","action":"","url":"","type":"image","background":"image","color":"light","position":"left","spacing":"overlap","mediaFiles":[502],"decorations":{"sidetext":{"text":"In life"}}}},{"type":"catalog","data":{"id":"cxeoos7psm","title":"","items":[1,4],"type":"treatments","style":"image","decorations":{"sidetext":{"text":"Cleansing techniques"}}}},{"type":"vimeo","data":{"id":"b88iecwu3l","items":[{"vimeo_id":"357376311","thumbnail":"https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830578998_1280x720.jpg?r=pad","thumbnail_srcset":"https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830578998_100x75.jpg?r=pad 100w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830578998_200x150.jpg?r=pad 200w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830578998_295x166.jpg?r=pad 295w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830578998_640x360.jpg?r=pad 640w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830578998_1280x720.jpg?r=pad 1280w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830578998_1920x1080.jpg?r=pad 1920w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830578998_640x360.jpg?r=pad 640w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830578998_960x540.jpg?r=pad 960w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830578998_1280x720.jpg?r=pad 1280w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830578998_1920x1080.jpg?r=pad 1920w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830578998_1280x720.jpg?r=pad 1280w","title":"Shri Mataji on The Central Channel"}],"quantity":"single","legacy":true,"decorations":{"gradient":{"alignment":"left","color":"orange"},"sidetext":{"text":"Shri Mataji's words"}}}},{"type":"textbox","data":{"id":"r8aysxqaejr","image":{"id":503,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/503/small_Central_Channel_-_Jung.jpg"},"title":"The Collective Unconscious","text":"The notion of a collective unconscious was first conceived in the western world in 1916 by Carl Jung, a swiss psychologist. According to Jung, there is an innate personality which is common to every human being, quite apart from the aspects of an individual which are built as a reaction to their environment. He describes a process of individuation, whereby an individual’s personality develops out of an undifferentiated unconscious and the experiences of a person’s life become part of a well-functioning whole. In other words, an individual’s personality and actions become unconsciously guided by an all-pervading force which is innate and accessible to everyone.\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003eThe central channel is instrumental in tapping into this collective unconscious. Through the raising of the kundalini up the central channel until it passes through our seventh chakra on the top of our head, the Sahasrara, we are brought into a state of true meditation, without thought. Here, although one is completely aware (as opposed to in any kind of trance) there is silence within. In this state, one goes beyond the conscious mind and becomes connected to the collective unconscious. \u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003eThe process called ‘individuation’ is in fact what an individual experiences through Self Realisation, when the kundalini is awakened. In this way, meditation allows the individual to grow into a personality which is truly part and parcel of one great whole.\u003cbr\u003e","action":"","url":"","type":"image","background":"ornate","color":"dark","position":"right","spacing":"overlap","mediaFiles":[503],"decorations":{"sidetext":{"text":"Ancient Knowledge"}}}}],"version":"2.16.0","media_files":[],"markupVersion":3}

translations.name: La Canal Central
translations.content: {"time":1591960001707,"blocks":[{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"a3833geg05","text":"Qualitiés du Canal Central","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"type":"media","data":{"id":"9mq6cknv8ui","items":[{"image":{"id":955,"preview":"https://assets.wemeditate.co/uploads/media_file/file/955/small_85d2adb303.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""}],"type":"image","quantity":"single","position":"left","size":"normal","mediaFiles":[955],"decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":null,"text":"Le canal central correspond au principe de l’évolution de la vie. Lorsqu’on ne recherche plus seulement le bien-être matériel et qu’on souhaite trouver un sens de satisfaction plus subtil, quand on recherche le but de sa propre vie, c'est ce canal qui s'active.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":null,"text":"Le canal gauche se termine par une impasse, le surmoi ou nos conditionnements; et le canal droit par une autre impasse, notre ego; tandis que le canal central aboutit au chakra du Sahasrara. Lorsque notre Kundalini s’élève le long de ce canal jusqu’à ce septième chakra, et qu'elle le traverse, elle nous amène à un état de conscience sans pensée, un état de véritable méditation, de béatitude, avec une conscience éveillée. La personnalité ne bascule plus vers les extrêmes émotionnels, mentaux ou physiques. Ensuite, élever la Kundalini renforcera et nourrira le canal central.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"4a1b583cl97","text":"Lorsque notre canal central est dégagé, nos opinions reflètent naturellement des valeurs universelles et subtiles. Nos actions deviennent automatiquement nourrissantes pour notre être, car elles sont en accord avec nos besoins. Cet équilibre est la clé de notre ascension: lorsque notre côté gauche ou notre côté droit ne sont pas trop sollicités par des humeurs ou des activités extrêmes, notre énergie et notre attention sont naturellement attirées par ce qui est propice à notre évolution spirituelle.","type":"text"}},{"type":"textbox","data":{"id":"r7hvw39j2z","image":{"id":502,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/502/small_in_life_background.jpg"},"title":"Comment équilibrer le Canal Central?","text":"Manifester les qualités du canal central dans la vie quotidienne, permet de le renforcer, et ainsi d’approfondir nos méditations et de nous rendre moins prédisposés aux déséquilibres. Négliger ce canal nous nous permet pas d'évoluer psychologiquement ni spirituellement et la recherche de la joie ne se porte que sur des objets extérieurs. On risque alors de rester insatisfait tout au long de sa vie.\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003eConseils pour améliorer le Canal Central:\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003e- Face à un dilemme ou à une décision difficile, essayez de trouver une approche qui ne soit pas basée sur des opinions extrêmes ou des habitudes de longue date.  Dans un conflit, essayer de trouver un terrain d'entente plutôt que de gagner en perdant l'autre.\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003e- Essayez de vous concentrer sur vos propres actions plutôt que sur celles des autres. L'introspection est la clé pour rester équilibré.\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003e- Soyez satisfait de votre physique! Il est important de  rester en bonne santé, sans pour autant gaspiller son attention ni son énergie à essayer d'être quelqu'un d'autre.\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003e- Ne cherchez pas les différences entre les religions et ne condamnez pas les racines de leurs enseignements. Essayez plutôt de rechercher la vérité dans chacune d'elles et de rester détaché vis à vis des différentes interprétations.","action":"","url":"","type":"image","background":"image","color":"light","position":"left","spacing":"overlap","mediaFiles":[502],"decorations":{"sidetext":{"text":"En pratique"}}}},{"type":"catalog","data":{"id":"cxeoos7psm","title":"","items":[1,4],"type":"treatments","style":"image","decorations":{"sidetext":{"text":"Techniques de nettoyage"}}}},{"type":"vimeo","data":{"id":"b88iecwu3l","items":[{"vimeo_id":"357376311","thumbnail":"https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830578998_1280x720.jpg?r=pad","thumbnail_srcset":"https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830578998_100x75.jpg?r=pad 100w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830578998_200x150.jpg?r=pad 200w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830578998_295x166.jpg?r=pad 295w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830578998_640x360.jpg?r=pad 640w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830578998_1280x720.jpg?r=pad 1280w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830578998_1920x1080.jpg?r=pad 1920w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830578998_640x360.jpg?r=pad 640w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830578998_960x540.jpg?r=pad 960w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830578998_1280x720.jpg?r=pad 1280w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830578998_1920x1080.jpg?r=pad 1920w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830578998_1280x720.jpg?r=pad 1280w","title":"Shri Mataji sur le canal central (en anglais)"}],"quantity":"single","legacy":true,"decorations":{"gradient":{"alignment":"left","color":"orange"},"sidetext":{"text":"Paroles de Shri Mataji"}}}},{"type":"textbox","data":{"id":"r8aysxqaejr","image":{"id":503,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/503/small_Central_Channel_-_Jung.jpg"},"title":"L'Inconscient Collectif","text":"La notion d'Inconscient Collectif a été conçue pour la première fois dans le monde occidental en 1916 par Carl Jung, un psychologue suisse. Selon Jung, il existe une personalité innée  commune à tous les êtres qui n'est pas seulement une réaction à un environnement, comme pour la formation de divers aspects de notre personnalité. Il décrit un \"processus d'individuation\" dont les racines puisent dans un inconscient indifférencié. Quand  nos  expériences y sont reliées, elles sont complètement intégrées au Tout. Autrement dit, c'est un processus où notre personnalité et nos actions sont inconsciemment guidées par une force omniprésente qui est  accessible à tous.\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003eLe canal central permet de puiser dans cet Inconscient Collectif dès lors que la kundalini s’est élevée  jusqu'à notre septième chakra, sur le sommet de la  tête, le Sahasrara. On entre dans un état de conscience éveillée et sans pensée, opposé à tout forme de transe, un silence intérieur. C'est là, au-dessus du mental,  que l'on peut se  connecter à l'Inconscient Collectif. \u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003eLe \"processus d'individuation\" dont parle Jung commence avec cet été que l'on expérimente grâce à la Réalisation du Soi, lorsque la kundalini est éveillée. De cette façon, la méditation permet à l'individu de devenir une personnalité qui fait vraiment partie d'un grand tout.\u003cbr\u003e","action":"","url":"","type":"image","background":"ornate","color":"dark","position":"right","spacing":"overlap","mediaFiles":[503],"decorations":{"sidetext":{"text":"Connaissances Ancestrales"}}}}],"version":"2.16.0","media_files":[],"markupVersion":3}

translations.name: Canale centrale
translations.content: {"time":1582808238307,"blocks":[{"type":"textbox","data":{"id":"0ohzg709rl9m","image":{"id":501,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/501/small_Central_Channel_1.jpg"},"title":"Le qualità del canale centrale.","text":"Il canale centrale corrisponde al nostro principio di ascesa e alla nostra qualità di ricerca della verità. Quando non cerchiamo più il benessere materiale e desideriamo trovare un senso più innato di appagamento, è attraverso le qualità del canale centrale che possiamo trovare ciò che stiamo cercando.\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003eLaddove il canale sinistro culmina con il superego (condizionamenti) e il canale destro culmina con il nostro ego, il canale centrale conduce al Sahasrara chakra. Così, quando la nostra Kundalini si muove lungo il nostro canale centrale, siamo portati a uno stato di consapevolezza senza pensieri che viene sperimentata quando il Sahasrara chakra viene aperto. Pertanto, la chiave per raggiungere un vero stato di meditazione, felicità e consapevolezza illuminata è quella di diventare una personalità più centrata, che non oscilli verso estremi emotivi, mentali o fisici. Ciò può essere ottenuto pulendo il nostro canale centrale e sollevando ripetutamente la Kundalini per rafforzarla e nutrirla.\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003eQuando il nostro canale centrale è libero, le nostre opinioni riflettono naturalmente una moralità innata e le nostre azioni diventano automaticamente nutrienti per il nostro essere, poiché sono equilibrate. Questo equilibrio è la chiave per salire. Senza andare agli estremi degli umori e delle attività sul lato sinistro o sul lato destro, la nostra energia e attenzione gravitano naturalmente verso ciò che è elevato e favorevole alla nostra evoluzione spirituale.\u003cbr\u003e","action":"","url":"","type":"image","background":"white","color":"dark","position":"right","spacing":"separate","mediaFiles":[501],"decorations":{}}},{"type":"textbox","data":{"id":"r7hvw39j2z","image":{"id":502,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/502/small_in_life_background.jpg"},"title":"Come bilanciare il canale centrale","text":"Manifestando le qualità del nostro canale centrale nella nostra vita quotidiana, questo canale può diventare più forte. Ciò ci permette di rendere più profonde le nostre meditazioni e di essere meno suscettibili a squilibri. Quando trascuriamo questo canale, possiamo trovarci spesso fuori equilibrio e può essere difficile raggiungere uno stato di silenzio mentale.\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003eConsigli per migliorare il tuo canale centrale:\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003e- Di fronte ad un dilemma o ad una decisione difficile, cercare un approccio equilibrato non basato su opinioni estreme o vecchie abitudini. In una disputa, trovare un terreno comune è di solito la chiave per mantenere l’equilibrio.\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003e- Cercare di focalizzarsi sulle proprie azioni piuttosto che sulle azioni degli altri. L’introspezione è la chiave per rimanere al centro.\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003e- Essere soddisfatti del proprio corpo! La salute generale è importante ma, per il resto, non sprecare la propria attenzione ed energia su questo.\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003e- Non discriminare le religioni né condannare le radici dei loro insegnamenti. Cercare piuttosto la verità in ciascuna di esse rimanendo distaccati dalle diverse interpretazioni.","action":"","url":"","type":"image","background":"image","color":"light","position":"left","spacing":"overlap","mediaFiles":[502],"decorations":{"sidetext":{"text":"vita quotidiana"}}}},{"type":"catalog","data":{"id":"cxeoos7psm","title":"","items":[1,4],"type":"treatments","style":"image","decorations":{"sidetext":{"text":"tecniche di pulizia"}}}},{"type":"vimeo","data":{"id":"b88iecwu3l","items":[{"vimeo_id":"357376311","thumbnail":"https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/810718235_1280x720.jpg?r=pad","thumbnail_srcset":"https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/810718235_100x75.jpg?r=pad 100w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/810718235_200x150.jpg?r=pad 200w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/810718235_295x166.jpg?r=pad 295w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/810718235_640x360.jpg?r=pad 640w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/810718235_960x540.jpg?r=pad 960w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/810718235_1280x720.jpg?r=pad 1280w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/810718235_1920x1080.jpg?r=pad 1920w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/810718235_1280x720.jpg?r=pad 1280w","title":"Shri Mataji sul Canale Centrale "}],"quantity":"single","legacy":true,"decorations":{"gradient":{"alignment":"left","color":"orange"},"sidetext":{"text":"Le parole di Shri Mataji"}}}},{"type":"textbox","data":{"id":"r8aysxqaejr","image":{"id":503,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/503/small_Central_Channel_-_Jung.jpg"},"title":"L'inconscio collettivo","text":"L'idea di un inconscio collettivo fu concepita per la prima volta nel mondo occidentale nel 1916 da Carl Jung, uno psicologo svizzero. Secondo Jung, esiste una personalità innata che è comune a ogni essere umano, a prescindere dagli aspetti di un individuo che sono costruiti come reazione al loro ambiente. Descrive un processo di individuazione, in base al quale la personalità di un individuo si sviluppa da un inconscio indifferenziato e le esperienze della vita di una persona diventano parte di un’energia onnipervadente ben funzionante. In altre parole, la personalità e le azioni di un individuo vengono inconsciamente guidate da una forza onnipresente che è innata e accessibile a tutti.\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003eIl canale centrale è fondamentale per attingere a questo inconscio collettivo. Attraverso l'innalzamento della kundalini lungo il canale centrale fino ad al  nostro settimo chakra sulla cima della nostra testa, il Sahasrara, qui si raggiunge uno stato di vera meditazione, senza pensiero. Qui, sebbene uno sia completamente consapevole (al contrario di qualsiasi tipo di trance) c'è un silenzio interiore. In questo stato, si va oltre la mente cosciente e ci si connette all'inconscio collettivo.\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003eIl processo chiamato \"individuazione\" è in effetti ciò che un individuo sperimenta attraverso la realizzazione del Sé, quando la Kundalini viene risvegliata. In questo modo, la meditazione consente all'individuo di crescere in una personalità che è veramente parte integrante di un unico grande insieme.\u003cbr\u003e","action":"","url":"","type":"image","background":"ornate","color":"dark","position":"right","spacing":"overlap","mediaFiles":[503],"decorations":{"sidetext":{"text":"Antica conoscenza"}}}}],"version":"2.16.0","media_files":[],"markupVersion":3}

translations.name: Canalul Central
translations.content:
{"time":1754929386475,"blocks":[{"id":"eEfpJBQ8dm","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"bl0gaknunbk","text":"Calitățile canalului central","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"yuATZL-NJp","type":"media","data":{"id":"4bg24h5xa2u","poster":{},"items":[{"image":{"id":959,"preview":"https://assets.wemeditate.co/uploads/media_file/file/959/small_8394ebeb78.jpg"},"alt":"","caption":"","credit":""}],"mediaFiles":[959],"youtube_id":"","type":"image","quantity":"single","position":"left","size":"narrow","decorations":{}}},{"id":"O-XRcCnBmw","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Canalul central corespunde principiului nostru de ascensiune și calității noastre de a căuta adevărul. Când nu mai căutăm bunăstarea materială și dorim să găsim un sentiment înnăscut de mulțumire și împlinire, prin calitățile canalului central putem găsi ceea ce căutăm.","type":"text"}},{"id":"9a7DdN_lbd","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"În timp ce canalul stâng se termină cu superegoul, iar canalul drept cu egoul nostru, canalul central conduce spre chakra Sahasrara. Astfel, atunci când energia Kundalini se ridică de-a lungul canalului central, atingem o stare de conștiință fără gânduri, care este experimentată atunci când chakra Sahasrara este deschisă. Prin urmare, cheia pentru atingerea unei adevărate stări de meditație, beatitudine și conștiință iluminată este de a deveni o personalitate mai centrată, care nu oscilează între extreme emoționale, mentale sau fizice. Acest lucru poate fi obținut prin purificarea canalului nostru central și ridicarea energiei Kundalini în mod repetat pentru a-l întări și hrăni.","type":"text"}},{"id":"s87CIV_2ye","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Când canalul central este curat, părerile noastre reflectă în mod natural o moralitate înnăscută și acțiunile devin automat benefice pentru ființa noastră, întrucât sunt echilibrate. Acest echilibru este cheia ascensiunii. Fără a merge la extremele de pe partea stângă sau dreaptă, energia și atenția noastră gravitează în mod natural spre ceea ce conduce la evoluția noastră spirituală.","type":"text"}},{"id":"Rx1MF9qJxu","type":"textbox","data":{"id":"r7hvw39j2z","title":"Cum echilibrăm Canalul Central","subtitle":"","caption":"","credit":"","text":"Prin manifestarea calităților canalului central în viața de zi cu zi, acesta poate deveni mai puternic, ajutându-ne să aprofundăm meditația și făcându-ne mai puțin sensibili la dezechilibre. Când neglijăm acest canal, ne putem regăsi deseori în afara echilibrului și poate fi dificil să obținem o stare de liniște mentală. Sfaturi pentru îmbunătățirea canalului central: • când te confrunți cu o dilemă sau o decizie dificilă, încearcă să găsești o abordare echilibrată care nu se bazează pe opinii extreme sau obiceiuri de multă vreme înrădăcinate în comportement; într-o dispută, găsirea unui compromis este de obicei cheia pentru menținerea echilibrului • încearcă să te concentrezi pe propriile acțiuni, mai degrabă decât pe acțiunile altora; introspecția este cheia pentru a rămâne centrat • fii mulțumit de corpul tău fizic! să fii în general sănătos și să ai un aspect îngrijit este important, dar nu-ți consuma atenția și energia astfel • nu condamna religiile sau rădăcinile învățăturilor lor; e mai recomandat să cauți adevărul în fiecare și să rămâi detașat de diferitele interpretări ulterioare
","action":"","url":"","image":{"id":502,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/502/small_in_life_background.jpg"},"mediaFiles":[502],"type":"image","alignment":"left","style":"hero","spacing":"overlap","background":"image","color":"light","position":"left","decorations":{"sidetext":{"text":""}}}},{"id":"S4_F5NxHxf","type":"vimeo","data":{"id":"b88iecwu3l","items":[{"vimeo_id":"357376311","thumbnail":"https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830578998_1280x720.jpg?r=pad","thumbnail_srcset":"https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830578998_100x75.jpg?r=pad 100w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830578998_200x150.jpg?r=pad 200w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830578998_295x166.jpg?r=pad 295w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830578998_640x360.jpg?r=pad 640w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830578998_1280x720.jpg?r=pad 1280w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830578998_1920x1080.jpg?r=pad 1920w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830578998_640x360.jpg?r=pad 640w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830578998_960x540.jpg?r=pad 960w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830578998_1280x720.jpg?r=pad 1280w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830578998_1920x1080.jpg?r=pad 1920w,https://i.vimeocdn.com/video/830578998_1280x720.jpg?r=pad 1280w","title":"Shri Mataji despre Canalul central"}],"legacy":true}},{"id":"_Bw7F7QNK_","type":"textbox","data":{"id":"r8aysxqaejr","title":"Inconștientul Colectiv","subtitle":"","caption":"","credit":"","text":"Noțiunea de inconștient colectiv a fost concepută pentru prima dată în lumea occidentală în 1916 de Carl Jung, un psiholog elvețian. Potrivit lui Jung, există o personalitate înnăscută care este comună fiecărei ființe umane, dincolo de aspectele particulare ale unui individ care sunt construite ca reacție la mediul său. El descrie un proces de individualizare, prin care personalitatea unui individ se dezvoltă dintr-un inconștient nediferențiat, iar experiențele vieții unei persoane devin parte a unui întreg care funcționează bine. Cu alte cuvinte, personalitatea și acțiunile unei persoane sunt îndrumate inconștient de o forță atotputernică, care este înnăscută și accesibilă tuturor. Canalul central este fundamental în atingerea acestui inconștient colectiv. Prin ridicarea energiei Kundalini de-a lungul canalului central până când trece prin chakra a șaptea din creștetul capului, Sahasrara, atingem o stare de meditație adevărată, fără gânduri. Aici, deși suntem complet conștienți (spre deosebire de orice fel de transă), există liniște în interior. În această stare, trecem dincolo de mintea conștientă și ne conectăm la inconștientul colectiv. Procesul numit „individualizare” este de fapt ceea ce experimentează o persoană prin Realizarea Sinelui, când este trezită energia Kundalini. În acest fel, meditația permite individului să crească într-o personalitate care este cu adevărat o parte a unui întreg măreț.","action":"","url":"","image":{"id":503,"preview":"https://storage.googleapis.com/wemeditate/uploads/media_file/file/503/small_Central_Channel_-_Jung.jpg"},"mediaFiles":[503],"type":"image","alignment":"left","style":"hero","spacing":"overlap","background":"ornate","color":"dark","position":"right","decorations":{"sidetext":{"text":""}}}}],"version":"2.23.2","markupVersion":3,"mediaFiles":[]}
