At the end of your foot-soak, raise your Kundalini and give yourself a Bandhan once more. You will then need to rinse your feet over the bucket, dry them off with a towel, and simply throw the foot-soak water down the toilet.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"2a7c894471dd3087","text":"Note: Doing a foot-soak in a lake, river, or in the ocean can be even more effective because of the additional soothing and cleansing effect of being outdoors and in the nature (in this case no salt is added, because the qualities of Mother Earth are present already).","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"64d711528f2c82c2","text":"Защо работи?","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"5f5b583093eb652b","text":"A lot of nerves end in our feet and soaking them in salt water can help soothe those nerves, relax our muscles and improve circulation.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"a4a253e1b9f1e872","text":"Apart from the rewarding physical benefits, the salt water foot-soak quickly and efficiently clears out energetic blockages in our subtle system, especially those linked to the first three Chakras. How so? Water is the element of the Nabhi Chakra, based at the solar plexus. While perhaps a seemingly simple fact, water has a powerful capacity to cleanse and soothe us. Salt represents the earth element, which is related to the first center, the Mooladhara, located at the base of our spine or the pelvic plexus. The earth element also has the power to absorb and restore us, which is often why we might suddenly feel more at ease and relaxed when sitting in nature. The combination of salt and water thus has an immense power to absorb and revitalize us no matter what state we are in.","type":"text"}}],"version":"2.16.0","media_files":[],"markupVersion":3}

translations.name: Μάντρας
translations.content: {"time":1662041549408,"blocks":[{"id":"9Dec13qHI5","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"714294046320ab0d","text":"Πότε τα χρησιμοποιούμε?","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"jVPTwtlSYw","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"6211e7c4d78fa0d9","text":"Μπορεί να έχετε βιώσει μια χαλαρωτική αίσθηση όταν κάθεστε κοντά στην όχθη ενός ποταμού, ή όταν στέκεστε όρθιος με τα πόδια μέσα στη θάλασσα μια ζεστή καλοκαιρινή μέρα.  Ίσως να συζητούσατε με έναν φίλο και να  απολαμβάνατε τη θέα, χωρίς να δίνατε  ιδιαίτερη σημασία για την κατάσταση  στην οποία βρίσκεστε, όμως παρ’ όλα  αυτά το νερό να σας ανακουφίζει, να σας  χαλαρώνει και να σας αναζωογονεί.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"z6J9ITssfk","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"xafzqyva5ki","text":"Όταν θέλετε να ηρεμήσετε μετά από μια μέρα σκληρής δουλειάς ή να χαλαρώσετε πριν πάτε για ύπνο, το ποδόλουτρο είναι  μία από τις πιο εύκολες και αποτελεσματικές  τεχνικές. Είτε είσαστε πεσμένοι, είτε είσαστε σε υπερδιέγερση και ανήσυχοι,  κάνοντας ποδόλουτρο με αλατισμένο νερό,  βοηθάει να αποκαταστήσετε την ισορροπία  μέσα σας. Από την ώρα που θα αποκτήσετε  την ρουτίνα να εφαρμόζετε αύτή την απλή  10λεπτη μέθοδο, μπορεί να σας γίνει το  ίδιο απαραίτητο, όσο και το πλύσιμο των  δοντιών.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"UVXIXcfzjy","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"ebff599116aa72e6","text":"Πως το κάνουμε;","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"LoQ1m99h2b","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"6c127327185d739f","text":"Θα χρειαστείτε μια πλαστική λεκάνη που να είναι μόνο γι’ αυτό το σκοπό. Γεμίστε  την με νερό, αρκετό να καλύψει τα πόδια  σας έως τους αστραγάλους σας. Το νερό  θα πρέπει να είναι κρύο αν αισθάνεστε  υπερδραστήριος ή ζεστό αν αισθάνεστε  περισσότερο ληθαργικός ή συναισθηματικός.  Χλιαρό νερό αν δεν είσαστε σίγουροι.  Προσθέστε μισή χούφτα αλάτι στο νερό  (συνιστούμε θαλασσινό αλάτι). Ετοιμάστε  μια καρέκελα για να καθήσετε, μια πετσέτα  να σκουπίσετε τα πόδια σας και μια κανάτα  με νερό για να  ξεπλύνετε τα πόδια σας  μετά το 10λεπτο ποδόλουτρο. Από την ώρα  που όλα είναι έτοιμα, είσαστε έτοιμοι να αρχίσετε.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"3Vrr6TqnAh","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"645d44a95b5ea8a3","text":"Πρώτα, για να αρχίσετε το ποδόλουτρο ανυψώστε την Κουνταλίνη σας και δώστε  μπάνταν, έπειτα καθήστε με τις παλάμες  σας προς τα πάνω και τα πόδια σας βυθισμένα  στο νερό με το αλάτι. Προσπαθήστε να έχετε τα μάτια σας κλειστά, με την προσοχή  σας να είναι στην κορυφή του κεφαλιού.  Μπορείτε να συνδυάσετε άλλες μεθόδους  καθαρισμού με το ποδόλουτρό σας, όπως  το να τοποθετήσετε πάγο στο σημείο του  συκωτιού σας και/ ή να ακούτε μουσική ή  να λέτε τα Μπίτζα μάντρας. Στο τέλος του  ποδόλουτρου, ανυψώστε την Κουνταλίνη  και δώστε στον εαυτό σας Μπάνταν όπως  στην αρχή. Μετά ξεπλένετε τα πόδια σας  πάνω από την λεκάνη, σκουπήστε τα με την  πετσέτα και απλά πετάτε το νερό στη λεκάνη της τουαλέτας.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"_jVMDEMD9V","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"2a7c894471dd3087","text":"Σημείωση: Κάνοντας ποδόλουτρο σε μια λίμνη ή τη θάλασσα, μπορεί να είναι πιο  αποτελεσματικό, λόγω του επιπρόσθετου  χαλαρωτικού και καθαριστικού αποτελέσματος  το να είμαστε σε φυσικό περιβάλλον (σε αυτή τη περίπτωση δεν προσθέτουμε το  αλάτι, επειδή οι ποιότητες της Μητέρας  Γης είναι είδη παρούσες).","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"-5vwnXw9mz","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"64d711528f2c82c2","text":"Γιατί είναι αποτελεσματικό;","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"v_cTrUOXp0","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"5f5b583093eb652b","text":"Πολλές νευρικές απολήξεις καταλήγουν στα πόδια μας, κρατώντας τα σε νερό με  αλάτι, μπορεί να βοηθήσει αυτά τα νεύρα,  να χαλαρώσει τους μυς και να βελτιώσει  την κυκλοφορία του αίματος.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"RzDYOsNDJk","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Πέρα από τα οφέλη σε φυσικό επίπεδο, το ποδόλουτρο με αλάτι, καθαρίζει γρήγορα  και αποτελεσματικά τα ενεργητικά  μπλοκαρίσματα στο λεπτό μας σύστημα,  ιδιαίτερα εκείνα που συνδέονται με τα  πρώτα τρία Τσάκρας. Γιατί αυτό; Το νερό  είναι στοιχείο του Νάμπι, που βρίσκεται  στο ηλιακό πλέγμα. Ίσως γι’ αυτό είναι γεγονός ότι το νερό έχει την ικανότητα  να μας καθαρίζει και να μας καλμάρει.  Το αλάτι αντιπροσωπεύει το στοιχείο  της γης, το οποίο συνδέεται με το πρώτο  κέντρο, το Μουλαντάρα, που βρίσκεται  στη βάση της σπονδυλικής μας στήλης ή  αλλιώς το πελβικό πλέγμα. Το στοιχείο  της γης έχει επίσης την δύναμη να απορροφά  και να αποκαθιστά, γι’ αυτό ίσως να  νιώθουμε ξαφνικά περισσότερο άνετα και  χαλαρά όταν βρισκόμαστε στη φύση. Ο  συνδιασμός αλατιού και νερού έχει  τεράστια δύναμη να απορροφά και να μας αναζωογονεί σε όποια κατάσταση κι αν  βρισκόμαστε.","type":"text"}}],"version":"2.23.2","markupVersion":3,"mediaFiles":[]}

translations.name: Mantras
translations.content: {"time":1567078535,"blocks":[{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"714294046320ab0d","text":"When is it used?","type":"header","level":null,"decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"6211e7c4d78fa0d9","text":"You may have experienced the soothing feeling of sitting on the bank of a river, or standing on an ocean shore, with your feet in the cool water on a hot day. Maybe you were chatting with a friend and enjoying the view, not really paying attention to your state of being, but nevertheless the water would have cooled you down, relaxed and invigorated you.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"f4c09df6efe66717","text":"When you want to wind down after a hard day’s work or calm yourself before going to bed, doing a foot-soak is one of the easiest and most effective techniques out there. Whether you are feeling down, or hyped up and restless, soaking your feet in salt-water helps to restore balance within. Once you get into the routine of enjoying this simple 10-minute method, it can become as important to you as brushing your teeth.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"ebff599116aa72e6","text":"How is it done?","type":"header","level":null,"decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"6c127327185d739f","text":"You will need a plastic tub designated solely for this purpose. Fill it with enough water to cover your feet with water up to your ankles. The water should be cool if you are feeling overactive, and warm if you are feeling more lethargic or emotional. Take lukewarm water if in doubt. Add a handful of salt to your water (we recommend sea salt). Prepare a chair to sit on, a towel to dry your feet and a jug of water to rinse your feet after the 10-minute foot-soak. Once all this is in place, you are ready to begin.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"645d44a95b5ea8a3","text":"First, to start the foot-soak raise your Kundalini and give yourself a Bandhan, then sit with your palms facing upward and your feet immersed in the salt water. Try to keep your eyes closed, with your attention resting at the top of your head. You can combine other methods of cleansing with your foot-soak e.g.: keeping ice on your liver and/or listening to music or saying Bija mantras. At the end of your foot-soak, raise your Kundalini and give yourself a Bandhan once more. You will then need to rinse your feet over the bucket, dry them off with a towel, and simply throw the foot-soak water down the toilet.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"2a7c894471dd3087","text":"Note: Doing a foot-soak in a lake, river, or in the ocean can be even more effective because of the additional soothing and cleansing effect of being outdoors and in the nature (in this case no salt is added, because the qualities of Mother Earth are present already).","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"64d711528f2c82c2","text":"Why does it work?","type":"header","level":null,"decorations":{}}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"5f5b583093eb652b","text":"A lot of nerves end in our feet and soaking them in salt water can help soothe those nerves, relax our muscles and improve circulation.","type":"text"}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"a4a253e1b9f1e872","text":"Apart from the rewarding physical benefits, the salt water foot-soak quickly and efficiently clears out energetic blockages in our subtle system, especially those linked to the first three Chakras. How so? Water is the element of the Nabhi Chakra, based at the solar plexus. While perhaps a seemingly simple fact, water has a powerful capacity to cleanse and soothe us. Salt represents the earth element, which is related to the first center, the Mooladhara, located at the base of our spine or the pelvic plexus. The earth element also has the power to absorb and restore us, which is often why we might suddenly feel more at ease and relaxed when sitting in nature. The combination of salt and water thus has an immense power to absorb and revitalize us no matter what state we are in.","type":"text"}}],"media_files":[],"version":"2.15","markupVersion":3}

translations.content: {"time":1674078918296,"blocks":[{"id":"3EKThGg6Gb","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"714294046320ab0d","text":"Ne zaman uygulanır?","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"AHJiP1t6rd","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"tkjvoh5lr2","text":"Sıcak bir günde bir nehir kenarında oturmanın veya bir okyanus kıyısında ayaklarınızı soğuk suda tutmanın rahatlatıcı hissini yaşamış olabilirsiniz. Belki bir arkadaşınızla sohbet ediyor ve manzaranın tadını çıkarıyordunuz, ne halde olduğunuza pek dikkat etmiyordunuz ama yine de su sizi serinletiyor, rahatlatıyor ve canlandırıyordu.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"x9mMc_P19q","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Yorucu bir günün ardından dinlenmek veya yatmadan önce kendinizi sakinleştirmek istediğinizde, ayak banyosu yapmak en kolay ve en etkili tekniklerden biridir. Moraliniz bozuk olduğunda ya da sinirli ve huzursuz hissettiğinizde, ayaklarınızı tuzlu suya sokmak, içinizdeki dengeyi geri kazanmanıza yardımcı olur. Bu 10 dakikalık basit yöntemin keyfini çıkarma rutinine girdiğinizde, bu sizin için dişlerinizi fırçalamak kadar önemli hale gelebilir.","type":"text","level":"div"}},{"id":"Vhe5g29rXQ","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"ebff599116aa72e6","text":"Nasıl uygulanır?","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"i1h2Aqlp7R","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"u7ribkcl43","text":"Yalnızca bu amaç için tasarlanmış plastik bir leğene ihtiyacınız olacak. Leğeni, ayaklarınızı bileklerinize kadar kaplayacak şekilde su ile doldurun. Aşırı aktif hissediyorsanız su soğuk, daha pasif veya duygusal hissediyorsanız ılık olmalıdır. Şüpheniz varsa ılık su kullanın. Suyunuza bir avuç tuz ekleyin (deniz veya kaya tuzu öneririz). Oturmak için bir sandalye, 10 dakikalık ayak banyosundan sonra ayaklarınızı durulamak için bir sürahi su ve kurulanmanız için bir havlu hazırlayın. Hazırlıklar tamamlandığında başlayabilirsiniz.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"ets-HUYb7u","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"48475z60hfg","text":"Ayak banyosuna başlamak için önce Kundalini'nizi yükseltin ve kendinize bir Bandhan verin, ardından ellerinizi avuç içleriniz yukarı bakacak şekilde dizlerinizin üzerine yerleştirin ve ayaklarınızı tuzlu suyun içine daldırarak oturun. Dikkatinizi başınızın üstüne vererek, gözlerinizi kapalı tutmaya çalışın. Diğer temizlenme yöntemlerini ayak banyosuyla birleştirebilirsiniz, örneğin: karaciğerinize buz tutmak ve/veya müzik dinlemek veya Bija mantraları söylemek gibi. Ayak banyosunun sonunda Kundalini'nizi yükseltin ve kendinize bir kez daha Bandhan verin. Daha sonra ayaklarınızı leğenin üzerinde durulamanız, bir havluyla kurulamanız ve tuzlu su banyosu yaptığınız suyu tuvalete dökmeniz yeterli olacaktır.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"0_pGO9Z6bt","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"xiiu7ej8ui","text":"Not: Bir gölde, nehirde veya okyanusta ayak banyosu yapmak, açık havada ve doğada olmanın sağladığı ilave yatıştırıcı ve temizleyici etkiler nedeniyle, daha da etkili olabilir (bu durumda tuz eklenmez, çünkü gerekli özellikler Toprak Ana’da zaten mevcuttur).","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"iNRbDipjZZ","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"64d711528f2c82c2","text":"Neden işe yarar?","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"AO9BY_5h_j","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"c4y2zit8f5","text":"Birçok sinir ayaklarımızda noktalanır ve onları tuzlu suda bekletmek bu sinirleri yatıştırmaya, kaslarımızı gevşetmeye ve dolaşımı iyileştirmeye yardımcı olabilir.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"RKvvSW-GI6","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"2txmzqjn544","text":"Bizi rahatlatan fiziksel faydaların yanı sıra tuzlu suda ayak banyosu, süptil sistemimizde yer alan, özellikle ilk üç çakra ile bağlantılı enerji blokajlarını hızlı ve verimli bir şekilde temizler. Bu şöyle olur: Su, solar pleksusta bulunan Nabhi Çakra'nın elementidir. Basit bir gerçeklik gibi görünse de, suyun bizi temizleme ve yatıştırma konusunda güçlü bir kapasitesi vardır. Tuz ise, omurgamızın tabanında veya pelvik pleksusta bulunan birinci merkez olan Mooladhara ile ilgili toprak elementini temsil eder. Toprak elementi aynı zamanda bizi içine alma ve yenileme gücüne de sahiptir, bu nedenle doğada otururken birdenbire kendimizi daha rahat ve gevşemiş hissedebiliriz. Bu nedenle, tuzun ve suyun birleşimi, hangi koşulda olursak olalım, bizi iyileştirmek ve canlandırmak için muazzam bir güce sahiptir.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}}],"version":"2.23.2","markupVersion":3,"mediaFiles":[]}

Forse stavi chiacchierando con un amico e ti godevi la vista, non prestando davvero attenzione al tuo stato interiore, cionostante l'acqua ti stava rinfrescando, rilassando e rinvigorendo."}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"084af548abc778f0","text":"Quando vuoi rilassarti dopo una dura giornata di lavoro o calmarti prima di andare a letto, fare un pediluvio è una delle tecniche più semplici ed efficaci là fuori. Sia che ti senta giù di morale, sia che siate agitati e irrequieti, immergere i piedi in acqua salata aiuta a ristabilire l'equilibrio interiore. Una volta entrato nella routine di godere di questo semplice metodo di 10 minuti, può diventare importante per te come lavarti i denti.When you want to wind down after a hard day’s work or calm yourself before going to bed, doing a foot-soak is one of the easiest and most effective techniques out there. Whether you are feeling down, or hyped up and restless, soaking your feet in salt-water helps to restore balance within. Once you get into the routine of enjoying this simple 10-minute method, it can become as important to you as brushing your teeth."}},{"type":"header","data":{"id":"f50647a7866dfe3c","text":"Come si fa?","level":"h2","centered":false}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"e7bb0b06b59872ea","text":"You will need a plastic tub designated solely for this purpose. Fill it with enough water to cover your feet with water up to your ankles. The water should be cool if you are feeling overactive, and warm if you are feeling more lethargic or emotional. Take lukewarm water if in doubt. Add a handful of salt to your water (we recommend sea salt). Prepare a chair to sit on, a towel to dry your feet and a jug of water to rinse your feet after the 10-minute foot-soak. Once all this is in place, you are ready to begin."}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"25d896201f47cbe0","text":"First, to start the foot-soak raise your Kundalini and give yourself a Bandhan, then sit with your palms facing upward and your feet immersed in the salt water. Try to keep your eyes closed, with your attention resting at the top of your head. You can combine other methods of cleansing with your foot-soak e.g.: keeping ice on your liver and/or listening to music or saying Bija mantras. At the end of your foot-soak, raise your Kundalini and give yourself a Bandhan once more. You will then need to rinse your feet over the bucket, dry them off with a towel, and simply throw the foot-soak water down the toilet."}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"a46250a9d81abd8d","text":"Note: Doing a foot-soak in a lake, river, or in the ocean can be even more effective because of the additional soothing and cleansing effect of being outdoors and in the nature (in this case no salt is added, because the qualities of Mother Earth are present already)."}},{"type":"header","data":{"id":"9903ab2994263373","text":"Come funziona?","level":"h2","centered":false}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"95d1381ac0e7f675","text":"A lot of nerves end in our feet and soaking them in salt water can help soothe those nerves, relax our muscles and improve circulation."}},{"type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"06612fe3062965df","text":"Apart from the rewarding physical benefits, the salt water foot-soak quickly and efficiently clears out energetic blockages in our subtle system, especially those linked to the first three Chakras. How so? Water is the element of the Nabhi Chakra, based at the solar plexus. While perhaps a seemingly simple fact, water has a powerful capacity to cleanse and soothe us. Salt represents the earth element, which is related to the first center, the Mooladhara, located at the base of our spine or the pelvic plexus. The earth element also has the power to absorb and restore us, which is often why we might suddenly feel more at ease and relaxed when sitting in nature. The combination of salt and water thus has an immense power to absorb and revitalize us no matter what state we are in."}}],"version":"2.16.0","media_files":[]}

translations.name: Suçluluğu Bırakmak
translations.content: {"time":1674079104830,"blocks":[{"id":"ox2iehC7z4","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"6072c67c9cdc53a0","text":"Ne zaman uygulanır?","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"36dMDsAKe7","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"8c354b2266154989","text":"Sıcak bir günde bir nehir kenarında oturmanın veya bir okyanus kıyısında ayaklarınızı soğuk suda tutmanın rahatlatıcı hissini yaşamış olabilirsiniz. Belki bir arkadaşınızla sohbet ediyor ve manzaranın tadını çıkarıyordunuz, ne halde olduğunuza pek dikkat etmiyordunuz ama yine de su sizi serinletiyor, rahatlatıyor ve canlandırıyordu.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"3DDVbUUXGP","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"084af548abc778f0","text":"Yorucu bir günün ardından dinlenmek veya yatmadan önce kendinizi sakinleştirmek istediğinizde, ayak banyosu yapmak en kolay ve en etkili tekniklerden biridir. Moraliniz bozuk olduğunda ya da sinirli ve huzursuz hissettiğinizde, ayaklarınızı tuzlu suya sokmak, içinizdeki dengeyi geri kazanmanıza yardımcı olur. Bu 10 dakikalık basit yöntemin keyfini çıkarma rutinine girdiğinizde, bu sizin için dişlerinizi fırçalamak kadar önemli hale gelebilir.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"y8CsmHNG1S","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"f50647a7866dfe3c","text":"Nasıl uygulanır?","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"j7Ra-lrCEK","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"e7bb0b06b59872ea","text":"Yalnızca bu amaç için tasarlanmış plastik bir leğene ihtiyacınız olacak. Leğeni, ayaklarınızı bileklerinize kadar kaplayacak şekilde su ile doldurun. Aşırı aktif hissediyorsanız su soğuk, daha pasif veya duygusal hissediyorsanız ılık olmalıdır. Şüpheniz varsa ılık su kullanın. Suyunuza bir avuç tuz ekleyin (deniz veya kaya tuzu öneririz). Oturmak için bir sandalye, 10 dakikalık ayak banyosundan sonra ayaklarınızı durulamak için bir sürahi su ve kurulanmanız için bir havlu hazırlayın. Hazırlıklar tamamlandığında başlayabilirsiniz.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"owLThP1vak","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"25d896201f47cbe0","text":"Ayak banyosuna başlamak için önce Kundalini'nizi yükseltin ve kendinize bir Bandhan verin, ardından ellerinizi avuç içleriniz yukarı bakacak şekilde dizlerinizin üzerine yerleştirin ve ayaklarınızı tuzlu suyun içine daldırarak oturun. Dikkatinizi başınızın üstüne vererek, gözlerinizi kapalı tutmaya çalışın. Diğer temizlenme yöntemlerini ayak banyosuyla birleştirebilirsiniz, örneğin: karaciğerinize buz tutmak ve/veya müzik dinlemek veya Bija mantraları söylemek gibi. Ayak banyosunun sonunda Kundalini'nizi yükseltin ve kendinize bir kez daha Bandhan verin. Daha sonra ayaklarınızı leğenin üzerinde durulamanız, bir havluyla kurulamanız ve tuzlu su banyosu yaptığınız suyu tuvalete dökmeniz yeterli olacaktır.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"HXMXaZ7BB2","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"a46250a9d81abd8d","text":"Not: Bir gölde, nehirde veya okyanusta ayak banyosu yapmak, açık havada ve doğada olmanın sağladığı ilave yatıştırıcı ve temizleyici etkiler nedeniyle, daha da etkili olabilir (bu durumda tuz eklenmez, çünkü gerekli özellikler Toprak Ana’da zaten mevcuttur).","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"Yxp6OO4bCQ","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"9903ab2994263373","text":"Neden işe yarar?","type":"header","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"IBJIXr4VrW","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"95d1381ac0e7f675","text":"Birçok sinir ayaklarımızda noktalanır ve onları tuzlu suda bekletmek bu sinirleri yatıştırmaya, kaslarımızı gevşetmeye ve dolaşımı iyileştirmeye yardımcı olabilir.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}},{"id":"MeEQa7Vmrf","type":"paragraph","data":{"id":"06612fe3062965df","text":"Bizi rahatlatan fiziksel faydaların yanı sıra tuzlu suda ayak banyosu, süptil sistemimizde yer alan, özellikle ilk üç çakra ile bağlantılı enerji blokajlarını hızlı ve verimli bir şekilde temizler. Bu şöyle olur: Su, solar pleksusta bulunan Nabhi Çakra'nın elementidir. Basit bir gerçeklik gibi görünse de, suyun bizi temizleme ve yatıştırma konusunda güçlü bir kapasitesi vardır. Tuz ise, omurgamızın tabanında veya pelvik pleksusta bulunan birinci merkez olan Mooladhara ile ilgili toprak elementini temsil eder. Toprak elementi aynı zamanda bizi içine alma ve yenileme gücüne de sahiptir, bu nedenle doğada otururken birdenbire kendimizi daha rahat ve gevşemiş hissedebiliriz. Bu nedenle, tuzun ve suyun birleşimi, hangi koşulda olursak olalım, bizi iyileştirmek ve canlandırmak için muazzam bir güce sahiptir.","type":"text","level":"h2","decorations":{}}}],"version":"2.23.2","markupVersion":3,"mediaFiles":[]}
